theorem capacityVacancy_incoming_label_unique
    (r : α → ℕ) (htotal : ∑ j, r j = n + 1) (hr : ∀ j, 0 < r j)
    (cost : Fin (n + 1) → α → ℝ) (i₀ : Fin (n + 1)) (root : α)
    (a : Fin n → α)
    (ha : OptimalCapacityAssignment (capacityDeficit r root)
      (fun s j ↦ cost (i₀.succAbove s) j) a)
    (hunique : ∀ z b c,
      OptimalCapacityAssignment (capacityDeficit r z)
        (fun s j ↦ cost (i₀.succAbove s) j) b →
      OptimalCapacityAssignment (capacityDeficit r z)
        (fun s j ↦ cost (i₀.succAbove s) j) c → b = c)
    (k l : Fin n) (u w : α) (hmatch : a k = a l)
    (hu : u ≠ a k) (hw : w ≠ a l)
    (hku : capacityVacancyRowPotential r htotal hr cost i₀ (i₀.succAbove k) -
      capacityVacancyPrice r htotal cost i₀ u (hr u) = cost (i₀.succAbove k) u)
    (hlw : capacityVacancyRowPotential r htotal hr cost i₀ (i₀.succAbove l) -
      capacityVacancyPrice r htotal cost i₀ w (hr w) = cost (i₀.succAbove l) w) :
    k = l ∧ u = w

theorem exists_optimalCapacityAssignment_reroot_path
    (r : α → ℕ) (htotal : ∑ j, r j = n + 1) (hr : ∀ j, 0 < r j)
    (cost : Fin (n + 1) → α → ℝ) (i₀ : Fin (n + 1)) (root : α)
    (a : Fin n → α)
    (ha : OptimalCapacityAssignment (capacityDeficit r root)
      (fun s j ↦ cost (i₀.succAbove s) j) a)
    (m : ℕ) (v : Fin (m + 1) → α) (hv : Function.Injective v) (hroot : v 0 = root)
    (k : Fin m → Fin n) (hmatch : ∀ t, a (k t) = v t.succ)
    (htight : ∀ t,
      capacityVacancyRowPotential r htotal hr cost i₀ (i₀.succAbove (k t)) -
        capacityVacancyPrice r htotal cost i₀ (v t.castSucc) (hr (v t.castSucc)) =
          cost (i₀.succAbove (k t)) (v t.castSucc)) :

        (fun s j ↦ cost (i₀.succAbove s) j) b ∧
      (∀ t, b (k t) = v t.castSucc) ∧
      (∀ s, s ∉ Set.range k → b s = a s)

theorem capacityVacancy_score_le_iff_tree_score_le {m : ℕ}
    (hα : ∑ _ : α, 1 = m + 1) (e : Fin m ≃ {k : Fin n // T k})
    (treeCost : Fin (m + 1) → α → ℝ) (iT : Fin (m + 1))
    (hcost : ∀ k j, treeCost (iT.succAbove k) j = cost (i₀.succAbove (e k)) j)
    (row : α → ℝ) (j l : α) :
    (row j + capacityVacancyPrice r htotal cost i₀ j (hr j) ≤
      row l + capacityVacancyPrice r htotal cost i₀ l (hr l)) ↔
    (row j + capacityVacancyPrice (fun _ : α ↦ 1) hα treeCost iT j (by omega) ≤
      row l + capacityVacancyPrice (fun _ : α ↦ 1) hα treeCost iT l (by omega))

theorem exists_capacityVacancy_labelled_path
    (r : α → ℕ) (htotal : ∑ j, r j = n + 1) (hr : ∀ j, 0 < r j)
    (cost : Fin (n + 1) → α → ℝ) (i₀ : Fin (n + 1)) (root : α)
    (a : Fin n → α)
    (ha : OptimalCapacityAssignment (capacityDeficit r root)
      (fun s j ↦ cost (i₀.succAbove s) j) a) (z : α) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (v : Fin (m + 1) → α) (k : Fin m → Fin n),
      Function.Injective v ∧ v 0 = root ∧ v (Fin.last m) = z ∧
      (∀ t, a (k t) = v t.succ) ∧
      ∀ t, capacityVacancyRowPotential r htotal hr cost i₀ (i₀.succAbove (k t)) -
        capacityVacancyPrice r htotal cost i₀ (v t.castSucc) (hr (v t.castSucc)) =
          cost (i₀.succAbove (k t)) (v t.castSucc)

theorem exists_calibrated_levelCylinder
    {σ : W → E} {B : Set W} {x₀ : E} {K : Set E} {ψ : E → ℝ}
    {T : ℝ × E → E} {r τ : ℝ} {C : ℝ≥0}
    (hB : IsOpen B) (h0 : (0 : W) ∈ B) (hσ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 σ B)
    (hσ0 : σ 0 = x₀) (hinj : InjOn σ B) (hK : IsClosed K) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hT : LipschitzOnWith C T (Icc (-τ) τ ×ˢ closedBall x₀ r))
    (hfixed : ∀ t ∈ Icc (-τ) τ, InjOn (fun x ↦ T (t, x)) (closedBall x₀ r))
    (hclock : ∀ t ∈ Icc (-τ) τ, ∀ x ∈ K ∩ closedBall x₀ r,
      ψ (T (t, x)) = ψ x + t)
    (hlevel : ∀ w ∈ B, σ w ∈ K → ψ (σ w) = ψ x₀) :
    ∃ a : ℝ, ∃ L : ℝ≥0, 0 < a ∧ ball 0 a ⊆ B ∧
      MapsTo σ (ball 0 a) (ball x₀ r) ∧
      LipschitzOnWith L (fun q : ℝ × W ↦ T (q.1, σ q.2))
        (Ioo (-τ) τ ×ˢ ball 0 a) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ Ioo (-τ) τ ×ˢ (ball 0 a ∩ σ ⁻¹' K),
        ψ (T (q.1, σ q.2)) = ψ x₀ + q.1) ∧
      InjOn (fun q : ℝ × W ↦ T (q.1, σ q.2))
        (Ioo (-τ) τ ×ˢ (ball 0 a ∩ σ ⁻¹' K)) ∧
      MeasurableSet (Ioo (-τ) τ ×ˢ (ball 0 a ∩ σ ⁻¹' K)) ∧
      Ioo (-τ) τ ×ˢ (ball 0 a ∩ σ ⁻¹' K) ⊆ Ioo (-τ) τ ×ˢ ball 0 a

theorem map_labelClock_restrict_eq_withDensity_of_comap
    (P : CalibratedSeedWindow F u)
    (hF : F.IsSmoothStronglyConvex)
    (hcomplete : @CompleteSpace M F.metricSpace.toUniformSpace)
    (hu : let _instWindowPushforwardLip : MetricSpace M := F.metricSpace
      LipschitzWith 1 u)
    {a : M → Z} (ha : Measurable a)
    (hinj : Function.Injective
      (fun x : F.potentialRegularDomain u ↦ (a x.val, u x.val)))
    (horder : let _instWindowPushforwardOrder : MetricSpace M := F.metricSpace
      ∀ x ∈ F.potentialRegularDomain u, ∀ y ∈ F.potentialRegularDomain u,
        (a x = a y ∧ u x ≤ u y) ↔ u y - u x = dist x y)
    (m : Measure E) [m.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (κ : Measure P.seed.covector.ker) [κ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (hprod : tubeParameterMeasure P.seed.normalization m =
      (volume : Measure ℝ).prod κ)
    (η : Measure M) (w : P.domain → ℝ≥0∞) (hw : Measurable w)
    (hpullback : η.comap (fun z : P.domain ↦ P.toManifold z) =
      ((tubeParameterMeasure P.seed.normalization m).comap
        ((↑) : P.domain → ℝ × P.seed.covector.ker)).withDensity w)
    {C : Set M} (hC : MeasurableSet C)
    (hCP : C ⊆ P.toManifold '' P.domain) :
    let L := P.labels ∩ ball P.center.2 (P.seed.radius P.center)
    let k := κ.comap ((↑) : L → P.seed.covector.ker)
    let e : L → Z := fun w ↦ a (P.seed.curve w 0)
    let β := k.map e
    let q : P.domain → Z × ℝ := fun z ↦
      (a (P.toManifold z), u (P.toManifold z))
    let d : P.domain → ℝ≥0∞ := fun z ↦
      w z * (C.indicator (fun _ : M ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞))) (P.toManifold z)
    let G : Z × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞ := Function.extend q d (fun _ ↦ 0)
    IsFiniteMeasure β ∧ Measurable G ∧
      (η.restrict C).map (fun x ↦ (a x, u x)) =
        (β.prod (volume : Measure ℝ)).withDensity G

    (hu : let _instWindowPushforwardLip : MetricSpace M := F.metricSpace

    {a : M → Z} (ha : Measurable a)
    (hinj : Function.Injective
      (fun x : F.potentialRegularDomain u ↦ (a x.val, u x.val)))
    (horder : let _instWindowPushforwardOrder : MetricSpace M := F.metricSpace

    (m : Measure E) [m.IsAddHaarMeasure]

    (hprod : tubeParameterMeasure P.seed.normalization m =

    let O := fun j ↦ (P j).toManifold '' (P j).domain
    let C := disjointed O
    let L := fun j ↦ (P j).labels ∩
      ball (P j).center.2 ((P j).seed.radius (P j).center)
    let β := fun j ↦ ((κ j).comap ((↑) : L j → (P j).seed.covector.ker)).map
      (fun w : L j ↦ a ((P j).seed.curve w 0))
    let q := fun j (z : (P j).domain) ↦

    (himm : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ σ w₀))
    {v₀ : E} (hz : (σ w₀, v₀) ∈ chartEnergyDomain x₀)
    (hmatch : fderiv ℝ f (σ w₀) = fiberLegendre (F.chartEnergy x₀) (σ w₀, v₀))
    (t₀ : ℝ) :
    let L := F.chartEnergy x₀
    let z := (σ w₀, v₀)
    let p₀ := parametricLegendre L z
    ∃ (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (E × E) (E × (E →L[ℝ] ℝ)))
      (U : Set W) (v : W → E) (a : W → ℝ) (r : ℝ≥0) (T : ℝ)
      (Φ : (E × (E →L[ℝ] ℝ)) × ℝ → E × (E →L[ℝ] ℝ)),
      let seed := potentialConormalState f σ a
      let Z := fun t ↦ fderiv ℝ (fun w ↦ Φ (seed w, t)) w₀
      (e : (E × E) → (E × (E →L[ℝ] ℝ))) = parametricLegendre L ∧
      z ∈ e.source ∧ e.source ⊆ chartEnergyDomain x₀ ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ e.symm e.target ∧
      IsOpen U ∧ w₀ ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ V ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U ∧ v w₀ = v₀ ∧ a w₀ = 1 ∧
      (∀ w ∈ U, (σ w, v w) ∈ e.source ∧ 0 < a w ∧
        L (σ w, v w) = L z ∧
        fiberLegendre L (σ w, v w) = a w • fderiv ℝ f (σ w) ∧
        e.symm (seed w) = (σ w, v w)) ∧
      0 < r ∧ 0 < T ∧
      LocalFlow.IsLocalFlow (fun _ ↦ localHamiltonianVectorField L e)
        t₀ p₀ r (t₀ - T) (t₀ + T) Φ ∧
      MapsTo Φ (closedBall p₀ r ×ˢ Icc (t₀ - T) (t₀ + T)) e.target ∧
      (∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 w₀, seed w ∈ closedBall p₀ r ∧ L (e.symm (seed w)) = L z) ∧
      Z t₀ = fderiv ℝ seed w₀ ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc (t₀ - T) (t₀ + T),
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w ↦ Φ (seed w, t)) w₀ ∧
        Function.Injective (Z t) ∧
        (∀ u w : W, canonicalPhasePairing (Z t u) (Z t w) = 0) ∧
        (∀ u : W, HasDerivWithinAt (fun s ↦ Z s u)
          (fderiv ℝ (localHamiltonianVectorField L e) (Φ (p₀, t)) (Z t u))
          (Icc (t₀ - T) (t₀ + T)) t) ∧

    (m : Measure E) [IsAddHaarMeasure m]
    {K U : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hU : IsOpen U) (hKU : K ⊆ U)

    (hactual : ∀ x ∈ K,

    {A : E → ℝ → M} (hEL : ∀ x ∈ U, F.IsEulerLagrangeOn (A x) univ)

      (∀ x ∈ C, ∃ l r : M,
        dist l ((extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E) old).symm x) = Δ ∧
        u ((extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E) old).symm x) - u l = Δ ∧
        dist ((extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E) old).symm x) r = Δ ∧
        u r - u ((extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E) old).symm x) = Δ) ∧

    (hcomplete : @CompleteSpace M F.metricSpace.toUniformSpace) (initial : M)
    {f : E → ℝ} {Ω : Set E} {y₀ v₀ : E}
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ Ω)
    (hz : (y₀, v₀) ∈ chartEnergyDomain initial)
    (hmatch : fderiv ℝ f y₀ = fiberLegendre (F.chartEnergy initial) (y₀, v₀))
    (t₀ : ℝ) :
    let p := fderiv ℝ f y₀
    Module.finrank ℝ p.ker + 1 = Module.finrank ℝ E ∧
    ∃ (B₀ B : Set p.ker) (σ v : p.ker → E) (a : p.ker → ℝ)
      (Γ : p.ker → ℝ → M) (U : Set E),
      IsOpen B₀ ∧ IsOpen B ∧ (0 : p.ker) ∈ B ∧ B ⊆ B₀ ∧
      IsOpen U ∧ y₀ ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ Ω ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ σ B₀ ∧ σ 0 = y₀ ∧ MapsTo σ B₀ Ω ∧
      (∀ w ∈ B₀, f (σ w) = f y₀) ∧ HasFDerivAt σ p.ker.subtypeL 0 ∧
      InjOn σ B₀ ∧ σ '' B₀ = U ∩ {x | f x = f y₀} ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v B ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a B ∧ v 0 = v₀ ∧ a 0 = 1 ∧
      (∀ w ∈ B, (σ w, v w) ∈ chartEnergyDomain initial ∧ 0 < a w) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ B, F.IsEulerLagrangeOn (Γ w) univ) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ B, tangentMap 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E) (Γ w) ⟨t₀, (1 : ℝ)⟩ =
        (extChartAt (𝓘(ℝ, E).prod 𝓘(ℝ, E))
          (⟨initial, 0⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E) M)).symm (σ w, v w)) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ B, F.chartMomentumFamily initial Γ (w, t₀) =
        potentialConormalState f σ a w) ∧
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, p.ker × ℝ) (𝓘(ℝ, E).prod 𝓘(ℝ, E)) 2
        (fun q ↦ tangentMap 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E) (Γ q.1) ⟨q.2, (1 : ℝ)⟩) (B ×ˢ univ) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ B, ∀ t : ℝ,
        F.energy (tangentMap 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E) (Γ w) ⟨t, (1 : ℝ)⟩) =
          F.chartEnergy initial (y₀, v₀)) ∧
      (∀ (old : M) (t : ℝ), Γ 0 t ∈ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E) old).source →
        Function.Injective
          (fderiv ℝ (fun b ↦ F.chartMomentumFamily old Γ (b, t)) 0)) ∧
      ∀ w ∈ B, ∀ (old : M) (t : ℝ), Γ w t ∈ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E) old).source →
        ∀ ξ η : p.ker, canonicalPhasePairing
          (fderiv ℝ (fun b ↦ F.chartMomentumFamily old Γ (b, t)) w ξ)
          (fderiv ℝ (fun b ↦ F.chartMomentumFamily old Γ (b, t)) w η) = 0

    {X : E → E} {U : Set E} {p : E} {r : ℝ≥0} {τ T : ℝ} {Φ : E × ℝ → E}
    (hΦ : IsLocalFlow (fun _ ↦ X) τ p r (τ - T) (τ + T) Φ)
    (hT : 0 < T)
    (hmap : MapsTo Φ (closedBall p r ×ˢ Icc (τ - T) (τ + T)) U)
    (hCn : ContDiffOn ℝ (n : ℕ∞) Φ (closedBall p r ×ˢ Icc (τ - T) (τ + T)))

    ∃ B' : Set W, IsOpen B' ∧ w₀ ∈ B' ∧ B' ⊆ B ∧
      MapsTo seed B' (ball p r) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ (n : ℕ∞) Ψ (B' ×ˢ Ioo (s₀ - T) (s₀ + T)) ∧
      MapsTo Ψ (B' ×ˢ Ioo (s₀ - T) (s₀ + T)) U ∧
      s₀ ∈ Ioo (s₀ - T) (s₀ + T) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ B', Ψ (w, s₀) = seed w) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ B', ∀ t ∈ Ioo (s₀ - T) (s₀ + T),
        HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ Ψ (w, s)) (X (Ψ (w, t))) t) ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fun w ↦ Ψ (w, s₀)) w₀ = fderiv ℝ seed w₀

theorem exists_chartNormalPositionFlow (hF : F.IsSmoothStronglyConvex)
    (x₀ : M) {z : E × E} (hz : z ∈ chartEnergyDomain x₀) (t₀ : ℝ) :
    let L := F.chartEnergy x₀
    let p := fiberLegendre L z
    ∃ (g : OpenPartialHomeomorph (p.ker × ℝ) E) (ρ τ : ℝ) (a : p.ker → ℝ),
      let phase := fun q : p.ker × ℝ ↦ (g q, deriv (fun t ↦ g (q.1, t)) q.2)
      0 < ρ ∧ 0 < τ ∧
      g.source = ball (0 : p.ker) ρ ×ˢ Ioo (t₀ - τ) (t₀ + τ) ∧
      (0, t₀) ∈ g.source ∧ z.1 ∈ g.target ∧
      g (0, t₀) = z.1 ∧ g.symm z.1 = (0, t₀) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 2 g g.source ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 g.symm g.target ∧
      g.target ⊆ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E) x₀).target ∧
      phase (0, t₀) = z ∧
      (∀ q ∈ g.source, phase q ∈ chartEnergyDomain x₀ ∧ L (phase q) = L z) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ ball (0 : p.ker) ρ, g (w, t₀) = z.1 + (w : E) ∧
        fiberLegendre L (phase (w, t₀)) = a w • p) ∧
      ∀ q ∈ g.source, HasDerivAt
        (fun t ↦ fiberLegendre L (phase (q.1, t)))
        (baseEnergyDifferential L (phase q)) q.2

theorem exists_uniform_complete_normal_path_upper
    (hF : F.IsSmoothStronglyConvex) (old : M)
    {Phi : (E × E) → ℝ → M}
    (hEL : ∀ z ∈ chartEnergyDomain old, F.IsEulerLagrangeOn (Phi z) univ)
    (hinit : ∀ z ∈ chartEnergyDomain old,
      tangentMap 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E) (Phi z) ⟨0, (1 : ℝ)⟩ =
        (extChartAt (𝓘(ℝ, E).prod 𝓘(ℝ, E))
          (⟨old, 0⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E) M)).symm z)
    {K : Set (E × E)} (hK : IsCompact K) (hKU : K ⊆ chartEnergyDomain old)
    (hunit : ∀ z ∈ K, (F.chartLength old z : ℝ) = 1) (lo hi : ℝ) :
    ∃ r > 0, ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ {a b : ℝ}, a ≤ b → lo ≤ a → b ≤ hi →
      ∀ {z : ℝ → E × E} {L : ℝ≥0}, LipschitzOnWith L z (Icc a b) →
      MapsTo z (Icc a b) K → (L : ℝ) ≤ r →
      (∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Ioo a b),
        (fderiv ℝ (fun w : TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E) (Phi (z s) s) ↦
            (F.toFun ⟨Phi (z s) s, w⟩ : ℝ))
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E) (Phi (z s)) s 1))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E) (fun q ↦ Phi (z q) s) s 1) = 0) →
      (F.lengthEDist (Phi (z a) a) (Phi (z b) b)).toReal - (b - a) ≤
        (b - a) * (C : ℝ) * (L : ℝ) ^ 2

theorem chartLengthKernelCompliance_eq_compression
    (hF : F.IsSmoothStronglyConvex)
    {Γ : W → ℝ → M} {B : Set W} (hB : IsOpen B)
    (hEL : ∀ w ∈ B, F.IsEulerLagrangeOn (Γ w) univ)
    (hG : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, W × ℝ) (𝓘(ℝ, E).prod 𝓘(ℝ, E)) 2
      (fun q ↦ tangentMap 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E) (Γ q.1) ⟨q.2, (1 : ℝ)⟩) (B ×ˢ univ))
    {w₀ : W} (hw : w₀ ∈ B) (old : M) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hx : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, Γ w₀ t ∈ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E) old).source)
    (p : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v₀ : E) (hp : p v₀ ≠ 0)
    (hvelocity : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, deriv (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E) old ∘ Γ w₀) t = v₀)
    (hmomentum : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, (F.chartMomentumFamily old Γ (w₀, t)).2 = p)
    (hunit : ∀ t ∈ Icc a b, (F.chartLength old
      ((extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E) old ∘ Γ w₀) t,

    {μ ν : Measure E} [IsAddHaarMeasure μ] (hν : ν ≪ μ)
    {N : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace N] {φ : N → ℝ}
    (hφ : LipschitzWith 1 φ) (Y : E → N)
    {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) (hνK : ν K ≠ ⊤)

    (haA : MapsTo a K A) (hbB : MapsTo b K B)
    (ha : ∀ x ∈ K, φ (Y x) - φ (a x) = dist (a x) (Y x))
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ K, φ (b x) - φ (Y x) = dist (Y x) (b x))
    (hleft : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ z ∈ closedBall c (3 * R),
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun y ↦ dist a (Y y)) z)
    (hright : ∀ b ∈ B, ∀ z ∈ closedBall c (3 * R),
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun y ↦ dist (Y y) b) z)
    (hcontLeft : ContinuousOn
      (fun q : N × E ↦ fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y ↦ dist q.1 (Y y))) q.2)
      (A ×ˢ closedBall c (3 * R)))
    (hcontRight : ContinuousOn
      (fun q : N × E ↦ fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y ↦ dist (Y y) q.1)) q.2)
      (B ×ˢ closedBall c (3 * R)))
    (hunit : ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ v : E, (x, v) ∈ chartEnergyDomain old ∧
      fiberLegendre (F.chartEnergy old) (x, v) = fderiv ℝ (φ ∘ Y) x ∧

      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G Kᶜ ∧ LipschitzWith L (fderiv ℝ G) ∧

      (∀ x ∈ K, HasFDerivAt (φ ∘ Y) (fderiv ℝ G x) x) ∧
      let J : E → Prop := fun x ↦
        Tendsto (fun r ↦ μ (K ∩ closedBall x r) / μ (closedBall x r))

    (hcomplete : @CompleteSpace M F.metricSpace.toUniformSpace) (old : M)

theorem chartMomentum_supplied_family_same_firstJet_mixed
    (hF : F.IsSmoothStronglyConvex) (initial : M)
    {Φ : (E × E) → ℝ → M}
    (hEL : ∀ z ∈ chartEnergyDomain initial, F.IsEulerLagrangeOn (Φ z) univ)
    (hΦ : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, (E × E) × ℝ) (𝓘(ℝ, E).prod 𝓘(ℝ, E)) ∞
      (fun z ↦ tangentMap 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E) (Φ z.1) ⟨z.2, (1 : ℝ)⟩)
      (chartEnergyDomain initial ×ˢ univ))
    {eL : OpenPartialHomeomorph (E × E) (E × (E →L[ℝ] ℝ))}
    (hsource : eL.source ⊆ chartEnergyDomain initial)
    (hInv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ eL.symm eL.target)
    {X Y : W → E × (E →L[ℝ] ℝ)} {f g : W → ℝ} {s : Set W} {w : W}
    {D : W →L[ℝ] E × (E →L[ℝ] ℝ)} {a : W →L[ℝ] ℝ}
    (hX : HasFDerivWithinAt X D s w) (hY : HasFDerivAt Y D w)
    (hf : HasFDerivWithinAt f a s w) (hg : HasFDerivAt g a w)
    (hseed : X w = Y w) (hclock : f w = g w) (hYt : Y w ∈ eL.target)
    (out : M) (r : ℝ)
    (hlegal : Φ (eL.symm (Y w)) (r - g w) ∈ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E) out).source) :
    let Ψ := fun (q : (E × (E →L[ℝ] ℝ)) × ℝ) ↦
      F.chartMomentumFamily out Φ (eL.symm q.1, q.2)
    Ψ (X w, r - f w) = Ψ (Y w, r - g w) ∧
      HasFDerivAt (fun y ↦ Ψ (Y y, r - g y))
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y ↦ Ψ (Y y, r - g y)) w) w ∧

    (hcal : let _instPotentialClockCalibration : MetricSpace M := F.metricSpace

    {A B : Set M} (hAB : Disjoint A B)

theorem exists_complete_normalPotentialLevelFamily [T2Space M] [PreconnectedSpace M]
    (hF : F.IsSmoothStronglyConvex)
    (hcomplete : @CompleteSpace M F.metricSpace.toUniformSpace) (initial : M)
    {f : E → ℝ} {Ω : Set E} {y₀ v₀ : E}
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ Ω)
    (hz : (y₀, v₀) ∈ chartEnergyDomain initial)
    (hmatch : fderiv ℝ f y₀ = fiberLegendre (F.chartEnergy initial) (y₀, v₀))
    (t₀ : ℝ) :
    let p := fderiv ℝ f y₀
    Module.finrank ℝ p.ker + 1 = Module.finrank ℝ E ∧
    ∃ (B : Set p.ker) (σ : p.ker → E) (a : p.ker → ℝ) (Γ : p.ker → ℝ → M),
      IsOpen B ∧ (0 : p.ker) ∈ B ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ σ B ∧ σ 0 = y₀ ∧ MapsTo σ B Ω ∧
      (∀ w ∈ B, f (σ w) = f y₀) ∧ HasFDerivAt σ p.ker.subtypeL 0 ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a B ∧ a 0 = 1 ∧ (∀ w ∈ B, 0 < a w) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ B, F.IsEulerLagrangeOn (Γ w) univ) ∧
      tangentMap 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E) (Γ 0) ⟨t₀, (1 : ℝ)⟩ =
        (extChartAt (𝓘(ℝ, E).prod 𝓘(ℝ, E))
          (⟨initial, 0⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E) M)).symm (y₀, v₀) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ B, F.chartMomentumFamily initial Γ (w, t₀) =
        potentialConormalState f σ a w) ∧
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, p.ker × ℝ) (𝓘(ℝ, E).prod 𝓘(ℝ, E)) 2
        (fun q ↦ tangentMap 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E) (Γ q.1) ⟨q.2, (1 : ℝ)⟩) (B ×ˢ univ) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ B, ∀ t : ℝ,
        F.energy (tangentMap 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E) (Γ w) ⟨t, (1 : ℝ)⟩) =
          F.chartEnergy initial (y₀, v₀)) ∧
      (∀ (old : M) (t : ℝ), Γ 0 t ∈ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E) old).source →
        Function.Injective
          (fderiv ℝ (fun b ↦ F.chartMomentumFamily old Γ (b, t)) 0)) ∧
      (∀ w ∈ B, ∀ (old : M) (t : ℝ), Γ w t ∈ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E) old).source →
        ∀ ξ η : p.ker, canonicalPhasePairing
          (fderiv ℝ (fun b ↦ F.chartMomentumFamily old Γ (b, t)) w ξ)
          (fderiv ℝ (fun b ↦ F.chartMomentumFamily old Γ (b, t)) w η) = 0) ∧
      ∀ w ∈ B, ∀ (old : M) (t : ℝ), Γ w t ∈ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E) old).source →
        ∀ ξ : p.ker, (F.chartMomentumFamily old Γ (w, t)).2
          (fderiv ℝ (fun b ↦ extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E) old (Γ b t)) w ξ) = 0

          HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ P (q.1, s)) (GraphHamiltonian.field L g q.2 (P q)) q.2 ∧

            let Z := fun s ↦ fderiv ℝ (fun w ↦ P (w, s)) q.1 ξ
            HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ (Z s).1) (B' (Z q.2).1 + C (Z q.2).2) q.2 ∧
            HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ (Z s).2) (-A (Z q.2).1 - (Z q.2).2.comp B') q.2) ∧
          (∀ u v, A u v = A v u) ∧
          (∀ p r : V →L[ℝ] ℝ, r (C p) = p (C r)) ∧

            (GraphLegendre.verticalHessian L (g.symm ((q.2, (P q).1), (P q).2))) ∧
          ∀ p : V →L[ℝ] ℝ, p ≠ 0 → 0 < p (C p)

theorem exists_chartHamiltonian_potentialNormalC2Flow [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (hF : F.IsSmoothStronglyConvex) (x₀ : M)
    {f : E → ℝ} {σ : W → E} {Ω : Set E} {V : Set W} {w₀ : W} {c : ℝ}
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f Ω)
    (hV : IsOpen V) (hw₀ : w₀ ∈ V) (hσ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ σ V) (hσΩ : MapsTo σ V Ω)
    (hlevel : (fun w ↦ f (σ w)) =ᶠ[𝓝 w₀] fun _ ↦ c)
    (himm : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ σ w₀))
    {v₀ : E} (hz : (σ w₀, v₀) ∈ chartEnergyDomain x₀)
    (hmatch : fderiv ℝ f (σ w₀) = fiberLegendre (F.chartEnergy x₀) (σ w₀, v₀))
    (t₀ : ℝ) :
    let L := F.chartEnergy x₀
    let z := (σ w₀, v₀)
    let p₀ := parametricLegendre L z
    ∃ (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph (E × E) (E × (E →L[ℝ] ℝ)))
      (U : Set W) (v : W → E) (a : W → ℝ) (r : ℝ≥0) (T : ℝ)
      (Φ : (E × (E →L[ℝ] ℝ)) × ℝ → E × (E →L[ℝ] ℝ))
      (D : Set ((E × (E →L[ℝ] ℝ)) × ℝ)),
      let seed := potentialConormalState f σ a
      let Ψ := fun q : W × ℝ ↦ Φ (seed q.1, q.2)
      let Z := fun t ↦ fderiv ℝ (fun w ↦ Ψ (w, t)) w₀
      (e : (E × E) → (E × (E →L[ℝ] ℝ))) = parametricLegendre L ∧
      z ∈ e.source ∧ e.source ⊆ chartEnergyDomain x₀ ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ e.symm e.target ∧
      IsOpen U ∧ w₀ ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ V ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U ∧ v w₀ = v₀ ∧ a w₀ = 1 ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ seed U ∧ seed w₀ = p₀ ∧
      (∀ w ∈ U, (σ w, v w) ∈ e.source ∧ 0 < a w ∧
        L (σ w, v w) = L z ∧
        fiberLegendre L (σ w, v w) = a w • fderiv ℝ f (σ w) ∧
        e.symm (seed w) = (σ w, v w) ∧ seed w ∈ closedBall p₀ r) ∧
      0 < r ∧ 0 < T ∧
      LocalFlow.IsLocalFlow (fun _ ↦ localHamiltonianVectorField L e)
        t₀ p₀ r (t₀ - T) (t₀ + T) Φ ∧
      MapsTo Φ (closedBall p₀ r ×ˢ Icc (t₀ - T) (t₀ + T)) e.target ∧
      IsOpen D ∧ closedBall p₀ r ×ˢ Icc (t₀ - T) (t₀ + T) ⊆ D ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 2 Φ D ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 Ψ (U ×ˢ Ioo (t₀ - T) (t₀ + T)) ∧
      Z t₀ = fderiv ℝ seed w₀ ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc (t₀ - T) (t₀ + T),
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w ↦ Ψ (w, t)) w₀ ∧
        Function.Injective (Z t) ∧
        (∀ u w : W, canonicalPhasePairing (Z t u) (Z t w) = 0) ∧
        (∀ u : W, HasDerivWithinAt (fun s ↦ Z s u)
          (fderiv ℝ (localHamiltonianVectorField L e) (Φ (p₀, t)) (Z t u))
          (Icc (t₀ - T) (t₀ + T)) t) ∧
        ∀ u : W, (Z t u).1 ∈ (fiberLegendre L (e.symm (Φ (p₀, t)))).ker

    {Z T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Z] [TopologicalSpace.MetrizableSpace Z]
    [TopologicalSpace T] [TopologicalSpace.MetrizableSpace T]
    {K : Set Z} {H : Set T} (hK : IsCompact K) (hH : IsCompact H)
    {A : Z × T → Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : ContinuousOn A (K ×ˢ H))
    (hpos : ∀ z ∈ K, ∀ p ∈ H, (A (z, p)).PosDef)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ (centers : Set Z) (U : Z → Set Z), centers.Finite ∧ centers ⊆ K ∧
      K ⊆ ⋃ z ∈ centers, U z ∧ ∀ z₀ ∈ centers, IsOpen (U z₀) ∧ z₀ ∈ U z₀ ∧
        ∀ z ∈ K ∩ U z₀, ∀ p ∈ H, ∀ v : n → ℝ,

            ε * matrixQuadratic (A (z₀, p)) v

    (p₁ p₂ δ : ι → ℝ) (D₀ : ℝ)
    (hcycle : matrixQuadratic (A₁ + B₁) p₁ + matrixQuadratic (A₂ + B₂) p₂ ≤
      matrixQuadratic (A₁ + B₂)⁻¹ (δ + A₁ *ᵥ p₁ + B₂ *ᵥ p₂) +
        matrixQuadratic (A₂ + B₁)⁻¹ (-δ + A₂ *ᵥ p₂ + B₁ *ᵥ p₁) + D₀) :
    let A₁' := T * A₁ * Tᵀ
    let B₁' := T * B₁ * Tᵀ
    let A₂' := T * A₂ * Tᵀ
    let B₂' := T * B₂ * Tᵀ
    let p₁' := (Tᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ p₁
    let p₂' := (Tᵀ)⁻¹ *ᵥ p₂
    let δ' := T *ᵥ δ
    matrixQuadratic (A₁' + B₁') p₁' + matrixQuadratic (A₂' + B₂') p₂' ≤
      matrixQuadratic (A₁' + B₂')⁻¹ (δ' + A₁' *ᵥ p₁' + B₂' *ᵥ p₂') +
        matrixQuadratic (A₂' + B₁')⁻¹ (-δ' + A₂' *ᵥ p₂' + B₁' *ᵥ p₁') + D₀

theorem legalTwoCycle_fourLeg_variation
    {A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hA₁ : A₁.PosDef) (hB₁ : B₁.PosDef) (hA₂ : A₂.PosDef) (hB₂ : B₂.PosDef)
    (p₁ p₂ δ : ι → ℝ) (D₀ : ℝ)
    (hcycle : matrixQuadratic (A₁ + B₁) p₁ + matrixQuadratic (A₂ + B₂) p₂ ≤

      matrixQuadratic A₁⁻¹ h + matrixQuadratic A₂⁻¹ h +
      matrixQuadratic B₁⁻¹ (h - δ) + matrixQuadratic B₂⁻¹ (h - δ)

private theorem norm_inverse_mulVec_le_of_identity_lower_bound
    {U : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hU : U.PosSemidef) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    {v : ι → ℝ} (hv : ‖v‖ ≤ 2 * R) :
    ‖(1 + U)⁻¹ *ᵥ v‖ ≤ 2 * ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) + 1) * R := by
  have hlo : ((1 + U) - (1 : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)).PosSemidef := by
    simpa using hU
  have hp := posDef_of_scalar_identity_lower_bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) hlo
  have hquad (w : ι → ℝ) :
      |matrixQuadratic (1 + U)⁻¹ w| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i, w i ^ 2 := by
    have hn : 0 ≤ matrixQuadratic (1 + U)⁻¹ w := by
      apply mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
      simpa only [star_trivial] using hp.inv.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg w
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hn]
    simpa using matrixQuadratic_inverse_le_of_scalar_identity_lower_bound
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) hlo w
  have hnorm := norm_mulVec_sq_le_quadratic_of_sum_bound hp.inv.posSemidef
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) hquad v
  have henergy := (le_abs_self (matrixQuadratic (1 + U)⁻¹ v)).trans (hquad v)
  have hsum : (∑ i, v i ^ 2) ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * (2 * R) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : ι, (2 * R) ^ 2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        have hi : |v i| ≤ 2 * R := (norm_le_pi_norm v i).trans hv
        simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hi 2
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hn : 0 ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have htarget : 0 ≤ 2 * ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) + 1) * R := by positivity
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Fintype.card ι : ℝ), sq_nonneg R,
    mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg R) (sq_nonneg ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) + 1)),
    norm_nonneg ((1 + U)⁻¹ *ᵥ v)]

/-- Every source of a bounded phase cell belongs to a fixed compact original-source set.
The set depends only on the deterministic compliance and cell radius. -/
theorem sub_mulVec_mem_phaseSourceCell
    {U : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hU : U.PosSemidef) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    {z p : ι → ℝ} (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ R) (hp : ‖p‖ ≤ R) :
    z - U *ᵥ p ∈ phaseSourceCell U R := by
  have hlo : ((1 + U) - (1 : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)).PosSemidef := by
    simpa using hU
  have hpos := posDef_of_scalar_identity_lower_bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) hlo
  let _ := hpos.isUnit.invertible
  let y := (1 + U)⁻¹ *ᵥ (z + p) - p
  have hv : ‖z + p‖ ≤ 2 * R := (norm_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith)
  have hy : ‖y‖ ≤ phaseSourceCellRadius ι R := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖(1 + U)⁻¹ *ᵥ (z + p)‖ + ‖p‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ 2 * ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) + 1) * R + R :=
        add_le_add (norm_inverse_mulVec_le_of_identity_lower_bound hU hR hv) hp
      _ = _ := by dsimp [phaseSourceCellRadius]; ring
  refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hy
  · change (1 + U) *ᵥ y = z - U *ᵥ p
    dsimp only [y]
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_inv_of_invertible,
      Matrix.one_mulVec, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    abel

theorem mem_phaseSourceCell_iff {U : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hU : U.PosSemidef)
    (R : ℝ) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    x ∈ phaseSourceCell U R ↔ ‖(1 + U)⁻¹ *ᵥ x‖ ≤ phaseSourceCellRadius ι R := by
  have hlo : ((1 + U) - (1 : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)).PosSemidef := by
    simpa using hU
  have hpos := posDef_of_scalar_identity_lower_bound (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1) hlo
  let _ := hpos.isUnit.invertible
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    change ‖(1 + U)⁻¹ *ᵥ ((1 + U) *ᵥ y)‖ ≤ _
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.inv_mul_of_invertible, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hy
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨(1 + U)⁻¹ *ᵥ x, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hx
    · change (1 + U) *ᵥ ((1 + U)⁻¹ *ᵥ x) = x
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_inv_of_invertible, Matrix.one_mulVec]

theorem legalTwoCycle_momentum_norm_sq_le_of_leg_lower_bounds
    {A₁ B₁ A₂ B₂ : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {h D₀ : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hD₀ : 0 ≤ D₀)
    (hA₁ : (A₁ - h • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)).PosSemidef)
    (hB₁ : (B₁ - h • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)).PosSemidef)
    (hA₂ : (A₂ - h • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)).PosSemidef)
    (hB₂ : (B₂ - h • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)).PosSemidef)
    (p₁ p₂ δ : ι → ℝ)
    (hcycle : matrixQuadratic (A₁ + B₁) p₁ + matrixQuadratic (A₂ + B₂) p₂ ≤
      matrixQuadratic (A₁ + B₂)⁻¹ (δ + A₁ *ᵥ p₁ + B₂ *ᵥ p₂) +
        matrixQuadratic (A₂ + B₁)⁻¹ (-δ + A₂ *ᵥ p₂ + B₁ *ᵥ p₁) + D₀) :
    ‖p₁ - p₂‖ ^ 2 ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / h ^ 2 * ‖δ‖ ^ 2 + 2 * D₀ / h

    (hcover : ∀ᵐ x ∂eta, x ∈ ⋃ j, O j)
    (hQR : eta.map T ≪ R) :
    let C := disjointed O
    let Q := fun j ↦ (eta.restrict (C j)).map T
    let p := fun j ↦ (Q j).rnDeriv R
    let h := fun y ↦ ∑' j, p j y
    Measurable h ∧ R.withDensity h = eta.map T ∧
      (∀ j, R.withDensity (p j) = Q j) ∧
      ∀ j, ∀ Phi : Y → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable Phi →

theorem existsUnique_probabilityMeasure_of_pressure
    {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} [NeBot l]
    (face : ι → Set (ProbabilityMeasure E))
    (value : (E →ᵇ ℝ) → ι → ℝ → ℝ) (pressure : (E →ᵇ ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ)
    (radius derivative : (E →ᵇ ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hne : ∀ᶠ z in l, (face z).Nonempty)
    (hradius : ∀ f, 0 < radius f)
    (hderiv : ∀ f, HasDerivAt (pressure f) (derivative f) 0)
    (hzero : ∀ f, Tendsto (fun z ↦ value f z 0) l (𝓝 (pressure f 0)))
    (hlower : ∀ f t, |t| < radius f →
      Tendsto (fun z ↦ max (pressure f t - value f z t) 0) l (𝓝 0))
    (haffine : ∀ f t, |t| < radius f → ∀ᶠ z in l, ∀ μ ∈ face z,
      value f z t ≤ value f z 0 + t * ∫ x, f x ∂(μ : Measure E)) :
    ∃! ν : ProbabilityMeasure E,
      (∀ f : E →ᵇ ℝ, ∫ x, f x ∂(ν : Measure E) = derivative f) ∧
        Tendsto face l (𝓝 ν).smallSets

theorem existsUnique_probabilityMeasure_row_of_pressure
    {Ω : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, MeasurableSpace (Ω n)]
    (P : ∀ n, Measure (Ω n)) [∀ n, IsProbabilityMeasure (P n)]
    (face : (Σ n, Ω n) → Set (ProbabilityMeasure E))
    (value : (E →ᵇ ℝ) → (Σ n, Ω n) → ℝ → ℝ)
    (pressure : (E →ᵇ ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ) (radius derivative : (E →ᵇ ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hne : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (P n).real {ω | ¬ (face ⟨n, ω⟩).Nonempty}) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hradius : ∀ f, 0 < radius f)
    (hderiv : ∀ f, HasDerivAt (pressure f) (derivative f) 0)
    (hzero : ∀ f ε, 0 < ε → Tendsto
      (fun n ↦ (P n).real {ω | ε ≤ |value f ⟨n, ω⟩ 0 - pressure f 0|}) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hlower : ∀ f t, |t| < radius f → ∀ ε, 0 < ε → Tendsto
      (fun n ↦ (P n).real {ω | ε ≤ max (pressure f t - value f ⟨n, ω⟩ t) 0})
      atTop (𝓝 0))
    (haffine : ∀ f t, |t| < radius f → Tendsto
      (fun n ↦ (P n).real {ω | ¬ ∀ μ ∈ face ⟨n, ω⟩,
        value f ⟨n, ω⟩ t ≤ value f ⟨n, ω⟩ 0 + t * ∫ x, f x ∂(μ : Measure E)})
      atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∃! ν : ProbabilityMeasure E,
      (∀ f : E →ᵇ ℝ, ∫ x, f x ∂(ν : Measure E) = derivative f) ∧
        ∀ U ∈ 𝓝 ν, Tendsto
          (fun n ↦ (P n).real {ω | ∃ μ ∈ face ⟨n, ω⟩, μ ∉ U}) atTop (𝓝 0)

    {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    [MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated Y]
    (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (τ : Measure Y) [SFinite τ]
    (k : Kernel X Y) [IsMarkovKernel k]
    (ν : Measure Y) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {ρ : X → ℝ≥0∞} [IsFiniteMeasure (μ.withDensity ρ)]

    (hmark : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ,
      ((k x).toSignedMeasure - ν.toSignedMeasure).totalVariation univ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal η) :

theorem sum_integral_le_of_shifted_lintegral_sum_le_liminf
    {I : Type*} [Fintype I] {X : I → Type*} {Y : ℕ → Type*}
    [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (X i)] [∀ n, MeasurableSpace (Y n)]
    (ρ : ∀ i, Measure (X i)) [∀ i, IsFiniteMeasure (ρ i)]
    (μ : ∀ n, Measure (Y n)) [∀ n, IsFiniteMeasure (μ n)]
    (f : ∀ i, X i → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, Integrable (f i) (ρ i))
    (g : ∀ n, Y n → ℝ) (hg : ∀ n, Integrable (g n) (μ n))
    (s : ℝ) (_hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hfn : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂ρ i, 0 ≤ f i x+s)
    (hgn : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ y ∂μ n, 0 ≤ g n y+s)
    (mphysical L : ℝ) (hμmass : ∀ n, (μ n).real univ = mphysical)
    (hphysical : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ y, g n y ∂μ n) atTop (𝓝 L))
    (hshift : (∑ i, ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (f i x+s) ∂ρ i) ≤
      liminf (fun n ↦ ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (g n y+s) ∂μ n) atTop) :
    (∑ i, ∫ x, f i x ∂ρ i) ≤ L+s*(mphysical-∑ i, (ρ i).real univ)

    (R : ProbabilityMeasure (CavityLocalScene X Y))
    (Q : ℕ → ProbabilityMeasure (CavityLocalScene X Y))
    (P : ℕ → ℕ → ProbabilityMeasure (CavityLocalScene X Y))
    (φ : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (hφ : ∀ k, Tendsto (φ k) atTop atTop) (ψ : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hinner : ∀ k, Tendsto (fun n ↦ P k (φ k n)) atTop (𝓝 (Q k)))
    (houter : Tendsto (fun l ↦ Q (ψ l)) atTop (𝓝 R))
    (KX : CompactExhaustion X) (KY : CompactExhaustion Y)
    (targetCutoff : (ℕ ⊕ (ℕ × ℕ)) → CompactExhaustion Y)
    (sourceCutoff : (ℕ ⊕ (ℕ × ℕ)) → CompactExhaustion X)
    (hlocal : ∀ᵐ scene ∂(R : Measure (CavityLocalScene X Y)),
      (IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts (scene.1 : Measure (X × Y)).fst ∧
        IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts (scene.2 : Measure (X × Y)).fst) ∧
      (IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts (scene.1 : Measure (X × Y)).snd ∧
        IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts (scene.2 : Measure (X × Y)).snd))
    (sourceTail targetTail : (ℕ ⊕ (ℕ × ℕ)) → ℕ → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hsourceTail : ∀ i, Tendsto (sourceTail i) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (htargetTail : ∀ i, Tendsto (targetTail i) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (sourceDefect targetDefect : (ℕ ⊕ (ℕ × ℕ)) → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hsourceDefect : ∀ i j k, Tendsto (sourceDefect i j k) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (htargetDefect : ∀ i j k, Tendsto (targetDefect i j k) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hsourceBound : ∀ i j k, ∀ᶠ N in atTop,
      (∫⁻ scene : CavityLocalScene X Y,
        ENNReal.ofReal |LocalFiniteMeasure.testIntegral scene.1
          (cavityProductTest (LocalFiniteMeasure.separatingTest KX i)
            (LocalFiniteMeasure.exhaustionCutoff (targetCutoff i) j)) -
          LocalFiniteMeasure.testIntegral scene.2
          (cavityProductTest (LocalFiniteMeasure.separatingTest KX i)
            (LocalFiniteMeasure.exhaustionCutoff (targetCutoff i) j))|
        ∂(P k N : Measure (CavityLocalScene X Y))) ≤ sourceTail i j + sourceDefect i j k N)
    (htargetBound : ∀ i j k, ∀ᶠ N in atTop,
      (∫⁻ scene : CavityLocalScene X Y,

          (cavityProductTest (LocalFiniteMeasure.exhaustionCutoff (sourceCutoff i) j)
            (LocalFiniteMeasure.separatingTest KY i)) -
          LocalFiniteMeasure.testIntegral scene.2
          (cavityProductTest (LocalFiniteMeasure.exhaustionCutoff (sourceCutoff i) j)

/-- An original lower semicontinuous witness keeps only its fixed-core loss
in every positive-level event after the sample and tilt weak limits. -/
theorem measure_lsc_gt_le_of_iterated_weak_sample_tilt_defect_bounds
    (Pn : ℕ → ℕ → ProbabilityMeasure S) (Q : ℕ → ProbabilityMeasure S)
    (R : ProbabilityMeasure S)
    (φ : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (hφ : ∀ k, Tendsto (φ k) atTop atTop)
    (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (hψ : Tendsto ψ atTop atTop)
    (hinner : ∀ k, Tendsto (fun N ↦ Pn k (φ k N)) atTop (𝓝 (Q k)))
    (houter : Tendsto (fun k ↦ Q (ψ k)) atTop (𝓝 R))
    (W : S → ℝ≥0∞) (hW : LowerSemicontinuous W)
    (loss : ℝ≥0∞) (tilt : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (sample : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞)
    (htilt : Tendsto tilt atTop (𝓝 0)) (hsample : Tendsto sample atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hbound : ∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ᶠ N in atTop,
      (∫⁻ s, W s ∂(Pn k N : Measure S)) ≤ tilt k + loss + sample N)
    (r : ℝ≥0∞) (hr : 0 < r) (hrt : r ≠ ⊤) :
    (R : Measure S) {s | r < W s} ≤ loss / r := by
  have hQ : ∀ᶠ k in atTop, (Q k : Measure S) {s | r < W s} ≤ (tilt k + loss) / r := by
    filter_upwards [hbound] with k hk
    have hb : ∀ᶠ N in atTop,

    {M Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace M] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (eta : Measure M) [IsFiniteMeasure eta]
    {a : M → Z} {u : M → ℝ} (ha : Measurable a) (hu : Measurable u)

    (hcover : ∀ᵐ x ∂eta, x ∈ ⋃ j, O j)
    (hjoint : eta.map (fun x ↦ (a x, u x)) ≪ (eta.map a).prod volume)
    (b : Z × ℝ → M) (hb : Measurable b)
    (hbinv : ∀ᵐ x ∂eta, b (a x, u x) = x) :
    let R := (eta.map a).prod (volume : Measure ℝ)

    let p := fun j ↦ ((eta.restrict (C j)).map (fun x ↦ (a x, u x))).rnDeriv R
    let h := fun y ↦ ∑' j, p j y
    Measurable h ∧ R.withDensity h = eta.map (fun x ↦ (a x, u x)) ∧
      (∀ᵐ z ∂eta.map a, ∫⁻ s, h (z, s) ∂volume = 1) ∧
      ∀ g : M → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g →
        (∫⁻ x, g x ∂eta) =
          ∫⁻ z, ∫⁻ s, h (z, s) * g (b (z, s)) ∂volume ∂eta.map a

theorem mk_add_mulVec_sub_mem_markedPhaseSourceCell
    {L : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hL : IsUnit L.det) {U : ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ}
    (hU : ∀ a, (U a).PosSemidef) (c : ℝ → (ι → ℝ))
    {B : Set ℝ} {a R : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ B) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    {z p : ι → ℝ} (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ R) (hp : ‖p‖ ≤ R) :
    (c a + L *ᵥ (z - U a *ᵥ p), a) ∈ markedPhaseSourceCell L U c B R := by
  refine ⟨ha, ?_⟩
  change ‖(1 + U a)⁻¹ *ᵥ (L⁻¹ *ᵥ ((c a + L *ᵥ (z - U a *ᵥ p)) - c a))‖ ≤ _
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec (z - U a *ᵥ p) L⁻¹ L,
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hL, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  exact (mem_phaseSourceCell_iff (hU a) R _).mp (sub_mulVec_mem_phaseSourceCell (hU a) hR hz hp)

/-- Giry-measurable actual locally finite measures are measurable for the proved
vague Borel structure. -/
theorem measurable_localFiniteMeasure_of_measurable_measure
    (π : V → LocalFiniteMeasure X)
    (hπ : Measurable (fun v ↦ (π v : Measure X))) : Measurable π := by
  apply LocalFiniteMeasure.measurable_of_testIntegral
  intro f
  have hpos := (Measure.measurable_lintegral f.continuous.measurable.ennreal_ofReal).comp hπ
  have hneg := (Measure.measurable_lintegral
    f.continuous.measurable.neg.ennreal_ofReal).comp hπ
  have heq (v : V) : LocalFiniteMeasure.testIntegral (π v) f =
      (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ∂(π v : Measure X)).toReal -
        (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (-f x) ∂(π v : Measure X)).toReal :=
    integral_eq_lintegral_pos_part_sub_lintegral_neg_part f.integrable
  simp_rw [heq]
  exact hpos.ennreal_toReal.sub hneg.ennreal_toReal

theorem map_withDensity_measurableEquiv
    {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    (e : X ≃ᵐ Y) (μ : Measure X) (d : X → ℝ≥0∞) :

  ext S hS

    withDensity_apply _ hS, e.measurableEmbedding.restrict_map,
    e.measurableEmbedding.lintegral_map]
  simp only [e.symm_apply_apply]

theorem measure_prod_witness_le_of_add
    (full₀ retained₀ discarded₀ : Measure X)
    (full₁ retained₁ discarded₁ : Measure Y)
    [SFinite full₀] [SFinite retained₀] [SFinite discarded₀]
    [SFinite full₁] [SFinite retained₁] [SFinite discarded₁]

d-24d0afe87f8e3cb6acd346e6.selected_source_excerpt:
/-- Auxiliary retained/lost laws may change with core accuracy while their
original projection stays fixed. Accuracy is taken only after those original
sample and tilt limits, and forces the fixed full readout to vanish. -/
theorem ae_eq_zero_of_projected_retained_zero_and_lost_accuracy
    (R : ProbabilityMeasure Y) (Raux : ℕ → ProbabilityMeasure X)
    (f : X → Y) (hf : Measurable f)
    (hmap : ∀ m, (Raux m).map hf.aemeasurable = R)
    (W : Y → ℝ≥0∞) (hW : Measurable W)
    (retained lost : ℕ → X → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hdom : ∀ m, ∀ᵐ s ∂(Raux m : Measure X), W (f s) ≤ retained m s + lost m s)
    (hretained : ∀ m, ∀ᵐ s ∂(Raux m : Measure X), retained m s = 0)
    (accuracy : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (haccuracy : Tendsto accuracy atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hlost : ∀ (m : ℕ) (level : ℝ≥0∞), 0 < level → level ≠ ⊤ →
      (Raux m : Measure X) {s | level < lost m s} ≤ accuracy m / level) :
    ∀ᵐ y ∂(R : Measure Y), W y = 0 := by
  have hopen (level : ℝ≥0∞) (hl0 : 0 < level) (hlt : level ≠ ⊤) :
      (R : Measure Y) {y | level < W y} = 0 := by
    have hb (m : ℕ) : (R : Measure Y) {y | level < W y} ≤ accuracy m / level := by
      have hm : (Raux m : Measure X).map f = (R : Measure Y) :=
        congrArg (fun p : ProbabilityMeasure Y ↦ (p : Measure Y)) (hmap m)
      rw [← hm, Measure.map_apply hf (measurableSet_lt measurable_const hW)]
      apply (measure_mono_ae ?_).trans (hlost m level hl0 hlt)
      filter_upwards [hdom m, hretained m] with s hs hr hlevel
      have hd : W (f s) ≤ lost m s := by simpa only [hr, zero_add] using hs
      exact hlevel.trans_le hd
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun m ↦ accuracy m / level) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa only [ENNReal.zero_div] using
        ENNReal.Tendsto.div_const haccuracy (Or.inr hl0.ne')
    apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
    calc
      _ = atTop.liminf (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (R : Measure Y) {y | level < W y}) := (liminf_const _).symm
      _ ≤ atTop.liminf (fun m ↦ accuracy m / level) := liminf_le_liminf (Eventually.of_forall hb)

    intro b hb

    have hs : {y | b ≤ W y} ⊆ {y | ((q : ℝ).toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) < W y} :=
      fun _ hy ↦ hqb.trans_le hy

theorem ae_absolutelyContinuous_source_restrict_of_projected_retained_discard
    {S : Type*} [TopologicalSpace S] [MeasurableSpace S] [OpensMeasurableSpace S]
    {A : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, MeasurableSpace (A n)]
    (R : Measure S) (P : ∀ n, Measure (A n))
    (projection : ∀ n, A n → S)
    (hprojection : ∀ n, Measurable (projection n))
    (hmap : ∀ n, (P n).map (projection n) = R)
    (full : S → LocalFiniteMeasure (X × Y)) (hfull : Continuous full)
    (retained : ∀ n, A n → Measure (X × Y))
    (U : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (reference : Measure X)
    (approximant : ℕ → Measure X) [∀ n, (approximant n).OuterRegular]
    (hac : ∀ n, approximant n ≪ reference)
    (discard : ∀ n, A n → ℝ≥0∞) (error loss : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞)
    (herror : Tendsto error atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hloss : Tendsto loss atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hsplit : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ a ∂P n, ∀ B : Set X,
      (full (projection n a) : Measure (X × Y)).fst (B ∩ U) ≤
        (retained n a).fst (B ∩ U) + discard n a)
    (hretained : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ a ∂P n,
      sourceOpenDominationDefectOn (retained n a) U (approximant n) (error n))
    (htail : ∀ n (threshold : ℝ≥0∞), 0 < threshold → threshold ≠ ⊤ →
      P n {a | threshold < discard n a} ≤ loss n / threshold) :
    ∀ᵐ s ∂R, (full s : Measure (X × Y)).fst.restrict U ≪ reference

theorem ae_closed_set_of_physicalScene_weak_tendsto
    {S : Type*} [TopologicalSpace S] [MeasurableSpace S]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace S] [HasOuterApproxClosed S]
    (R : ProbabilityMeasure S) (Pn : ℕ → ProbabilityMeasure S)
    (hweak : Tendsto Pn atTop (𝓝 R)) (K : Set S) (hK : IsClosed K)
    (hmem : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ s ∂(Pn n : Measure S), s ∈ K) :
    ∀ᵐ s ∂(R : Measure S), s ∈ K := by
  have hn : ∀ n, (Pn n : Measure S) Kᶜ = 0 := fun n ↦ hmem n
  have hle := ProbabilityMeasure.le_liminf_measure_open_of_tendsto hweak hK.isOpen_compl
  change (R : Measure S) Kᶜ ≤ atTop.liminf (fun n ↦ (Pn n : Measure S) Kᶜ) at hle
  simp only [hn, liminf_const] at hle
  exact le_antisymm hle bot_le

theorem exists_original_calibrated_coupling_of_clockBinFlow
    {M Z : Type*} [MetricSpace M] [MeasurableSpace M] [BorelSpace M]
    [SecondCountableTopology M] [StandardBorelSpace M] [Nonempty M]
    [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace.CountablySeparated Z] [MeasurableEq Z]
    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    {N : Set M} (hN : MeasurableSet N)
    {a : M → Z} {u : M → ℝ} (ha : Measurable a) (hu : Measurable u)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (fun x : N ↦ (a x.val, u x.val)))
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ N, ∀ y ∈ N,
      (a x = a y ∧ u x ≤ u y) ↔ u y - u x = dist x y)
    (μ ν : Measure M) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμN : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ N) (hνN : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, y ∈ N)
    (hbalance : μ.map a = ν.map a)
    (S : I → Set ℝ) (T : J → Set ℝ)
    (hS : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (S i)) (hT : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (T j))
    (hdS : Pairwise (Disjoint on S)) (hdT : Pairwise (Disjoint on T))
    (hcoverS : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.map a, ∀ᵐ s ∂condDistrib u a μ z, s ∈ ⋃ i, S i)
    (hcoverT : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.map a, ∀ᵐ t ∂condDistrib u a ν z, t ∈ ⋃ j, T j)
    (fallbackS : I → ℝ) (fallbackT : J → ℝ)
    (P : Z → I → J → ℝ) (hmP : ∀ i j, Measurable (fun z ↦ P z i j))
    (hP : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.map a, ∀ i j, 0 ≤ P z i j)
    (hrow : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.map a, ∀ i, ∑ j, P z i j = (condDistrib u a μ z).real (S i))
    (hcol : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.map a, ∀ j, ∑ i, P z i j = (condDistrib u a ν z).real (T j))
    (allowed : I → J → Prop)
    (hzero : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.map a, ∀ i j, ¬ allowed i j → P z i j = 0)
    (hbins : ∀ i j, allowed i j → ∀ s ∈ S i, ∀ t ∈ T j, s ≤ t) :
    let α := fun i ↦ normalizedActualBinKernel (condDistrib u a μ) (S i) (hS i) (fallbackS i)
    let β := fun j ↦ normalizedActualBinKernel (condDistrib u a ν) (T j) (hT j) (fallbackT j)
    ∃ b : Z × ℝ → M, Measurable b ∧
      Vlasov.IsCoupling ((sameLabelPopulationCoupling (μ.map a) P α β).map (Prod.map b b)) μ ν ∧
      (∀ᵐ p ∂(sameLabelPopulationCoupling (μ.map a) P α β).map (Prod.map b b),
        u p.2 - u p.1 = dist p.1 p.2) ∧
      ∀ ξ : Measure ((Z × ℝ) × (Z × ℝ)), ξ ≤ sameLabelPopulationCoupling (μ.map a) P α β →
        ξ.map (Prod.map b b) ≤ (sameLabelPopulationCoupling (μ.map a) P α β).map (Prod.map b b) ∧
        ξ.map (Prod.map b b) univ = ξ univ

theorem integral_maxCardValue_le_sum_block_add_discrepancy
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (Np Nm : Ω → ℕ)
    (blockS : (ω : Ω) → Fin (Np ω) → ι)
    (blockT : (ω : Ω) → Fin (Nm ω) → ι)
    (cost : (ω : Ω) → Fin (Np ω) → Fin (Nm ω) → ℝ)
    {B : ℝ} (hB0 : 0 ≤ B)
    (hB : ∀ ω i j, cost ω i j ≤ B)
    (hV : Integrable (fun ω ↦ PartialMatching.maxCardValue (cost ω)) P)
    (hBlock : ∀ t : ι, Integrable (fun ω ↦ PartialMatching.maxCardValue
      (blockCost (blockS ω) (blockT ω) (cost ω) t)) P)
    (hDisc : Integrable (fun ω ↦ ∑ t,
      |(blockSizeS (blockS ω) t : ℝ) - (blockSizeT (blockT ω) t : ℝ)|) P) :
    ∫ ω, PartialMatching.maxCardValue (cost ω) ∂P ≤
      (∑ t, ∫ ω, PartialMatching.maxCardValue
        (blockCost (blockS ω) (blockT ω) (cost ω) t) ∂P) +
        B * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ ω, ∑ t,
          |(blockSizeS (blockS ω) t : ℝ) - (blockSizeT (blockT ω) t : ℝ)| ∂P)

theorem finiteCellPairKernel_glue
    {C Z : Type*} [Fintype C] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (r : Measure Z) (cell : C → Set Z) (hcell : ∀ c, MeasurableSet (cell c))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (Disjoint on cell))
    (P Q : C → Kernel Z (ℝ × ℝ))
    (γ : Kernel Z (ℝ × ℝ)) (α β : Kernel Z ℝ)
    (hγ : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, Vlasov.IsCoupling (γ z) (α z) (β z) ∧
      ∀ᵐ p ∂γ z, p.1 ≤ p.2)
    (hlocal : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, ∀ c, z ∈ cell c →
      Vlasov.IsCoupling (P c z + Q c z) (α z) (β z) ∧
      ∀ᵐ p ∂P c z + Q c z, p.1 ≤ p.2) :
    let G := ⋃ c, cell c
    let hG : MeasurableSet G := MeasurableSet.iUnion hcell
    let P' := finiteCellPairKernel cell hcell P
    let Q' := finiteCellPairKernel cell hcell Q + cellComplementKernel G hG γ
    ∀ᵐ z ∂r, Vlasov.IsCoupling ((P' + Q') z) (α z) (β z) ∧
      ∀ᵐ p ∂(P' + Q') z, p.1 ≤ p.2

theorem finiteCellPairKernel_residual_mass_le
    {C Z : Type*} [Fintype C] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (r : Measure Z) [IsProbabilityMeasure r]
    (cell : C → Set Z) (hcell : ∀ c, MeasurableSet (cell c))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (Disjoint on cell))
    (Q : C → Kernel Z (ℝ × ℝ)) [∀ c, IsSFiniteKernel (Q c)]
    (γ : Kernel Z (ℝ × ℝ)) [IsMarkovKernel γ]
    (B : ℝ) (hmass : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, ∀ c, z ∈ cell c → Q c z univ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B) :
    let G := ⋃ c, cell c
    let hG : MeasurableSet G := MeasurableSet.iUnion hcell
    let Q' := finiteCellPairKernel cell hcell Q + cellComplementKernel G hG γ
    (r ⊗ₘ Q') univ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B + r Gᶜ

theorem exists_original_cellwise_residual_population
    {X Z C : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [SecondCountableTopology X] [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
    [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace.CountablySeparated Z] [MeasurableEq Z]
    [Fintype C] {N : Set X} (hN : MeasurableSet N)
    {a : X → Z} {u : X → ℝ} (ha : Measurable a) (hu : Measurable u)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (fun x : N ↦ (a x.val, u x.val)))
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ N, ∀ y ∈ N,
      (a x = a y ∧ u x ≤ u y) ↔ u y - u x = dist x y)
    (μ ν : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (hμN : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ N) (hνN : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, y ∈ N)
    (π : Measure (X × X)) (hπ : Vlasov.IsCoupling π μ ν)
    (hlabel : ∀ᵐ p ∂π, a p.1 = a p.2)
    (hforward : ∀ᵐ p ∂π, u p.1 ≤ u p.2)
    (cell : C → Set Z) (hcell : ∀ c, MeasurableSet (cell c))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (Disjoint on cell))
    (P Q : C → Kernel Z (ℝ × ℝ))
    [∀ c, IsSFiniteKernel (P c)] [∀ c, IsSFiniteKernel (Q c)]
    (hlocal : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.map a, ∀ c, z ∈ cell c →
      Vlasov.IsCoupling (P c z + Q c z) (condDistrib u a μ z) (condDistrib u a ν z) ∧
      ∀ᵐ p ∂P c z + Q c z, p.1 ≤ p.2)
    (B : ℝ) (hmass : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.map a, ∀ c, z ∈ cell c → Q c z univ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B) :
    let χ := ((μ.map a) ⊗ₘ finiteCellPairKernel cell hcell P).map sameLabelPopulationPair
    ∃ (b : Z × ℝ → X) (ξ : Measure (X × X)), Measurable b ∧
      Vlasov.IsCoupling (χ.map (Prod.map b b) + ξ) μ ν ∧
      (∀ᵐ p ∂χ.map (Prod.map b b) + ξ, u p.2 - u p.1 = dist p.1 p.2) ∧
      ξ ≤ χ.map (Prod.map b b) + ξ ∧
      ξ univ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B + (μ.map a) (⋃ c, cell c)ᶜ

    (γ₀ : Measure (X × X)) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ₀]
    (γ₁ : Measure (Y × Y)) [IsProbabilityMeasure γ₁]
    (μ₀ μ₁ : Measure X) (ν₀ ν₁ : Measure Y)
    (hμ₀ : γ₀.map Prod.fst = μ₀) (hμ₁ : γ₀.map Prod.snd = μ₁)

        (Measure.pi (fun _ : I ↦ μ₀)).prod (Measure.pi (fun _ : I ↦ ν₀)) ∧
    Ω.map (fun p ↦ (fun i ↦ (p.1 i).2, fun i ↦ (p.2 i).2)) =
        (Measure.pi (fun _ : I ↦ μ₁)).prod (Measure.pi (fun _ : I ↦ ν₁))

    {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (hε : ε ≠ 0) :

theorem hittingAfter_zero_lt_set_eq_iUnion_rat
    [TopologicalSpace β] {u : ℝ≥0 → Ω → β} {s : Set β}
    (hcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun t ↦ u t ω) (hs : IsOpen s) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    {ω | MeasureTheory.hittingAfter u s 0 ω < (t : WithTop ℝ≥0)} =
      ⋃ q : ℚ, if Real.toNNReal (q : ℝ) < t then
        {ω | u (Real.toNNReal (q : ℝ)) ω ∈ s} else ∅

    (F : Filtration NNReal (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace Omega))
    {mu nu : @Measure (NNReal × Omega) F.predictable}
    [IsFiniteMeasure mu]
    (T : NNReal) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hmu_support : mu = mu.restrict (finiteHorizon (Omega := Omega) T))
    (hnu_support : nu = nu.restrict (finiteHorizon (Omega := Omega) T))
    (hrect : ∀ s : NNReal, s < T → ∀ A : Set Omega,

    mu = nu

theorem jumpTime_lt_iff_lt_countBefore
    {N : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℕ} {ω : Ω} {k : ℕ} {s T : ℝ≥0}
    (hmono : Monotone fun t ↦ N t ω)

    (hinj : Set.InjOn (fun j ↦ jumpTime N j ω) (Iio (N T ω)))

theorem countingExponential_pow_exp (N : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℕ) (Λ : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (θ₀ : ℝ)
    (t : ℝ≥0) (ω : Ω)

theorem integratedIntensity_add_Ioc {Λ H : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ} {ω : Ω} {w v u : ℝ≥0}
    (hwv : w ≤ v) (hvu : v ≤ u)
    (hHI : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ ↦ H (Real.toNNReal x) ω * Λ (Real.toNNReal x) ω)
      volume 0 (u : ℝ)) :
    integratedIntensity Λ H u ω = integratedIntensity Λ H w ω +
        ∫ s in Ioc w v, H s ω * Λ s ω ∂timeMeasure +
        ∫ s in Ioc v u, H s ω * Λ s ω ∂timeMeasure

theorem expWeight_integral_Ioc {Λ : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ} {N : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℕ} {ω : Ω} {θ₀ : ℝ}
    {u v : ℝ≥0} {m : ℕ} (hθ0 : 0 < θ₀) (huv : u ≤ v)
    (hcount : ∀ s ∈ Ioc u v, countBefore N s ω = m)
    (hΛint : IntegrableOn (fun s ↦ Λ s ω) (Ioc (0 : ℝ≥0) v) timeMeasure) :
    ∫ s in Ioc u v, expWeight N Λ θ₀ s ω * Λ s ω ∂timeMeasure =
      -(Real.exp (-θ₀) ^ m) *
        (Real.exp ((1 - Real.exp (-θ₀)) *
            integratedIntensity Λ (fun _ _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) v ω) -
          Real.exp ((1 - Real.exp (-θ₀)) *
            integratedIntensity Λ (fun _ _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) u ω))

theorem countBefore_jumpTime {N : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℕ} {ω : Ω} {k : ℕ} {t : ℝ≥0}
    (hmono : Monotone fun t ↦ N t ω)
    (hrc : ∀ t, ContinuousWithinAt (fun s ↦ (N s ω : ℝ)) (Ici t) t)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (fun j ↦ jumpTime N j ω) (Iio (N t ω))) (hk : k < N t ω) :
    countBefore N (jumpTime N k ω) ω = k

theorem countingExponential_path_identity {μ : Measure Ω} {ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›}
    {N : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℕ} {Λ : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ} {θ₀ C₀ : ℝ} {T t : ℝ≥0}
    (hθ0 : 0 < θ₀) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) (hΛupper : ∀ s ω, Λ s ω ≤ C₀)
    (hN : IsSimpleCountingProcess ℱ N) (hΛ : HasPredictableIntensity μ ℱ N Λ)
    (htT : t ≤ T) (ω : Ω) :
    countingExponential N Λ (fun _ _ ↦ -θ₀) t ω =
      1 + compensatedIntegral N Λ
        (fun s ω' ↦ if s ≤ T then expWeight N Λ θ₀ s ω' else 0) t ω

d-367c2e0ec2a31d043d2f7457.name: OTSelector.CountingProcess.martingale_of_all_setIntegral_eq
d-367c2e0ec2a31d043d2f7457.declaration_documentation: Set-integral extension lemma. Suppose `M` is strongly adapted and integrable, and for every deterministic pair `i ≤ j` its increment has zero integral on every finite `ℱ i`-measurable event. Then `M` is a martingale. This is the exact conditional-expectation uniqueness layer needed after a genuine rectangle (or random-measure) argument has produced section identities. The assumptions are low-level facts: adaptedness, integrability, and set-integral equalities. In particular, no packaged assumption or universal martingale property is assumed.

theorem martingale_of_all_setIntegral_eq
    {μ : Measure Ω} {ℱ : Filtration ℝ≥0 ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›}
    [SigmaFiniteFiltration μ ℱ]
    {M : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ}
    (hAdapted : StronglyAdapted ℱ M)
    (hIntegrable : ∀ i, Integrable (M i) μ)
    (hSetIntegral : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → ∀ B : Set Ω, MeasurableSet[ℱ i] B → μ B < ∞ →
      ∫ ω in B, M j ω ∂μ = ∫ ω in B, M i ω ∂μ) :
    Martingale M ℱ μ

    Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ s, obs s ∂(P n : Measure S)) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ s, obs s ∂(Q : Measure S))) ∧

theorem exists_good_bad_samples_with_constraints_of_frequently
    (P : ∀ n, Measure (Ω n)) [∀ n, IsProbabilityMeasure (P n)]
    (good bad : ∀ n, Set (Ω n)) (constraint : ∀ _m n : ℕ, Set (Ω n))
    (residual : ∀ _m n : ℕ, Ω n → ℝ) (weight : ℕ → ℝ)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hbad : ∃ᶠ n in atTop, δ ≤ (P n).real (bad n))
    (hgood : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, (P n).real (good n)ᶜ ≤ δ / 4)
    (hweight : ∀ j, ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), weight m ≤ δ / 4)
    (hconstraint : ∀ m, ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      (P n).real (good n ∩ (constraint m n)ᶜ) ≤ weight m)
    (hres : ∀ m ε, 0 < ε → Tendsto
      (fun n ↦ (P n).real (good n ∩ {ω | ε < |residual m n ω|})) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∃ sample : ∀ j, Ω (φ j),
      (∀ j, sample j ∈ good (φ j) ∧ sample j ∈ bad (φ j)) ∧
      (∀ m, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, sample j ∈ constraint m (φ j)) ∧
      ∀ m, Tendsto (fun j ↦ residual m (φ j) (sample j)) atTop (𝓝 0)

theorem integral_iid_coordinate_mul (ν : Measure S) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {f : S → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) (i j : I) :
    (∫ y : I → S, f (y i) * f (y j) ∂Measure.pi (fun _ ↦ ν)) =
      (∫ x, f x ∂ν) ^ 2 +
        if i = j then (∫ x, (f x) ^ 2 ∂ν) - (∫ x, f x ∂ν) ^ 2 else 0

theorem integral_iid_weighted_sum_sq (ν : Measure S) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {f : S → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hbound : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ B) (w : I → ℝ) :
    (∫ y : I → S, (∑ i, w i * f (y i)) ^ 2 ∂Measure.pi (fun _ ↦ ν)) =
      (∫ x, f x ∂ν) ^ 2 * (∑ i, w i) ^ 2 +

theorem exists_tendsto_subseq_original_triple_of_marginals
    {X Y Z : Type*} {Ω : ℕ → Type*}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [T2Space X] [PseudoMetrizableSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X]
    [TopologicalSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y]
    [T2Space Y] [PseudoMetrizableSpace Y] [SecondCountableTopology Y]
    [TopologicalSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z]
    [T2Space Z] [PseudoMetrizableSpace Z] [SecondCountableTopology Z]
    [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (Ω i)]
    (P : ∀ i, Measure (Ω i)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (P i)]
    (f : ∀ i, Ω i → X) (g : ∀ i, Ω i → Y) (h : ∀ i, Ω i → Z)
    (hf : ∀ i, Measurable (f i)) (hg : ∀ i, Measurable (g i))
    (hh : ∀ i, Measurable (h i))
    (hft : IsTightMeasureSet (range (fun i ↦ (P i).map (f i))))
    (hgt : IsTightMeasureSet (range (fun i ↦ (P i).map (g i))))
    (hht : IsTightMeasureSet (range (fun i ↦ (P i).map (h i)))) :
    let laws : ℕ → ProbabilityMeasure (X × Y × Z) := fun i ↦
      ProbabilityMeasure.map (⟨P i, inferInstance⟩ : ProbabilityMeasure (Ω i))
        (f := fun ω ↦ (f i ω, g i ω, h i ω))
        ((hf i).prodMk ((hg i).prodMk (hh i))).aemeasurable
    ∃ Q : ProbabilityMeasure (X × Y × Z), ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ,
      StrictMono φ ∧ Tendsto (laws ∘ φ) atTop (𝓝 Q)

theorem originalClassFlow_glue_marginals
    {I J Z : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (r : Measure Z) (G : Set Z) (allowed : I → J → Prop)
    (A P Q : Z → I → J → ℝ) (a : Z → I → ℝ) (b : Z → J → ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ᵐ z ∂r,
      (∀ i j, 0 ≤ A z i j) ∧ (∀ i, ∑ j, A z i j = a z i) ∧
      (∀ j, ∑ i, A z i j = b z j) ∧ ∀ i j, ¬ allowed i j → A z i j = 0)
    (hPQ : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, z ∈ G →
      (∀ i j, 0 ≤ P z i j) ∧ (∀ i j, 0 ≤ Q z i j) ∧
      (∀ i, ∑ j, (P z i j + Q z i j) = a z i) ∧
      (∀ j, ∑ i, (P z i j + Q z i j) = b z j) ∧
      ∀ i j, ¬ allowed i j → P z i j = 0 ∧ Q z i j = 0) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂r,
      (∀ i j, 0 ≤ retainedClassFlowOn G P z i j) ∧
      (∀ i j, 0 ≤ residualClassFlowOn G A Q z i j) ∧
      (∀ i, ∑ j, (retainedClassFlowOn G P z i j + residualClassFlowOn G A Q z i j) = a z i) ∧
      (∀ j, ∑ i, (retainedClassFlowOn G P z i j + residualClassFlowOn G A Q z i j) = b z j) ∧
      ∀ i j, ¬ allowed i j →
        retainedClassFlowOn G P z i j + residualClassFlowOn G A Q z i j = 0

theorem originalClassFlow_glue_residual_mass_le
    {I J Z X Y : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    (r : Measure Z) [SFinite r] (G : Set Z) (hG : MeasurableSet G)
    (A Q : Z → I → J → ℝ)
    (hmA : ∀ i j, Measurable (fun z ↦ A z i j))
    (hmQ : ∀ i j, Measurable (fun z ↦ Q z i j))
    (α : I → Kernel Z X) (β : J → Kernel Z Y)
    [∀ i, IsMarkovKernel (α i)] [∀ j, IsMarkovKernel (β j)]
    (hA : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A z i j)
    (hQ : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, z ∈ G → ∀ i j, 0 ≤ Q z i j)
    (d : Z → ℝ) (hmassA : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, (∑ i, ∑ j, A z i j) = d z)
    (B : ℝ) (hmassQ : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, z ∈ G → (∑ i, ∑ j, Q z i j) ≤ B) :

theorem integral_le_relative_of_pairedCloud_repair (m n : ℕ)
    (γs : Measure (X × X)) (γt : Measure (Y × Y))
    [IsProbabilityMeasure γs] [IsProbabilityMeasure γt]
    (μs νs : Measure X) (μt νt : Measure Y)
    (hs₀ : γs.map Prod.fst = μs) (hs₁ : γs.map Prod.snd = νs)
    (ht₀ : γt.map Prod.fst = μt) (ht₁ : γt.map Prod.snd = νt)
    (F F' : ((Fin m → X) × (Fin n → Y)) → ℝ)
    (R : ((Fin m → X × X) × (Fin n → Y × Y)) → ℝ)
    {ρ K δs δt : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hδs : 0 ≤ δs) (hδt : 0 ≤ δt)
    (hFs : Measurable F) (hFt : Measurable F')
    (hF : Integrable F ((Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m ↦ μs).prod
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n ↦ μt)))
    (hF' : Integrable F' ((Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m ↦ νs).prod
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n ↦ νt)))
    (hR : Integrable R (pairedCloudLaw m n γs γt))
    (hbs : γs {p | p.1 ≠ p.2} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δs)
    (hbt : γt {p | p.1 ≠ p.2} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δt)
    (hpoint : ∀ᵐ z ∂(pairedCloudLaw m n γs γt),
      F (pairedCloudProj m n true z) ≤
        (1 + ρ) * F' (pairedCloudProj m n false z) + ρ * K * (min m n : ℝ) +
          R z + 2 * K * (diffCount m z.1 + diffCount n z.2)) :
    ∫ z, F z ∂((Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m ↦ μs).prod
        (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n ↦ μt)) ≤
      (1 + ρ) * (∫ z, F' z ∂((Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m ↦ νs).prod
        (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n ↦ νt))) + ρ * K * (min m n : ℝ) +
        (∫ z, R z ∂(pairedCloudLaw m n γs γt)) +
        2 * K * ((m : ℝ) * δs + (n : ℝ) * δt)

theorem originalShapeHolePoisson_count_moments {q : ℕ} (hq : 4 < q) (a : ℝ≥0) (K : ℕ) :
    let P := (poissonMeasure a).prod (poissonMeasure a)
    Integrable (fun z : ℕ × ℕ ↦ ((min z.1 z.2 : ℕ) : ℝ)^(1-2/(q : ℝ))) P ∧
    (∫ z : ℕ × ℕ, ((min z.1 z.2 : ℕ) : ℝ)^(1-2/(q : ℝ)) ∂P) ≤ (a : ℝ)^(1-2/(q : ℝ)) ∧
    Integrable (fun z : ℕ × ℕ ↦ Real.sqrt (2*((min z.1 z.2 : ℕ) : ℝ)*K)) P ∧
    (∫ z : ℕ × ℕ, Real.sqrt (2*((min z.1 z.2 : ℕ) : ℝ)*K) ∂P) ≤ Real.sqrt (2*(a : ℝ)*K) ∧
    Integrable (fun z : ℕ × ℕ ↦ |(z.1 : ℝ)-z.2|) P ∧
    (∫ z : ℕ × ℕ, |(z.1 : ℝ)-z.2| ∂P) ≤ Real.sqrt (2*(a : ℝ))

private theorem restrict_box_factor {Ω E : Type} [MeasurableSpace E] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {K : ℕ → Ω → ℕ} {X : ℕ → ℕ → Ω → E} {m : Measure E} [SigmaFinite m] [Nonempty E]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hd : IsPoissonPointFamily K X m μ)
    {A B : Set E} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : MeasurableSet B) (hdisj : Disjoint A B)
    {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    {a : ι → Set E} (ha : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (a i)) (hafin : ∀ i, (m.restrict A) (a i) < ⊤)
    {C : ι → Set ℝ≥0∞} (hC : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (C i))
    {b : κ → Set E} (hb : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (b j)) (hbfin : ∀ j, (m.restrict B) (b j) < ⊤)
    {D : κ → Set ℝ≥0∞} (hD : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (D j)) :
    μ ((fun ω => (poissonRandomMeasure K X ω).restrict A) ⁻¹'
          {ν : Measure E | ∀ i, ν (a i) ∈ C i} ∩
        (fun ω => (poissonRandomMeasure K X ω).restrict B) ⁻¹'
          {ν : Measure E | ∀ j, ν (b j) ∈ D j}) =
      μ ((fun ω => (poissonRandomMeasure K X ω).restrict A) ⁻¹'
          {ν : Measure E | ∀ i, ν (a i) ∈ C i}) *
        μ ((fun ω => (poissonRandomMeasure K X ω).restrict B) ⁻¹'
          {ν : Measure E | ∀ j, ν (b j) ∈ D j})

theorem ae_originalPositiveRetainedPairKernel_lost_mass_law
    (lambda : Measure Z) (χ : ℕ → Kernel Z (ℝ × ℝ))
    [∀ n z, IsFiniteMeasure (χ n z)] (γ : Kernel Z (ℝ × ℝ)) [IsMarkovKernel γ]
    (hχ : ∀ᵐ z ∂lambda, ∀ n, χ n z ≤ γ z)
    (hmass : ∀ᵐ z ∂lambda, Tendsto (fun n ↦ (χ n z).real univ) atTop (𝓝 1)) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂lambda,
      (∀ n, originalPositiveRetainedPairKernel (χ n) γ z ≤ γ z) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n ↦ 1 - (originalPositiveRetainedPairKernel (χ n) γ z).real univ)
        atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ n, 0 ≤ 1 - (originalPositiveRetainedPairKernel (χ n) γ z).real univ ∧
        1 - (originalPositiveRetainedPairKernel (χ n) γ z).real univ < 1 ∧
        1 - (1 - (originalPositiveRetainedPairKernel (χ n) γ z).real univ) ≤
          (originalPositiveRetainedPairKernel (χ n) γ z).real univ

    (A : Finset (SampleVector m)) (a : ↑A) :
    (a : SampleVector m) =

theorem regularBirth_sceneEvent_traffic_level_norm
    {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) (bands : Finset ι)
    (Small Bad : ι → Set Ω) (T : ι → Ω → ℝ)
    (hgood : ∀ i ∈ bands, MemLp (((Small i)ᶜ ∪ Bad i)ᶜ.indicator (T i)) 2 P)
    (hbad : ∀ i ∈ bands, MemLp ((Bad i).indicator ((Small i).indicator (T i))) 2 P)
    (v : ι → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i, 0 ≤ v i)
    {E C s H B c K : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hNs : (bands.card : ℝ) * s ≤ H)
    (hV : (∑ i ∈ bands, v i) ≤ E)
    (hmean : ∀ i ∈ bands,
      (∫ x, (((Small i)ᶜ ∪ Bad i)ᶜ.indicator (T i) x) ^ 2 ∂P) ≤ C * s ^ 2 * v i)
    (hbadNorm : ∀ i ∈ bands,
      eLpNorm ((Bad i).indicator ((Small i).indicator (T i))) 2 P ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (B * Real.exp (-c * K))) :
    MemLp (fun x ↦ ∑ i ∈ bands, (Small i).indicator (T i) x) 2 P ∧
      eLpNorm (fun x ↦ ∑ i ∈ bands, (Small i).indicator (T i) x) 2 P ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt H * Real.sqrt C * Real.sqrt E * Real.sqrt s +
          (bands.card : ℝ) * (B * Real.exp (-c * K)))

    {X Z W : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace W]
    [MeasurableEq Z] (μ ν : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (lambda : Measure Z) [SFinite lambda]
    (a : X → Z) (u : X → ℝ) (ha : Measurable a) (hu : Measurable u)
    (b : Z × ℝ → X) (hb : Measurable b)

    (hνinv : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, b (a y, u y) = y)

    {L : Set Z} (K : Kernel Z (ℝ × ℝ)) [IsSFiniteKernel K]
    (hmarginals : ∀ᵐ z ∂lambda.restrict L,
      (K z).map Prod.fst ≤ condDistrib u a μ z ∧ (K z).map Prod.snd ≤ condDistrib u a ν z)
    (R : Z → W) (hR : Measurable R) :
    ((((lambda.restrict L ⊗ₘ K).map sameLabelPopulationPair).map (Prod.map b b)).map
      (Prod.map (fun x ↦ (R (a x), u x)) (fun y ↦ (R (a y), u y)))) =
      ((lambda.restrict L ⊗ₘ K).map (Prod.map R id)).map sameLabelPopulationPair

theorem exists_original_retained_pair_sampling
    {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [MeasurableEq X] [MeasurableEq Y]
    (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (ν : Measure Y) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (π χ : Measure (X × Y)) [IsFiniteMeasure π]
    (hπ : Vlasov.IsCoupling π μ ν) (hχ : χ ≤ π) (hpos : 0 < χ.real univ) :
    ∃ κS : ProbabilityMeasure (X × X), ∃ κT : ProbabilityMeasure (Y × Y),
      (κS : Measure (X × X)).map Prod.fst = μ ∧
      (κS : Measure (X × X)).map Prod.snd = (normalizedFiniteLaw χ).map Prod.fst ∧
      (κT : Measure (Y × Y)).map Prod.fst = ν ∧
      (κT : Measure (Y × Y)).map Prod.snd = (normalizedFiniteLaw χ).map Prod.snd ∧
      (κS : Measure (X × X)) {p | p.1 ≠ p.2} ≤ (π - χ) univ ∧
      (κT : Measure (Y × Y)) {p | p.1 ≠ p.2} ≤ (π - χ) univ

    [MeasurableSpace (Option T)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (Option T)]
    {Z : I → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (Z i)]
    (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (m : T → Measure X) [∀ t, IsFiniteMeasure (m t)]
    (assignment : I → Option T) (a : ∀ i, X → Z i) (ha : ∀ i, Measurable (a i))
    (hpos : ∀ i, finiteRNMarkComponent μ m (assignment i) univ ≠ 0) :
    let P := Measure.pi (fun _ : I ↦ finiteRNMarkLaw μ m)
    let E := univ.pi (fun i ↦ Prod.snd ⁻¹' {assignment i})

      Measure.pi (fun i ↦ (finiteRNMarkComponent μ m (assignment i) univ)⁻¹ •
        (finiteRNMarkComponent μ m (assignment i)).map (a i))

theorem iid_normalized_label_laws {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    {Z : I → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (Z i)]
    (hπ : Vlasov.IsCoupling π μ ν) (assignment : I → Option T)
    (a : ∀ i, X → Z i) (b : ∀ i, Y → Z i)
    (ha : ∀ i, Measurable (a i)) (hb : ∀ i, Measurable (b i))
    (hroot : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ p ∂π, a i p.1 = b i p.2)
    (hpos : ∀ i, D.completed (assignment i) univ ≠ 0) :
    let Ps := Measure.pi (fun _ : I ↦ D.sourceMarkedLaw μ)
    let Pt := Measure.pi (fun _ : I ↦ D.targetMarkedLaw ν)
    let Es := univ.pi (fun i ↦ Prod.snd ⁻¹' {assignment i})
    let Et := univ.pi (fun i ↦ Prod.snd ⁻¹' {assignment i})
    let L := Measure.pi (fun i ↦ (D.completed (assignment i) univ)⁻¹ •
      (D.completed (assignment i)).map (fun p ↦ a i p.1))
    ((Ps Es)⁻¹ • Ps.restrict Es).map (fun x i ↦ a i (x i).1) = L ∧
      ((Pt Et)⁻¹ • Pt.restrict Et).map (fun y i ↦ b i (y i).1) = L

/-- **Rational selection.**  Every component of an open subset of the real line
contains a rational number, and the component of that rational is the whole
component.  This is the topological content of the paper's rational curve codes
`eq:intrinsic-active-marker`. -/
theorem exists_rat_connectedComponentIn_eq {U : Set ℝ} (hU : IsOpen U) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ U) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, ((q : ℝ) ∈ connectedComponentIn U x) ∧
      connectedComponentIn U (q : ℝ) = connectedComponentIn U x := by
  have hnon : (connectedComponentIn U x).Nonempty := ⟨x, mem_connectedComponentIn hx⟩
  have hopen : IsOpen (connectedComponentIn U x) := hU.connectedComponentIn
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Rat.denseRange_cast.exists_mem_open hopen hnon
  exact ⟨q, hq, (connectedComponentIn_eq hq).symm⟩

d-e182372b8d9c82a139fcf0ca.name: OTSelector.Reconstruction.exists_component_cover_of_rational_codes
d-e182372b8d9c82a139fcf0ca.selected_source_excerpt:
/-- **Rational-code cover.**  The rational curve codes of the minimal-arc
transport: if a rational code map selects, for every active point `r`, a
rational number in the component of `r`, then the components of the rational
codes cover the active set.  No enumeration of the components is needed: the
index set is `ℚ` itself, which is exactly what the minimal-arc transport
provides. -/
theorem exists_component_cover_of_rational_codes {U : Set ℝ} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (c : ℝ → ℚ) (hc : ∀ r : ℝ, r ∈ U → (c r : ℝ) ∈ connectedComponentIn U r) :
    ∃ comp : ℚ → Set ℝ,
      (∀ q : ℚ, comp q = ∅ ∨ ∃ x : ℝ, x ∈ U ∧
        comp q = connectedComponentIn U x) ∧
      (∀ r : ℝ, r ∈ U → ∃ q : ℚ, r ∈ comp q) := by
  classical
  let comp : ℚ → Set ℝ :=
    fun q => if (q : ℝ) ∈ U then connectedComponentIn U (q : ℝ) else ∅
  have hcomp_pos : ∀ q : ℚ, (q : ℝ) ∈ U →
      comp q = connectedComponentIn U (q : ℝ) := by
    intro q hq
    simp only [comp]
    rw [if_pos hq]
  refine ⟨comp, fun q => ?_, fun r hr => ?_⟩
  · by_cases hq : (q : ℝ) ∈ U
    · exact Or.inr ⟨(q : ℝ), hq, hcomp_pos q hq⟩
    · refine Or.inl ?_
      simp only [comp]
      rw [if_neg hq]
  · refine ⟨c r, ?_⟩
    have hqU : ((c r : ℚ) : ℝ) ∈ U :=
      connectedComponentIn_subset U r (hc r hr)
    rw [hcomp_pos (c r) hqU]
    rw [← connectedComponentIn_eq (hc r hr)]
    exact mem_connectedComponentIn hr

        comp q = connectedComponentIn U x) ∧

    rw [← interior_Icc]
    exact mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr hab
  exact ⟨a, b, ht.1, ht.2, hsub⟩

theorem exists_original_calibrated_coupling_of_labelClock
    {M Z : Type*} [MetricSpace M] [MeasurableSpace M] [BorelSpace M]
    [SecondCountableTopology M] [StandardBorelSpace M] [Nonempty M] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    [MeasurableSpace.CountablySeparated Z] [MeasurableEq Z]
    {N : Set M} (hN : MeasurableSet N)
    {a : M → Z} {u : M → ℝ} (ha : Measurable a) (hu : Measurable u)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (fun x : N ↦ (a x.val, u x.val)))
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ N, ∀ y ∈ N,
      (a x = a y ∧ u x ≤ u y) ↔ u y - u x = dist x y)
    (μ ν : Measure M) (hμN : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ N) (hνN : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, y ∈ N)
    (Λ : Measure ((Z × ℝ) × (Z × ℝ)))
    (hΛ : Vlasov.IsCoupling Λ (μ.map (fun x ↦ (a x, u x)))
      (ν.map (fun y ↦ (a y, u y))))
    (hforward : ∀ᵐ p ∂Λ, p.1.1 = p.2.1 ∧ p.1.2 ≤ p.2.2) :
    ∃ b : Z × ℝ → M, Measurable b ∧
      Vlasov.IsCoupling (Λ.map (Prod.map b b)) μ ν ∧
      (∀ᵐ p ∂Λ.map (Prod.map b b), u p.2 - u p.1 = dist p.1 p.2) ∧
      ∀ ξ : Measure ((Z × ℝ) × (Z × ℝ)), ξ ≤ Λ →
        ξ.map (Prod.map b b) ≤ Λ.map (Prod.map b b) ∧
        ξ.map (Prod.map b b) Set.univ = ξ Set.univ

theorem exists_original_calibrated_coupling_of_classFlow
    {M Z : Type*} [MetricSpace M] [MeasurableSpace M] [BorelSpace M]
    [SecondCountableTopology M] [StandardBorelSpace M] [Nonempty M]
    [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace.CountablySeparated Z] [MeasurableEq Z]
    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    {N : Set M} (hN : MeasurableSet N)
    {a : M → Z} {u : M → ℝ} (ha : Measurable a) (hu : Measurable u)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (fun x : N ↦ (a x.val, u x.val)))
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ N, ∀ y ∈ N,
      (a x = a y ∧ u x ≤ u y) ↔ u y - u x = dist x y)
    (μ ν : Measure M) (hμN : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ N) (hνN : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, y ∈ N)
    (r : Measure Z) [SFinite r]
    (P : Z → I → J → ℝ) (asrc : Z → I → ℝ) (btgt : Z → J → ℝ)
    (hmP : ∀ i j, Measurable (fun z ↦ P z i j))
    (hma : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z ↦ asrc z i))
    (hmb : ∀ j, Measurable (fun z ↦ btgt z j))
    (α : I → Kernel Z ℝ) (β : J → Kernel Z ℝ)
    [∀ i, IsMarkovKernel (α i)] [∀ j, IsMarkovKernel (β j)]
    (hP : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, ∀ i j, 0 ≤ P z i j)
    (hrow : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, ∀ i, ∑ j, P z i j = asrc z i)
    (hcol : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, ∀ j, ∑ i, P z i j = btgt z j)
    (hsource : r ⊗ₘ finiteClassMarginalKernel asrc α = μ.map (fun x ↦ (a x, u x)))
    (htarget : r ⊗ₘ finiteClassMarginalKernel btgt β = ν.map (fun y ↦ (a y, u y)))
    (allowed : I → J → Prop)
    (hzero : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, ∀ i j, ¬ allowed i j → P z i j = 0)
    (hbinlegal : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, ∀ i j, allowed i j →
      ∀ᵐ p ∂(α i z).prod (β j z), p.1 ≤ p.2) :
    ∃ b : Z × ℝ → M, Measurable b ∧
      Vlasov.IsCoupling ((sameLabelPopulationCoupling r P α β).map (Prod.map b b)) μ ν ∧
      (∀ᵐ p ∂(sameLabelPopulationCoupling r P α β).map (Prod.map b b),
        u p.2 - u p.1 = dist p.1 p.2) ∧
      ∀ ξ : Measure ((Z × ℝ) × (Z × ℝ)), ξ ≤ sameLabelPopulationCoupling r P α β →
        ξ.map (Prod.map b b) ≤ (sameLabelPopulationCoupling r P α β).map (Prod.map b b) ∧
        ξ.map (Prod.map b b) Set.univ = ξ Set.univ

theorem original_classFlow_residual_subplan
    {M Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace M] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (r : Measure Z) [SFinite r] (P Q : Z → I → J → ℝ)
    (hmP : ∀ i j, Measurable (fun z ↦ P z i j))
    (hmQ : ∀ i j, Measurable (fun z ↦ Q z i j))
    (α : I → Kernel Z ℝ) (β : J → Kernel Z ℝ)
    [∀ i, IsMarkovKernel (α i)] [∀ j, IsMarkovKernel (β j)]
    (hP : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, ∀ i j, 0 ≤ P z i j)
    (hQ : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, ∀ i j, 0 ≤ Q z i j)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, (∑ i, ∑ j, Q z i j) ≤ B)
    (b : Z × ℝ → M) (hb : Measurable b) :
    ((sameLabelPopulationCoupling r Q α β).map (Prod.map b b) ≤
      (sameLabelPopulationCoupling r (fun z i j ↦ P z i j + Q z i j) α β).map (Prod.map b b)) ∧
    ((sameLabelPopulationCoupling r Q α β).map (Prod.map b b) univ ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal B * r univ)

theorem exists_original_calibrated_coupling_of_positive_classFlow
    {M Z : Type*} [MetricSpace M] [MeasurableSpace M] [BorelSpace M]
    [SecondCountableTopology M] [StandardBorelSpace M] [Nonempty M]
    [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace.CountablySeparated Z] [MeasurableEq Z]
    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    {N : Set M} (hN : MeasurableSet N)
    {a : M → Z} {u : M → ℝ} (ha : Measurable a) (hu : Measurable u)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (fun x : N ↦ (a x.val, u x.val)))
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ N, ∀ y ∈ N,
      (a x = a y ∧ u x ≤ u y) ↔ u y - u x = dist x y)
    (μ ν : Measure M) (hμN : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ N) (hνN : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, y ∈ N)
    (r : Measure Z) [SFinite r]
    (P : Z → I → J → ℝ) (asrc : Z → I → ℝ) (btgt : Z → J → ℝ)
    (hmP : ∀ i j, Measurable (fun z ↦ P z i j))
    (hma : ∀ i, Measurable (fun z ↦ asrc z i))
    (hmb : ∀ j, Measurable (fun z ↦ btgt z j))
    (α : I → Kernel Z ℝ) (β : J → Kernel Z ℝ)
    [∀ i, IsMarkovKernel (α i)] [∀ j, IsMarkovKernel (β j)]
    (hP : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, ∀ i j, 0 ≤ P z i j)
    (hrow : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, ∀ i, ∑ j, P z i j = asrc z i)
    (hcol : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, ∀ j, ∑ i, P z i j = btgt z j)
    (hsource : r ⊗ₘ finiteClassMarginalKernel asrc α = μ.map (fun x ↦ (a x, u x)))
    (htarget : r ⊗ₘ finiteClassMarginalKernel btgt β = ν.map (fun y ↦ (a y, u y)))
    (hbinlegal : ∀ᵐ z ∂r, ∀ i j, 0 < P z i j →
      ∀ᵐ p ∂(α i z).prod (β j z), p.1 ≤ p.2) :
    ∃ b : Z × ℝ → M, Measurable b ∧
      Vlasov.IsCoupling ((sameLabelPopulationCoupling r P α β).map (Prod.map b b)) μ ν ∧
      (∀ᵐ p ∂(sameLabelPopulationCoupling r P α β).map (Prod.map b b),
        u p.2 - u p.1 = dist p.1 p.2) ∧
      ∀ ξ : Measure ((Z × ℝ) × (Z × ℝ)), ξ ≤ sameLabelPopulationCoupling r P α β →
        ξ.map (Prod.map b b) ≤ (sameLabelPopulationCoupling r P α β).map (Prod.map b b) ∧
        ξ.map (Prod.map b b) Set.univ = ξ Set.univ

theorem isOptimalCoupling_of_calibrated_of_original_label_face
    (μ ν : Measure M) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (u : M → ℝ) (hu : Continuous u) (a : M → Z) (ha : Measurable a)
    (N : Set M) (hN : MeasurableSet N)
    (hμN : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ N) (hνN : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, y ∈ N)
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ N, ∀ y ∈ N,
      (a x = a y ∧ u x ≤ u y) ↔ u y - u x = dist x y)
    (hface : ∀ π : Measure (M × M), IsOptimalCoupling edist μ ν π ↔
      ∃ k : Kernel Z (M × M), IsMarkovKernel k ∧ k ∘ₘ μ.map a = π ∧
        ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.map a, Vlasov.IsCoupling (k z)
          (condDistrib id a μ z) (condDistrib id a ν z) ∧
          ∀ᵐ p ∂k z, p.1 ∈ N ∧ p.2 ∈ N ∧ a p.1 = a p.2 ∧ u p.1 ≤ u p.2)
    (π : Measure (M × M)) (hπ : Vlasov.IsCoupling π μ ν)
    (hcal : ∀ᵐ p ∂π, u p.2 - u p.1 = dist p.1 p.2) :
    IsOptimalCoupling edist μ ν π

theorem exists_compact_legal_clock_collars
    (q : ℕ) (α β : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure α] [IsProbabilityMeasure β]
    {J A₀ B₀ : Set ℝ} (hJ : MeasurableSet J)
    (hA₀ : MeasurableSet A₀) (hB₀ : MeasurableSet B₀)
    (hαJ : α Jᶜ = 0) (hβJ : β Jᶜ = 0)
    (hαA : α A₀ᶜ = 0) (hβB : β B₀ᶜ = 0)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hsep : ∀ a ∈ A₀, ∀ b ∈ B₀, δ ≤ |b - a|)
    (matrix : (ℝ × ℝ) → Matrix (Fin q) (Fin q) ℝ)
    (hmatrix : ContinuousOn matrix {p | p.1 ∈ J ∧ p.2 ∈ J ∧ p.1 < p.2})
    (hpos : ∀ p, p.1 ∈ J → p.2 ∈ J → p.1 < p.2 → (matrix p).PosDef)
    (kin : ℝ → ℝ → (Fin q → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hactual : ∀ a ∈ J ∩ A₀, ∀ b ∈ J ∩ B₀, a < b → ∀ v,
      kin a b v = matrixQuadratic (matrix (a, b)) v)
    {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ A B : Set ℝ, IsCompact A ∧ IsCompact B ∧
      A ⊆ J ∩ A₀ ∧ B ⊆ J ∩ B₀ ∧ α Aᶜ < ε ∧ β Bᶜ < ε ∧

/-- Product embeddings preserve and reflect the prescribed marginal constraints. -/
theorem isCoupling_map_embedding_iff {f : α → α'} {g : β → β'}
    (hf : MeasurableEmbedding f) (hg : MeasurableEmbedding g)
    {μ : Measure α} {ν : Measure β} {π : Measure (α × β)} :
    Vlasov.IsCoupling (π.map (Prod.map f g)) (μ.map f) (ν.map g) ↔
      Vlasov.IsCoupling π μ ν := by
  constructor
  · intro hπ
    constructor
    · apply hf.map_injective
      calc
        (π.map Prod.fst).map f = (π.map (Prod.map f g)).map Prod.fst := by
          rw [Measure.map_map hf.measurable measurable_fst,
            Measure.map_map measurable_fst (hf.measurable.prodMap hg.measurable)]
          rfl
        _ = μ.map f := hπ.1
    · apply hg.map_injective
      calc
        (π.map Prod.snd).map g = (π.map (Prod.map f g)).map Prod.snd := by
          rw [Measure.map_map hg.measurable measurable_snd,
            Measure.map_map measurable_snd (hf.measurable.prodMap hg.measurable)]
          rfl
        _ = ν.map g := hπ.2
  · exact fun hπ ↦ hπ.map f g hf.measurable hg.measurable

/-- Every ambient coupling is concentrated on the product of the marginal embedding ranges. -/
theorem ae_mem_range_prodMap_of_isCoupling {f : α → α'} {g : β → β'}
    (hf : MeasurableEmbedding f) (hg : MeasurableEmbedding g)
    {μ : Measure α} {ν : Measure β} {κ : Measure (α' × β')}
    (hκ : Vlasov.IsCoupling κ (μ.map f) (ν.map g)) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂κ, z ∈ range (Prod.map f g) := by
  have hleft : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ.map f, x ∈ range f :=
    hf.ae_map_iff.mpr (Eventually.of_forall fun x ↦ mem_range_self x)
  have hright : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν.map g, y ∈ range g :=
    hg.ae_map_iff.mpr (Eventually.of_forall fun y ↦ mem_range_self y)
  rw [← hκ.1] at hleft
  rw [← hκ.2] at hright
  have hleft' := ae_of_ae_map measurable_fst.aemeasurable hleft
  have hright' := ae_of_ae_map measurable_snd.aemeasurable hright
  filter_upwards [hleft', hright'] with z hz₁ hz₂
  rcases hz₁ with ⟨x, hx⟩
  rcases hz₂ with ⟨y, hy⟩
  exact ⟨(x, y), Prod.ext hx hy⟩

theorem map_comap_of_isCoupling {f : α → α'} {g : β → β'}
    (hf : MeasurableEmbedding f) (hg : MeasurableEmbedding g)
    {μ : Measure α} {ν : Measure β} {κ : Measure (α' × β')}

    {μ : Measure α} {ν : Measure β} {κ : Measure (α' × β')}

    ∃! π : Measure (α × β), Vlasov.IsCoupling π μ ν ∧

  · apply (isCoupling_map_embedding_iff hf hg).mp
    rwa [heq]

/-- Ambient optimality compares against every coupling, all of which lift uniquely. -/
theorem isOptimalCoupling_map_embedding_iff {f : α → α'} {g : β → β'}
    (hf : MeasurableEmbedding f) (hg : MeasurableEmbedding g)
    (cost : α → β → ℝ≥0∞) (cost' : α' → β' → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hcost : ∀ x y, cost' (f x) (g y) = cost x y)
    {μ : Measure α} {ν : Measure β} {π : Measure (α × β)} :
    IsOptimalCoupling cost' (μ.map f) (ν.map g) (π.map (Prod.map f g)) ↔
      IsOptimalCoupling cost μ ν π := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hπ, hmin⟩
    refine ⟨(isCoupling_map_embedding_iff hf hg).mp hπ, fun κ hκ ↦ ?_⟩
    have h := hmin (κ.map (Prod.map f g)) ((isCoupling_map_embedding_iff hf hg).mpr hκ)
    simpa only [couplingCost_map_embedding hf hg cost cost' hcost] using h
  · rintro ⟨hπ, hmin⟩
    refine ⟨(isCoupling_map_embedding_iff hf hg).mpr hπ, fun κ hκ ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨κ₀, ⟨hκ₀, heq⟩, _⟩ := existsUnique_coupling_lift hf hg hκ
    rw [← heq, couplingCost_map_embedding hf hg cost cost' hcost,
      couplingCost_map_embedding hf hg cost cost' hcost]
    exact hmin κ₀ hκ₀

/-- Product pushforward maps the entire optimal face onto the ambient optimal face. -/
theorem image_optimalCouplings_embedding {f : α → α'} {g : β → β'}
    (hf : MeasurableEmbedding f) (hg : MeasurableEmbedding g)
    (cost : α → β → ℝ≥0∞) (cost' : α' → β' → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hcost : ∀ x y, cost' (f x) (g y) = cost x y)
    (μ : Measure α) (ν : Measure β) :
    Measure.map (Prod.map f g) '' {π | IsOptimalCoupling cost μ ν π} =
      {κ | IsOptimalCoupling cost' (μ.map f) (ν.map g) κ} := by
  ext κ
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨π, hπ, rfl⟩
    exact (isOptimalCoupling_map_embedding_iff hf hg cost cost' hcost).mpr hπ
  · intro hκ
    obtain ⟨π, ⟨_, heq⟩, _⟩ := existsUnique_coupling_lift hf hg hκ.1
    refine ⟨π, ?_, heq⟩
    apply (isOptimalCoupling_map_embedding_iff hf hg cost cost' hcost).mp
    rwa [heq]
