/-- Bundled probability couplings have the same entire-face correspondence. -/
theorem image_optimalProbabilityCouplings_embedding {f : α → α'} {g : β → β'}
    (hf : MeasurableEmbedding f) (hg : MeasurableEmbedding g)
    (cost : α → β → ℝ≥0∞) (cost' : α' → β' → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hcost : ∀ x y, cost' (f x) (g y) = cost x y)
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure α) (ν : ProbabilityMeasure β) :
    (fun π : ProbabilityMeasure (α × β) ↦
      π.map (hf.measurable.prodMap hg.measurable).aemeasurable) ''
        {π | IsOptimalCoupling cost (μ : Measure α) (ν : Measure β) (π : Measure (α × β))} =
      {κ : ProbabilityMeasure (α' × β') |
        IsOptimalCoupling cost' ((μ : Measure α).map f) ((ν : Measure β).map g)
          (κ : Measure (α' × β'))} := by
  ext κ
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨π, hπ, rfl⟩
    exact (isOptimalCoupling_map_embedding_iff hf hg cost cost' hcost).mpr hπ
  · intro hκ
    obtain ⟨π, ⟨hπ, heq⟩, _⟩ := existsUnique_coupling_lift hf hg hκ.1
    have : IsProbabilityMeasure (π.map Prod.fst) := by rw [hπ.1]; infer_instance
    have : IsProbabilityMeasure π := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_of_map Prod.fst
    refine ⟨⟨π, inferInstance⟩, ?_, ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure_injective heq⟩
    apply (isOptimalCoupling_map_embedding_iff hf hg cost cost' hcost).mp
    change IsOptimalCoupling cost' ((μ : Measure α).map f) ((ν : Measure β).map g)
      (π.map (Prod.map f g))
    rwa [heq]

/-- A measure carried by a measurable subset is exactly the pushforward of its subtype pullback. -/
theorem map_comap_subtype_of_ae_mem {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    {μ : Measure α} (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s) :
    (μ.comap ((↑) : s → α)).map ((↑) : s → α) = μ := by
  rw [map_comap_subtype_coe hs]
  exact Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hμ

/-- The same probability on its measurable carrier, without restriction renormalization. -/
noncomputable def probabilityOnSubset (μ : ProbabilityMeasure α) (s : Set α)
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ : Measure α), x ∈ s) : ProbabilityMeasure s := by
  let μ₀ := (μ : Measure α).comap ((↑) : s → α)
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ₀.map ((↑) : s → α)) := by
    rw [show μ₀.map ((↑) : s → α) = (μ : Measure α) from
      map_comap_subtype_of_ae_mem hs hμ]
    infer_instance
  exact ⟨μ₀, Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_of_map ((↑) : s → α)⟩

/-- Every ambient coupling of supported marginals has a unique coupling on the two subspaces. -/
theorem existsUnique_subtype_coupling_lift {s : Set α} {t : Set β}
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : MeasurableSet t)
    {μ : Measure α} {ν : Measure β}
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s) (hν : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, y ∈ t)
    {κ : Measure (α × β)} (hκ : Vlasov.IsCoupling κ μ ν) :
    ∃! π : Measure (s × t),
      Vlasov.IsCoupling π (μ.comap ((↑) : s → α)) (ν.comap ((↑) : t → β)) ∧
        π.map (Prod.map ((↑) : s → α) ((↑) : t → β)) = κ := by
  apply existsUnique_coupling_lift (MeasurableEmbedding.subtype_coe hs)
    (MeasurableEmbedding.subtype_coe ht)
  rwa [map_comap_subtype_of_ae_mem hs hμ, map_comap_subtype_of_ae_mem ht hν]

/-- Continuous cost-preserving embeddings transport convergence of entire optimal faces.
No measurable choice of an optimizer, compactness, or finite-cost hypothesis is required. -/
theorem tendsto_optimalProbabilityCouplings_embedding
    {f : α → α'} {g : β → β'}
    (hf : MeasurableEmbedding f) (hg : MeasurableEmbedding g)
    (hfc : Continuous f) (hgc : Continuous g)
    (cost : α → β → ℝ≥0∞) (cost' : α' → β' → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hcost : ∀ x y, cost' (f x) (g y) = cost x y)
    {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι}
    (μ : ι → ProbabilityMeasure α) (ν : ι → ProbabilityMeasure β)
    (π : ProbabilityMeasure (α × β))
    (hface : Tendsto
      (fun i ↦ {γ : ProbabilityMeasure (α × β) |
        IsOptimalCoupling cost (μ i : Measure α) (ν i : Measure β) (γ : Measure (α × β))})
      l (𝓝 π).smallSets) :
    Tendsto (fun i ↦ {κ : ProbabilityMeasure (α' × β') |
      IsOptimalCoupling cost' ((μ i : Measure α).map f) ((ν i : Measure β).map g)
        (κ : Measure (α' × β'))}) l
      (𝓝 (π.map (hf.measurable.prodMap hg.measurable).aemeasurable)).smallSets := by
  have hcont := ProbabilityMeasure.continuous_map (hfc.prodMap hgc)
  have h := hcont.continuousAt.image_smallSets.comp hface
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, image_optimalProbabilityCouplings_embedding hf hg cost cost'
    hcost] using h

theorem originalAtomPopulationLaw_spec (x : I → E) (π : Measure (E × E))
    [IsFiniteMeasure π] (hsource : π.fst = ∑ i, Measure.dirac (x i))
    (hcost : Integrable (fun p ↦ dist p.1 p.2 ^ 2) π) :

      (∑ i, originalAtomPopulationLaw x π i) = π.snd ∧
      (∀ i, Integrable (fun v ↦ dist (x i) v ^ 2) (originalAtomPopulationLaw x π i)) ∧
      (∑ i, ∫ v, dist (x i) v ^ 2 ∂originalAtomPopulationLaw x π i) =
        ∫ p, dist p.1 p.2 ^ 2 ∂π

/-- Every actual prefix has finite endpoint square costs and the linear-length
energy potential. Both completed and active plans are the genuine ordered plans. -/
theorem exists_finiteOrderedQuadraticStagePrefix
    (ν S T : ℕ → Measure E) (π : ℕ → Measure (E × E)) (N n : ℕ)
    [∀ k, IsFiniteMeasure (ν k)] [∀ k, IsFiniteMeasure (S k)]
    [∀ k, IsFiniteMeasure (T k)] [∀ k, IsFiniteMeasure (π k)]
    (hν₀ : ν 0 = 0) (hnN : n ≤ N)
    (hπ₁ : ∀ k < n, (π k).fst = ν k + S k)
    (hπ₂ : ∀ k < n, (π k).snd = ν (k + 1) + T k)
    (hcost : ∀ k < n, Integrable (fun p ↦ dist p.1 p.2 ^ 2) (π k)) :
    ∃ w : FiniteOrderedStagePrefix ν S T n,
      Integrable (fun p ↦ dist p.1.2 p.2 ^ 2) w.active ∧
      Integrable (fun p ↦ dist p.1.2 p.2.2 ^ 2) w.completed ∧
      (∫ p, dist p.1.2 p.2.2 ^ 2 ∂w.completed) +
          (N : ℝ) / n * (∫ p, dist p.1.2 p.2 ^ 2 ∂w.active) ≤
        (N : ℝ) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ∫ p, dist p.1 p.2 ^ 2 ∂π k := by
  revert hnN hπ₁ hπ₂ hcost
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro _ _ _ _
      let w : FiniteOrderedStagePrefix ν S T 0 :=
        { completed := 0
          active := 0
          completed_finite := inferInstance
          active_finite := inferInstance
          source_balance := by simp
          target_balance := by simp
          active_target := by simpa using hν₀.symm
          completed_order := by simp
          active_birth := by simp }
      refine ⟨w, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [w]
  | succ n ih =>
      intro hnN hπ₁ hπ₂ hcost
      obtain ⟨w, hactive, hcompleted, hbound⟩ := ih (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ n) hnN)
        (fun k hk ↦ hπ₁ k (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hk))
        (fun k hk ↦ hπ₂ k (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hk))
        (fun k hk ↦ hcost k (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hk))
      obtain ⟨v⟩ := exists_finiteOrderedStageStep ν S T n w (π n)
        (hπ₁ n (Nat.lt_succ_self n)) (hπ₂ n (Nat.lt_succ_self n))
      by_cases hn : n = 0
      · subst n
        obtain ⟨hnext, hcomp, hstep⟩ := v.quadratic_prefix_zero_le N hnN hν₀
          (hcost 0 (Nat.lt_succ_self 0))
        refine ⟨v.toPrefix, hnext, hcomp, ?_⟩
        simpa only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.cast_one, div_one, Finset.sum_range_one] using hstep
      · obtain ⟨hnext, hcomp, hstep⟩ := v.quadratic_prefix_le N (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn) hnN
          hactive hcompleted (hcost n (Nat.lt_succ_self n))
        refine ⟨v.toPrefix, hnext, hcomp, ?_⟩
        calc
          _ ≤ (∫ p, dist p.1.2 p.2.2 ^ 2 ∂w.completed) +
              (N : ℝ) / n * (∫ p, dist p.1.2 p.2 ^ 2 ∂w.active) +
              (N : ℝ) * (∫ p, dist p.1 p.2 ^ 2 ∂π n) := hstep
          _ ≤ (N : ℝ) * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ∫ p, dist p.1 p.2 ^ 2 ∂π k) +
              (N : ℝ) * (∫ p, dist p.1 p.2 ^ 2 ∂π n) := add_le_add hbound le_rfl
          _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, mul_add]

/-- The supplied genuine finite stages yield an actual ordered coupling of all
labelled sources and targets. Its quadratic cost is at most the number of
stages times the exact sum of actual stage costs, including the empty chain. -/
theorem exists_finiteOrderedQuadraticClasswiseCoupling
    (ν S T : ℕ → Measure E) (π : ℕ → Measure (E × E)) (N : ℕ)
    [∀ k, IsFiniteMeasure (ν k)] [∀ k, IsFiniteMeasure (S k)]
    [∀ k, IsFiniteMeasure (T k)] [∀ k, IsFiniteMeasure (π k)]
    (hν₀ : ν 0 = 0) (hνN : ν N = 0)
    (hπ₁ : ∀ k < N, (π k).fst = ν k + S k)
    (hπ₂ : ∀ k < N, (π k).snd = ν (k + 1) + T k)
    (hcost : ∀ k < N, Integrable (fun p ↦ dist p.1 p.2 ^ 2) (π k)) :
    ∃ Γ : Measure ((ℕ × E) × (ℕ × E)), IsFiniteMeasure Γ ∧
      Vlasov.IsCoupling Γ (finiteStageLabelledPrefix S N) (finiteStageLabelledPrefix T N) ∧
      (∀ᵐ z ∂Γ, z.1.1 ≤ z.2.1) ∧
      Integrable (fun p ↦ dist p.1.2 p.2.2 ^ 2) Γ ∧
      (∫ p, dist p.1.2 p.2.2 ^ 2 ∂Γ) ≤
        (N : ℝ) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, ∫ p, dist p.1 p.2 ^ 2 ∂π k := by
  obtain ⟨w, _, hcompleted, hbound⟩ :=
    exists_finiteOrderedQuadraticStagePrefix ν S T π N N hν₀ le_rfl hπ₁ hπ₂ hcost
  have hactive : w.active = 0 := by
    apply (Measure.map_eq_zero_iff measurable_snd.aemeasurable).mp
    exact w.active_target.trans hνN
  refine ⟨w.completed, w.completed_finite, ⟨?_, w.target_balance⟩,
    w.completed_order, hcompleted, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Measure.fst, hactive, Measure.map_zero, add_zero] using w.source_balance
  · simpa only [hactive, integral_zero_measure, mul_zero, add_zero] using hbound

/-- Any actual ordered labelled coupling is strictly ordered when each class
contains at most one colour; the coupling itself is retained. -/
theorem finiteStageLabelledCoupling_ae_strict_of_colours
    {E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace E] (S T : ℕ → Measure E) (N : ℕ)
    (Γ : Measure ((ℕ × E) × (ℕ × E)))
    (hΓ : Vlasov.IsCoupling Γ (finiteStageLabelledPrefix S N) (finiteStageLabelledPrefix T N))
    (horder : ∀ᵐ p ∂Γ, p.1.1 ≤ p.2.1)
    (hcolours : ∀ k < N, S k = 0 ∨ T k = 0) :
    ∀ᵐ p ∂Γ, p.1.1 < p.2.1 := by
  have hsource : ∀ᵐ p ∂Γ, p.1.1 < N := by
    have h : ∀ᵐ a ∂Γ.fst, a.1 < N := by
      rw [Measure.fst, hΓ.1]
      exact finiteStageLabelledPrefix_ae_lt S N
    exact ae_of_ae_map measurable_fst.aemeasurable h
  have havoid (k : Fin N) : ∀ᵐ p ∂Γ, p.1.1 ≠ (k : ℕ) ∨ p.2.1 ≠ (k : ℕ) := by
    rcases hcolours k k.isLt with hS | hT
    · have h : ∀ᵐ a ∂Γ.fst, a.1 ≠ (k : ℕ) := by
        rw [Measure.fst, hΓ.1]
        exact finiteStageLabelledPrefix_ae_ne_of_zero S N k hS
      exact (ae_of_ae_map measurable_fst.aemeasurable h).mono fun _ hz ↦ Or.inl hz
    · have h : ∀ᵐ a ∂Γ.snd, a.1 ≠ (k : ℕ) := by
        rw [Measure.snd, hΓ.2]
        exact finiteStageLabelledPrefix_ae_ne_of_zero T N k hT
      exact (ae_of_ae_map measurable_snd.aemeasurable h).mono fun _ hz ↦ Or.inr hz
  have hall : ∀ᵐ p ∂Γ, ∀ k : Fin N, p.1.1 ≠ (k : ℕ) ∨ p.2.1 ≠ (k : ℕ) :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr havoid
  filter_upwards [horder, hsource, hall] with p hp hsource hall
  apply Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hp
  intro heq
  rcases hall ⟨p.1.1, hsource⟩ with hs | ht
  · exact hs rfl
  · exact ht heq.symm

    [SecondCountableTopology E] [StandardBorelSpace E] [Nonempty E]
    (ν S T : ℕ → Measure E) (π : ℕ → Measure (E × E)) (N : ℕ)

    [∀ k, IsFiniteMeasure (T k)] [∀ k, IsFiniteMeasure (π k)]
    (hν₀ : ν 0 = 0) (hνN : ν N = 0)
    (hπ₁ : ∀ k < N, (π k).fst = ν k + S k)
    (hπ₂ : ∀ k < N, (π k).snd = ν (k + 1) + T k)

d-70e9b5e63497c8a23014ac90.selected_source_excerpt:
/-- Forbidden class pairs have zero mass in the actual recovered RN label
matrix. Readouts may be the class coordinates of a labelled physical space. -/
theorem smoothingEndpointLabelMatrix_zero_of_forbidden_labels
    {X Y I J K L : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (κ : I → Measure X) (σ : J → Measure Y)
    [∀ i, IsFiniteMeasure (κ i)] [∀ j, IsFiniteMeasure (σ j)]
    (π : Measure (X × Y)) (hπ : Vlasov.IsCoupling π (∑ i, κ i) (∑ j, σ j))
    (sourceClass : X → K) (targetClass : Y → L) (a : I → K) (b : J → L)
    (R : K → L → Prop)
    (hκ : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂κ i, sourceClass x = a i)
    (hσ : ∀ j, ∀ᵐ y ∂σ j, targetClass y = b j)
    (hR : ∀ᵐ p ∂π, R (sourceClass p.1) (targetClass p.2)) :
    ∀ i j, ¬ R (a i) (b j) → smoothingEndpointLabelMatrix κ σ π i j = 0 := by
  classical
  intro i j hij
  let τ := smoothingEndpointCouplingPart κ σ π i j
  have hleft : τ.map Prod.fst ≤ κ i := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (∑ k, smoothingEndpointCouplingPart κ σ π i k).map Prod.fst :=
        Measure.map_mono (Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun k ↦ smoothingEndpointCouplingPart κ σ π i k)
          (fun _ _ ↦ bot_le) (Finset.mem_univ j)) measurable_fst
      _ = _ := smoothingEndpointCouplingPart_row κ σ π hπ i
  have hright : τ.map Prod.snd ≤ σ j := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (∑ k, smoothingEndpointCouplingPart κ σ π k j).map Prod.snd :=
        Measure.map_mono (Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun k ↦ smoothingEndpointCouplingPart κ σ π k j)
          (fun _ _ ↦ bot_le) (Finset.mem_univ i)) measurable_snd
      _ = _ := smoothingEndpointCouplingPart_column κ σ π hπ j
  have hs := ae_of_ae_map (μ := τ) measurable_fst.aemeasurable
    (hleft.absolutelyContinuous.ae_le (hκ i))
  have ht := ae_of_ae_map (μ := τ) measurable_snd.aemeasurable
    (hright.absolutelyContinuous.ae_le (hσ j))
  have hRτ := (smoothingEndpointCouplingPart_le κ σ π hπ i j).absolutelyContinuous.ae_le hR
  have hfalse : ∀ᵐ p ∂τ, False := by
    filter_upwards [hs, ht, hRτ] with p hp₁ hp₂ hpR
    exact hij (by simpa only [hp₁, hp₂] using hpR)
  have hzero : τ = 0 := by
    apply Measure.measure_univ_eq_zero.mp
    simpa only [ae_iff, not_false_eq_true, ofPred_true] using hfalse
  change τ.real univ = 0
  simp only [hzero, measureReal_zero_apply]

d-ff1bf5e3be65a40c8aaa0505.selected_source_excerpt:
/-- The actual weighted joint estimate and exact target splitting propagate the
linear-length prefix energy potential. -/
theorem finiteStage_quadratic_prefix_potential_le
    {N k G A B C D A' X : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (hN : k + 1 ≤ N)
    (hX : 0 ≤ X) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hweighted : C ≤ (k + 1) / k * A + (k + 1) * B)
    (hsplit : A' + X = C + D) :
    G + X + N / (k + 1) * A' ≤ G + N / k * A + N * (B + D) := by
  have hk₁ : 0 < k + 1 := by linarith
  have hN₀ : 0 ≤ N := by linarith
  let c := N / (k + 1)
  have hc₁ : 1 ≤ c := (le_div_iff₀ hk₁).mpr (by simpa using hN)
  have hc₀ : 0 ≤ c := le_trans zero_le_one hc₁
  have hcN : c ≤ N := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hk₁).mpr
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hN₀ hk.le]
  have hcancel : c * ((k + 1) / k * A + (k + 1) * B + D) =
      N / k * A + N * B + c * D := by
    dsimp [c]
    field_simp
  calc
    _ ≤ G + c * (A' + X) := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc₁ hX]
    _ = G + c * (C + D) := by rw [hsplit]
    _ ≤ G + c * ((k + 1) / k * A + (k + 1) * B + D) := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add_right hweighted D) hc₀
      linarith
    _ = G + N / k * A + N * B + c * D := by rw [hcancel]; ring
    _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcN hD]

    [MeasurableSpace.CountablySeparated Z] {N : Set M} (hN : MeasurableSet N)
    {a : M → Z} {u : M → ℝ} (ha : Measurable a) (hu : Measurable u)

      ∀ (z : Z) (μ ν : Measure M),
        (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ N ∧ a x = z) → (∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ N ∧ a x = z) →
        ∃ e : {π : Measure (M × M) // Vlasov.IsCoupling π μ ν} ≃
            {κ : Measure (ℝ × ℝ) // Vlasov.IsCoupling κ (μ.map u) (ν.map u)},

theorem exists_measurable_actualReferenceWindow_split
    {I J Z : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (γ : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)) [IsFiniteMeasure γ]
    (S : I → Set ℝ) (T : J → Set ℝ)
    (hS : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (S i)) (hT : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (T j))
    (hdS : Pairwise (Disjoint on S)) (hdT : Pairwise (Disjoint on T))
    (H : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (allowed : I → J → Prop)
    (P Q : Z → I → J → ℝ)
    (hmP : ∀ i j, Measurable (fun z ↦ P z i j))
    (hmQ : ∀ i j, Measurable (fun z ↦ Q z i j))
    (a : Z → I → ℝ) (b : Z → J → ℝ) (G : Set Z) (B L : ℝ)
    (htotalRef : (∑ i, ∑ j, actualClockClassFlow γ S T i j) = 1)
    (hloss : γ.real Hᶜ ≤ L)
    (hlocal : ∀ z ∈ G,
      (∀ i j, 0 ≤ P z i j) ∧ (∀ i j, 0 ≤ Q z i j) ∧
      (∀ i, ∑ j, (P z i j + Q z i j) = a z i) ∧
      (∀ j, ∑ i, (P z i j + Q z i j) = b z j) ∧
      (∀ i j, ¬ allowed i j → actualClockClassFlow γ S T i j = 0 ∧ Q z i j = 0) ∧
      (∑ i, ∑ j, Q z i j) ≤ B ∧ (∑ i, a z i) = 1 ∧
      ∃ scale : ℝ, ∀ i j, P z i j = scale * actualClockClassFlow γ S T i j) :
    ∃ Pg Qg : Z → I → J → ℝ,
      (∀ i j, Measurable (fun z ↦ Pg z i j)) ∧
      (∀ i j, Measurable (fun z ↦ Qg z i j)) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ G,
        (∀ i j, 0 ≤ Pg z i j) ∧ (∀ i j, 0 ≤ Qg z i j) ∧
        (∀ i, ∑ j, (Pg z i j + Qg z i j) = a z i) ∧
        (∀ j, ∑ i, (Pg z i j + Qg z i j) = b z j) ∧
        (∀ i j, ¬ allowed i j → Pg z i j = 0 ∧ Qg z i j = 0) ∧
        (∑ i, ∑ j, Qg z i j) ≤ B + L ∧
        ∀ i j, Pg z i j = maskedClockFlow
          (fun i j ↦ ((S i ×ˢ T j) ∩ H).Nonempty) (P z) i j

theorem exists_optimal_face_conditional_densities
    (μ ν m : Measure M) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    [IsFiniteMeasure m] (hμm : μ ≪ m) (hνm : ν ≪ m)
    {K : Set M} (hK : IsCompact K) (hμ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ K)
    (hν : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, x ∈ K) :
    ∃ f : M → ℝ, LipschitzWith 1 f ∧
      ∀ (N : Set M), MeasurableSet N → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ N) → (∀ᵐ y ∂ν, y ∈ N) →
      ∀ label : M → Z, Measurable label →
      (∀ x ∈ N, ∀ y ∈ N, f y - f x = dist x y → label x = label y) →
      μ.map label = ν.map label ∧ ∃ wμ wν : Z → M → ℝ≥0∞,
        Measurable (Function.uncurry wμ) ∧ Measurable (Function.uncurry wν) ∧
        (∀ᵐ z ∂μ.map label,
          (condDistrib id label m z).withDensity (wμ z) = condDistrib id label μ z ∧
          (condDistrib id label m z).withDensity (wν z) = condDistrib id label ν z ∧
          (∫⁻ x, wμ z x ∂condDistrib id label m z) = 1 ∧
          (∫⁻ x, wν z x ∂condDistrib id label m z) = 1) ∧
        ∀ π : Measure (M × M), IsOptimalCoupling edist μ ν π ↔
          ∃ κ : Kernel Z (M × M), IsMarkovKernel κ ∧ κ ∘ₘ μ.map label = π ∧
            ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.map label,
              Vlasov.IsCoupling (κ z)
                ((condDistrib id label m z).withDensity (wμ z))
                ((condDistrib id label m z).withDensity (wν z)) ∧
              ∀ᵐ p ∂κ z, p.1 ∈ N ∧ p.2 ∈ N ∧ f p.2 - f p.1 = dist p.1 p.2

      ∀ (N : Set M), MeasurableSet N → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ N) → (∀ᵐ y ∂ν, y ∈ N) →
      ∀ (a b : M → Z), Measurable a → Measurable b →

theorem FiniteOrderedStageStep.quadratic_energy
    {ν S T : ℕ → Measure E} {n : ℕ}
    {w : FiniteOrderedStagePrefix ν S T n} {π : Measure (E × E)}
    (v : FiniteOrderedStageStep ν S T n w π)
    (hactive : Integrable (fun p ↦ dist p.1.2 p.2 ^ 2) w.active)
    (hcompleted : Integrable (fun p ↦ dist p.1.2 p.2.2 ^ 2) w.completed)
    (hπ : Integrable (fun p ↦ dist p.1 p.2 ^ 2) π)
    {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) :
    Integrable (fun p ↦ dist p.1.2 p.2 ^ 2) v.nextActive ∧
    Integrable (fun p ↦ dist p.1.2 p.2 ^ 2) v.exits ∧
    Integrable (fun p ↦ dist p.1.2 p.2.2 ^ 2) v.toPrefix.completed ∧
    (∫ p, dist p.1.2 p.2.2 ^ 2 ∂v.toPrefix.completed) =
      (∫ p, dist p.1.2 p.2.2 ^ 2 ∂w.completed) +
        (∫ p, dist p.1.2 p.2 ^ 2 ∂v.exits) ∧
    (∫ p, dist p.1.2 p.2 ^ 2 ∂v.nextActive) +
        (∫ p, dist p.1.2 p.2 ^ 2 ∂v.exits) =
      (∫ p, dist p.1.1.2 p.2 ^ 2 ∂v.triple) +
        (∫ p, dist p.1 p.2 ^ 2 ∂v.birth) ∧
    (∫ p, dist p.1.1.2 p.2 ^ 2 ∂v.triple) ≤
      (k + 1) / k * (∫ p, dist p.1.2 p.2 ^ 2 ∂w.active) +
        (k + 1) * (∫ p, dist p.1 p.2 ^ 2 ∂v.continuing) ∧
    (∫ p, dist p.1 p.2 ^ 2 ∂v.continuing) +
        (∫ p, dist p.1 p.2 ^ 2 ∂v.birth) = ∫ p, dist p.1 p.2 ^ 2 ∂π

theorem FiniteOrderedStageStep.quadratic_prefix_le
    {ν S T : ℕ → Measure E} {n : ℕ}
    {w : FiniteOrderedStagePrefix ν S T n} {π : Measure (E × E)}
    (v : FiniteOrderedStageStep ν S T n w π) (N : ℕ)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hN : n + 1 ≤ N)
    (hactive : Integrable (fun p ↦ dist p.1.2 p.2 ^ 2) w.active)
    (hcompleted : Integrable (fun p ↦ dist p.1.2 p.2.2 ^ 2) w.completed)
    (hπ : Integrable (fun p ↦ dist p.1 p.2 ^ 2) π) :
    Integrable (fun p ↦ dist p.1.2 p.2 ^ 2) v.toPrefix.active ∧
    Integrable (fun p ↦ dist p.1.2 p.2.2 ^ 2) v.toPrefix.completed ∧
    (∫ p, dist p.1.2 p.2.2 ^ 2 ∂v.toPrefix.completed) +
        (N : ℝ) / (n + 1 : ℕ) * (∫ p, dist p.1.2 p.2 ^ 2 ∂v.toPrefix.active) ≤
      (∫ p, dist p.1.2 p.2.2 ^ 2 ∂w.completed) +
        (N : ℝ) / n * (∫ p, dist p.1.2 p.2 ^ 2 ∂w.active) +
        (N : ℝ) * (∫ p, dist p.1 p.2 ^ 2 ∂π)

theorem exists_original_feasible_clockClassFlow
    {X Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [StandardBorelSpace X] [Nonempty X]
    [MeasurableSpace Z] {M L : ℕ}
    (μ ν : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (π : Measure (X × X)) (hπ : Vlasov.IsCoupling π μ ν)
    (a : X → Z) (u : X → ℝ) (ha : Measurable a) (hu : Measurable u)
    (hlabel : ∀ᵐ p ∂π, a p.1 = a p.2)
    (δ : ℝ) (hgap : ∀ᵐ p ∂π, δ ≤ u p.2 - u p.1)
    (S : Fin M → Set ℝ) (T : Fin L → Set ℝ)
    (hS : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (S i)) (hT : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (T j))
    (hdS : Pairwise (Disjoint on S)) (hdT : Pairwise (Disjoint on T))
    (hcoverS : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.map a, ∀ᵐ s ∂condDistrib u a μ z, s ∈ ⋃ i, S i)
    (hcoverT : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.map a, ∀ᵐ t ∂condDistrib u a ν z, t ∈ ⋃ j, T j)
    (allowed : Fin M → Fin L → Prop)
    (hbins : ∀ i j, ∀ s ∈ S i, ∀ t ∈ T j, δ ≤ t - s → allowed i j) :
    ∃ γ : Kernel Z (ℝ × ℝ), IsMarkovKernel γ ∧ μ.map a = ν.map a ∧
      ∀ᵐ z ∂μ.map a,
        (∀ i j, 0 ≤ actualClockClassFlow (γ z) S T i j) ∧
        (∀ i, ∑ j, actualClockClassFlow (γ z) S T i j = (condDistrib u a μ z).real (S i)) ∧
        (∀ j, ∑ i, actualClockClassFlow (γ z) S T i j = (condDistrib u a ν z).real (T j)) ∧
        (∀ i j, ¬ allowed i j → actualClockClassFlow (γ z) S T i j = 0) ∧
        (∀ A : Finset (Fin M), (∑ i ∈ A, (condDistrib u a μ z).real (S i)) ≤
          ∑ j ∈ orderedClockNeighbors allowed A, (condDistrib u a ν z).real (T j)) ∧
        (∑ i, ∑ j, actualClockClassFlow (γ z) S T i j) = 1

d-ea870c03a19d8502740e6567.exact_source_header:
theorem exists_tolerance_reference_residual_clockFlow
    {M L : ℕ} (allowed : Fin M → Fin L → Prop)
    (horder : ∀ i i' j j', i ≤ i' → j' ≤ j → allowed i' j' → allowed i j)
    (a₀ : Fin M → ℝ) (b₀ : Fin L → ℝ)
    (ha₀ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a₀ i) (hb₀ : ∀ j, 0 ≤ b₀ j)
    (htotal₀ : ∑ i, a₀ i = ∑ j, b₀ j)
    (hhall₀ : ∀ A : Finset (Fin M), (∑ i ∈ A, a₀ i) ≤
      ∑ j ∈ orderedClockNeighbors allowed A, b₀ j)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ (a : Fin M → ℝ) (b : Fin L → ℝ),
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) → (∀ j, 0 ≤ b j) →
      (∑ i, a i = ∑ j, b j) →
      (∀ A : Finset (Fin M), (∑ i ∈ A, a i) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ orderedClockNeighbors allowed A, b j) →
      (∀ i, |a i - a₀ i| ≤ δ) → (∀ j, |b j - b₀ j| ≤ δ) →
      (∀ i j, 0 ≤ referenceResidualClockFlow a₀ b₀ η a b i j) ∧
      (∀ i, ∑ j, referenceResidualClockFlow a₀ b₀ η a b i j = a i - (1 - η) * a₀ i) ∧
      (∀ j, ∑ i, referenceResidualClockFlow a₀ b₀ η a b i j = b j - (1 - η) * b₀ j) ∧
      ∀ i j, ¬ allowed i j → referenceResidualClockFlow a₀ b₀ η a b i j = 0

theorem referenceWholeClockFlow_marginals
    {M L : ℕ} (allowed : Fin M → Fin L → Prop)
    (a₀ : Fin M → ℝ) (b₀ : Fin L → ℝ) (a : Fin M → ℝ) (b : Fin L → ℝ)
    (P₀ R : Fin M → Fin L → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hP₀ : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ P₀ i j) (hR : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ R i j)
    (hrow₀ : ∀ i, ∑ j, P₀ i j = a₀ i) (hcol₀ : ∀ j, ∑ i, P₀ i j = b₀ j)
    (hrowR : ∀ i, ∑ j, R i j = a i - θ * a₀ i)
    (hcolR : ∀ j, ∑ i, R i j = b j - θ * b₀ j)
    (hlegal₀ : ∀ i j, ¬ allowed i j → P₀ i j = 0)
    (hlegalR : ∀ i j, ¬ allowed i j → R i j = 0) :
    (∀ i j, 0 ≤ θ * P₀ i j + R i j) ∧
    (∀ i, ∑ j, (θ * P₀ i j + R i j) = a i) ∧
    (∀ j, ∑ i, (θ * P₀ i j + R i j) = b j) ∧
    ∀ i j, ¬ allowed i j → θ * P₀ i j + R i j = 0

theorem referenceWholePopulationCoupling
    {M L : ℕ} {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    (a₀ : Fin M → ℝ) (b₀ : Fin L → ℝ) (a : Fin M → ℝ) (b : Fin L → ℝ)
    (P₀ R : Fin M → Fin L → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hP₀ : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ P₀ i j) (hR : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ R i j)
    (hrow₀ : ∀ i, ∑ j, P₀ i j = a₀ i) (hcol₀ : ∀ j, ∑ i, P₀ i j = b₀ j)
    (hrowR : ∀ i, ∑ j, R i j = a i - θ * a₀ i)
    (hcolR : ∀ j, ∑ i, R i j = b j - θ * b₀ j)
    (α : Fin M → Measure X) (β : Fin L → Measure Y)
    [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (α i)] [∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (β j)] :
    let χ := finiteClassPopulationCoupling (fun i j ↦ θ * P₀ i j) α β
    let ξ := finiteClassPopulationCoupling R α β
    ((χ + ξ).map Prod.fst = ∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (a i) • α i) ∧
    ((χ + ξ).map Prod.snd = ∑ j, ENNReal.ofReal (b j) • β j) ∧
    ξ ≤ χ + ξ

theorem referenceResidualClockFlow_mass_le
    {M L : ℕ} (a₀ : Fin M → ℝ) (b₀ : Fin L → ℝ) (η : ℝ)
    (a : Fin M → ℝ) (b : Fin L → ℝ) (δ : ℝ)
    (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, referenceResidualClockFlow a₀ b₀ η a b i j =

theorem FiniteStageSpliceWitness.lintegral_energy
    {π₁ : Measure (A × B)} {π₂ : Measure (B × C)} {ρ ν ζ : Measure B}

theorem FiniteStageSpliceWitness.labelPlan_quadratic_cost_le
    {E : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E]
    {π₁ : Measure (A × B)} {π₂ : Measure (B × C)} {ρ ν ζ : Measure B}

    (x : A → E) (y : B → E) (z : C → E)

theorem finiteStageJoint_quadratic_weighted_le
    {A B C E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A] [MeasurableSpace B] [MeasurableSpace C]
    [PseudoMetricSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
    (x : A → E) (y : B → E) (z : C → E)
    (hx : Measurable x) (hy : Measurable y) (hz : Measurable z)
    (π₁ : Measure (A × B)) (π₂ : Measure (B × C)) (θ : Measure ((A × B) × C))
    (hθfst : θ.map Prod.fst = π₁)
    (hθsnd : θ.map (fun p ↦ (p.1.2, p.2)) = π₂)
    (hcost₁ : Integrable (fun p ↦ dist (x p.1) (y p.2) ^ 2) π₁)
    (hcost₂ : Integrable (fun p ↦ dist (y p.1) (z p.2) ^ 2) π₂)

      (∫ p, dist (x p.1.1) (z p.2) ^ 2 ∂θ) ≤
        (k + 1) / k * (∫ p, dist (x p.1) (y p.2) ^ 2 ∂π₁) +

theorem referencePairMask_split
    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (keep allowed : I → J → Prop) (A Q : I → J → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (a : I → ℝ) (b : J → ℝ) (B L : ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) (hQ : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ Q i j)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1)
    (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, (c * A i j + Q i j) = a i)
    (hcol : ∀ j, ∑ i, (c * A i j + Q i j) = b j)
    (hzero : ∀ i j, ¬ allowed i j → A i j = 0 ∧ Q i j = 0)
    (hmassQ : (∑ i, ∑ j, Q i j) ≤ B)
    (hmassBad : (∑ i, ∑ j, maskedClockFlow (fun i j ↦ ¬ keep i j) A i j) ≤ L) :
    let P' := fun i j ↦ c * maskedClockFlow keep A i j
    let Q' := fun i j ↦ Q i j + c * maskedClockFlow (fun i j ↦ ¬ keep i j) A i j
    (∀ i j, 0 ≤ P' i j) ∧ (∀ i j, 0 ≤ Q' i j) ∧
    (∀ i, ∑ j, (P' i j + Q' i j) = a i) ∧
    (∀ j, ∑ i, (P' i j + Q' i j) = b j) ∧
    (∀ i j, ¬ allowed i j → P' i j = 0 ∧ Q' i j = 0) ∧
    (∑ i, ∑ j, Q' i j) ≤ B + L

The retained reference scale bound is derived from the actual conditional total mass, so the loss is charged without an additional density-ratio constant.

theorem actualReferenceWindow_split
    {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (γ : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)) [IsFiniteMeasure γ]
    (S : I → Set ℝ) (T : J → Set ℝ)
    (hS : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (S i)) (hT : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (T j))
    (hdS : Pairwise (Disjoint on S)) (hdT : Pairwise (Disjoint on T))
    (H : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (allowed : I → J → Prop)
    (Q : I → J → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (a : I → ℝ) (b : J → ℝ) (B : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hQ : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ Q i j)
    (htotalRef : (∑ i, ∑ j, actualClockClassFlow γ S T i j) = 1)
    (htotalActual : (∑ i, a i) = 1)
    (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, (c * actualClockClassFlow γ S T i j + Q i j) = a i)
    (hcol : ∀ j, ∑ i, (c * actualClockClassFlow γ S T i j + Q i j) = b j)
    (hzero : ∀ i j, ¬ allowed i j → actualClockClassFlow γ S T i j = 0 ∧ Q i j = 0)
    (hmassQ : (∑ i, ∑ j, Q i j) ≤ B) :
    let keep := fun i j ↦ ((S i ×ˢ T j) ∩ H).Nonempty
    let P' := fun i j ↦ c * maskedClockFlow keep (actualClockClassFlow γ S T) i j
    let Q' := fun i j ↦ Q i j + c * maskedClockFlow (fun i j ↦ ¬ keep i j)
      (actualClockClassFlow γ S T) i j
    (∀ i j, 0 ≤ P' i j) ∧ (∀ i j, 0 ≤ Q' i j) ∧
    (∀ i, ∑ j, (P' i j + Q' i j) = a i) ∧
    (∀ j, ∑ i, (P' i j + Q' i j) = b j) ∧
    (∀ i j, ¬ allowed i j → P' i j = 0 ∧ Q' i j = 0) ∧
    (∑ i, ∑ j, Q' i j) ≤ B + γ.real Hᶜ

theorem exists_originalAtoms_strictClassRepair_of_actualStages
    (κ : I → Measure E) (τ : J → Measure E)
    [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (κ i)] [∀ j, IsProbabilityMeasure (τ j)]
    (c : I → ℕ) (d : J → ℕ) (x : I → E) (y : J → E)
    (N : ℕ) (hc : ∀ i, c i < N) (hd : ∀ j, d j < N)
    (ν : ℕ → Measure E) (π : ℕ → Measure (E × E))
    [∀ k, IsFiniteMeasure (ν k)] [∀ k, IsFiniteMeasure (π k)]
    (hν₀ : ν 0 = 0) (hνN : ν N = 0)
    (hπ₁ : ∀ k < N, (π k).fst = ν k + originalAtomSmoothingClassLaw κ c k)
    (hπ₂ : ∀ k < N, (π k).snd = ν (k + 1) + originalAtomSmoothingClassLaw τ d k)
    (hstageCost : ∀ k < N, Integrable (fun p ↦ dist p.1 p.2 ^ 2) (π k))
    (hcolours : ∀ k < N, (∀ i, c i ≠ k) ∨ (∀ j, d j ≠ k))
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hx : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ u ∂κ i, dist (x i) u ≤ a)
    (hy : ∀ j, ∀ᵐ v ∂τ j, dist v (y j) ≤ b) :
    ∃ σ : I ≃ J, (∀ i, c i < d (σ i)) ∧
      (∑ i, dist (x i) (y (σ i)) ^ 2) ≤
        3 * (N : ℝ) * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, ∫ p, dist p.1 p.2 ^ 2 ∂π k) +
          3 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * (Fintype.card I : ℝ)

    (c : I → ℕ) (d : J → ℕ) (x : I → E) (y : J → E)

/-- Quantizing the genuine original density law produces exactly the finite
weighted measure of its literal cell integrals, including zero-mass cells. -/
theorem originalDensityCellWeight_map_withDensity
    {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [MeasurableSpace I] [MeasurableSingletonClass I]
    (μ : Measure X) (f : X → ℝ) (hf : Integrable f μ) (hf0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ f x)
    (T : X → I) (hT : Measurable T) :
    (μ.withDensity (fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (f x))).map T =
      finiteWeightedMeasure (originalDensityCellWeight μ f T) := by
  classical
  apply Measure.ext_of_singleton
  intro i
  rw [Measure.map_apply hT (measurableSet_singleton i),
    withDensity_apply _ (hT (measurableSet_singleton i)),
    ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hf.restrict (ae_restrict_of_ae hf0)]
  simp [finiteWeightedMeasure, originalDensityCellWeight, Pi.single_apply]

/-- Actual finite quadratic dual prices are bounded by their original weighted
soft-test endpoint readout, paying the explicit error only on the target mass. -/
theorem quadraticSoftMinimum_weighted_dual_endpoints
    {ε δ M : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (α : I → ℝ) (β : J → ℝ) (hα : ∀ i,0 ≤ α i) (hβ : ∀ j,0 ≤ β j)
    (u : I → ℝ) (v : J → ℝ) (x : I → H) (y : J → H)
    (hdual : ∀ i j,u i+v j ≤ ‖y j-x i‖^2/2)
    (hcost : ∀ i j,‖y j-x i‖^2/2 ≤ M) :
    let ψ := fun τ z ↦ finiteSoftMinimum ε
      (fun i ↦ quadraticHamiltonJacobiBranch (-u i) (x i) τ z)
    (∑ i,α i*u i)+(∑ j,β j*v j) ≤
      (∑ j,β j*ψ (1+δ) (y j))-(∑ i,α i*ψ δ (x i))+
        (∑ j,β j)*(M*δ+ε*Real.log (Fintype.card I)) := by
  dsimp only
  let ψ := fun τ z ↦ finiteSoftMinimum ε
    (fun i ↦ quadraticHamiltonJacobiBranch (-u i) (x i) τ z)
  let err := M*δ+ε*Real.log (Fintype.card I)
  have hsource : (∑ i,α i*u i) ≤ ∑ i,α i*(-ψ δ (x i)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    have hi := quadraticSoftMinimum_sourceNode_le (δ := δ) hε u x i
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (hα i)
    change u i ≤ -ψ δ (x i)
    linarith only [hi]
  have htarget : (∑ j,β j*v j) ≤ ∑ j,β j*(ψ (1+δ) (y j)+err) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j _
    have hj := finiteSoftMinimum_lower hε
      (fun i ↦ quadraticHamiltonJacobiBranch (-u i) (x i) (1+δ) (y j))
      (fun i ↦ quadraticHamiltonJacobiBranch_target_le_error hδ (x i) (y j) (hdual i j) (hcost i j))
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (hβ j)
    change v j ≤ ψ (1+δ) (y j)+err
    dsimp only [ψ,err]
    linarith only [hj]
  simp only [mul_neg,Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at hsource
  simp only [mul_add,Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.sum_mul] at htarget
  dsimp only [ψ,err] at hsource htarget ⊢
  linarith only [hsource,htarget]

/-- The actual soft test is integrable on the original compactly carried law,
and quantizing that law costs only the original geometric gradient bound. -/
theorem neumannQuadraticSoftTest_grid_error
    (μ : Measure (ι → ℝ)) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {K₀ : Set (ι → ℝ)} (hK₀ : IsCompact K₀) (hsupp : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ K₀)
    (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : Integrable f μ) (hf0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ f x)
    (Q : (ι → ℝ) → (ι → ℝ)) (hQ : Measurable Q)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : ε ≠ 0) (a : I → ℝ) (y : I → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)
    (δ t D h : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < t+δ) (hD0 : 0 ≤ D) (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    {Ω : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)} (hΩ : Convex ℝ Ω)
    (hnode : ∀ z ∈ Ω, ∀ i, ‖z-y i‖ ≤ D)
    (hmem : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℝ).symm x ∈ Ω ∧
      (EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℝ).symm (Q x) ∈ Ω)
    (hdisp : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ,
      ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℝ).symm (Q x)-(EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℝ).symm x‖ ≤ h) :
    Integrable (fun x ↦ neumannQuadraticSoftTest ε a y δ t x*f x) μ ∧
    Integrable (fun x ↦ neumannQuadraticSoftTest ε a y δ t (Q x)*f x) μ ∧
    |(∫ x, neumannQuadraticSoftTest ε a y δ t (Q x)*f x ∂μ)-
      (∫ x, neumannQuadraticSoftTest ε a y δ t x*f x ∂μ)| ≤
        (D/(t+δ)*h)*(∫ x, f x ∂μ) := by
  let ψ := neumannQuadraticSoftTest ε a y δ t
  let L := D/(t+δ)*h
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hD0 hτ.le) hh
  have hψ : Continuous ψ := (contDiff_neumannQuadraticSoftTest ε a y δ t hτ.ne').continuous
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (hK₀.image hψ).isBounded.exists_norm_le
  have horig : Integrable (fun x ↦ ψ x*f x) μ := by
    apply (hf.norm.const_mul C).mono' (hψ.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hf.aestronglyMeasurable)
    filter_upwards [hsupp] with x hx
    simp only [Pi.mul_apply, norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hC _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩) (norm_nonneg _)
  have herr : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖ψ (Q x)-ψ x‖ ≤ L := by
    filter_upwards [hmem, hdisp] with x hx hd
    exact (quadraticSoftMinimum_norm_sub_le ε hε a y hτ hΩ hnode hx.1 hx.2).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (div_nonneg hD0 hτ.le))
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (ψ (Q x)-ψ x)*f x) μ :=
    ((hψ.measurable.comp hQ).aestronglyMeasurable.sub hψ.aestronglyMeasurable).mul
      hf.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hdiff : Integrable (fun x ↦ (ψ (Q x)-ψ x)*f x) μ := by
    apply (hf.norm.const_mul L).mono' hmeas
    filter_upwards [herr] with x hx
    rw [norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul hx le_rfl (norm_nonneg _) hL0
  have hquant : Integrable (fun x ↦ ψ (Q x)*f x) μ := by
    exact (hdiff.add horig).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x ↦ by
      change (ψ (Q x)-ψ x)*f x+ψ x*f x = ψ (Q x)*f x
      ring))
  refine ⟨horig, hquant, ?_⟩
  change |(∫ x, ψ (Q x)*f x ∂μ)-(∫ x, ψ x*f x ∂μ)| ≤ L*(∫ x, f x ∂μ)
  have heq : (∫ x, ψ (Q x)*f x ∂μ)-(∫ x, ψ x*f x ∂μ) =
      ∫ x, (ψ (Q x)-ψ x)*f x ∂μ := by
    rw [← integral_sub hquant horig]
    congr 1
    funext x
    ring
  rw [heq, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ x, L*f x ∂μ := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (hf.const_mul L) (by
      filter_upwards [herr, hf0] with x hx hf0x
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hf0x]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx hf0x)
    _ = _ := integral_const_mul L f

    (j : Lp (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) 2 μ)

        (∫x,φ x*f x∂μ)-(∫x,φ x*g x∂μ))

    (∫x,neumannQuadraticSoftTest ε a y δ 1 x*g x∂μ)-
      (∫x,neumannQuadraticSoftTest ε a y δ 0 x*f x∂μ)≤
        ρ⁻¹*(∫x,‖j x‖^2∂μ)/2 := by

  let d:=neumannQuadraticSoftTimeDerivative ε a y δ
  let p:=fun t x↦physicalCoordinateGradient ι (fderiv ℝ (ψ t) x)
  let mean:=fun t↦∫x,ψ t x*residualDensityInterpolation f g t x∂μ
  let rate:=fun t↦(∫x,d t x*residualDensityInterpolation f g t x∂μ)-
    (∫x,inner ℝ (j x) (p t x)∂μ)
  let budget:=ρ⁻¹*(∫x,‖j x‖^2∂μ)/2
  have hjI : Integrable (fun x↦‖j x‖^2) μ :=
    (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable j)).mp (Lp.memLp j)
  have hTime : ∀t∈Icc (-δ/2) (1+δ/2),t+δ≠0 := by
    intro t ht
    have : 0<t+δ:=by linarith [ht.1]
    exact this.ne'
  have hjoint:=continuousOn_neumannQuadraticSoftTest_timeDerivative ε a y δ (-δ/2) (1+δ/2) hTime
  have hpacket (t:ℝ) (ht:t∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1) : HasDerivAt mean (rate t) t ∧ rate t≤budget := by
    have htd : t+δ≠0:=(add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos ht.1 hδ).ne'
    have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ψ t):=contDiff_neumannQuadraticSoftTest ε a y δ t htd
    obtain ⟨φ,hφ,_hgrad⟩:=exists_original_smoothTest_ae_eq_on_support K μ hK₀ hK₀K hμ (ψ t) hψ
    have hψf : Integrable (fun x↦ψ t x*f x) μ:=
      (smoothTest_mul_density_integrable K μ φ hf).congr (hφ.mono fun x hx↦congrArg (fun r↦r*f x) hx)
    have hψg : Integrable (fun x↦ψ t x*g x) μ:=
      (smoothTest_mul_density_integrable K μ φ hg).congr (hφ.mono fun x hx↦congrArg (fun r↦r*g x) hx)
    have hψgf : Integrable (fun x↦ψ t x*(g x-f x)) μ:=
      (hψg.sub hψf).congr (ae_of_all _ fun x↦by
        change ψ t x*g x-ψ t x*f x=ψ t x*(g x-f x)
        ring)
    have hdiff:=hasDerivAt_integral_timeTest_residualDensityInterpolation μ hK₀ hμ f g hf hg ψ d

    have hdr : Integrable (fun x↦d t x*residualDensityInterpolation f g t x) μ:=
      (hdiff.1.sub hψgf).congr (ae_of_all _ fun x↦by
        change (d t x*residualDensityInterpolation f g t x+ψ t x*(g x-f x))-ψ t x*(g x-f x)=_
        ring)
    have hjp : Integrable (fun x↦inner ℝ (j x) (p t x)) μ:=
      integrable_original_smoothGradient_inner_on_support K μ hK₀ hK₀K hμ j (ψ t) hψ
    have hfluxψ:=original_weakNeumannFlux_pairing_of_smooth_on_support K μ hK₀ hK₀K hμ f g
      (fun x↦j x) hflux (ψ t) hψ
    have hgf : (∫x,ψ t x*(g x-f x)∂μ)=-(∫x,inner ℝ (j x) (p t x)∂μ) := by
      have heq : (fun x↦ψ t x*(g x-f x))=(fun x↦ψ t x*g x-ψ t x*f x):=funext fun x↦by ring
      rw [heq,integral_sub hψg hψf]
      change _=-(∫x,inner ℝ (j x) (physicalCoordinateGradient ι (fderiv ℝ (ψ t) x))∂μ)
      rw [hfluxψ]
      ring
    have hderiv : HasDerivAt mean (rate t) t := by
      convert hdiff.2 using 1
      rw [integral_add hdr hψgf,hgf]
      rfl
    refine ⟨hderiv,?_⟩
    have hbound : ∀ᵐx∂μ,d t x*residualDensityInterpolation f g t x-inner ℝ (j x) (p t x)≤
        ρ⁻¹*‖j x‖^2/2 := by

      have hHJ : d t x+‖p t x‖^2/2≤0 := by
        dsimp only [p]
        rw [(neumannQuadraticSoftTest_pointwise ε hε a y δ t htd x).2.1]
        exact (neumannQuadraticSoftTest_pointwise ε hε a y δ t htd x).2.2
      exact (hamiltonJacobi_flux_young (j x) (p t x) (hρ.trans_le hr) hHJ).trans

          simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv,mul_comm] using
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg ‖j x‖) hρ hr) (by norm_num))
    have hb:=integral_mono_ae (hdr.sub hjp) ((hjI.const_mul ρ⁻¹).div_const 2) hbound
    change (∫x,d t x*residualDensityInterpolation f g t x-inner ℝ (j x) (p t x)∂μ)≤_ at hb
    rw [integral_sub hdr hjp,integral_div,integral_const_mul] at hb
    exact hb
  have hFTC:=intervalIntegral.sub_le_integral_of_hasDeriv_right_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1)

    (fun t ht↦(hpacket t ⟨ht.1.le,ht.2.le⟩).1.hasDerivWithinAt)
    (show IntegrableOn (fun _t:ℝ↦budget) (Icc (0:ℝ) 1) volume from integrable_const _)
    (fun t ht↦(hpacket t ⟨ht.1.le,ht.2.le⟩).2)
  simpa only [mean,residualDensityInterpolation,sub_self,zero_mul,one_mul,sub_zero,add_zero,zero_add,
    intervalIntegral.integral_const,one_smul] using hFTC

quadratic soft-test endpoint budget, with the exact Neumann energy constant. -/
theorem originalDensity_neumannQuadraticSoft_signedValue_le
    (K : Compacts (ι→ℝ)) (μ : Measure (ι→ℝ)) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {K₀ : Set (ι→ℝ)} (hK₀ : IsCompact K₀) (hK₀K : K₀⊆interior (K:Set (ι→ℝ)))
    (hμ : ∀ᵐx∂μ,x∈K₀) (f g : (ι→ℝ)→ℝ) (hf : Integrable f μ) (hg : Integrable g μ)
    {ρ C : ℝ} (hρ : 0<ρ) (hC : 0≤C)
    (hfl : ∀ᵐx∂μ,ρ≤f x) (hgl : ∀ᵐx∂μ,ρ≤g x)
    (hbound : ∀φ:𝓓_{K}(ι→ℝ,ℝ),
      ‖(∫x,φ x*f x∂μ)-(∫x,φ x*g x∂μ)‖≤C*‖smoothPhysicalGradientLtwo K μ φ‖)
    {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : ε≠0) (hδ : 0<δ) (a : I→ℝ) (y : I→EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    (∫x,neumannQuadraticSoftTest ε a y δ 1 x*g x∂μ)-
      (∫x,neumannQuadraticSoftTest ε a y δ 0 x*f x∂μ)≤ρ⁻¹*C^2/2 := by
  obtain ⟨j,_hjI,hjE,hjtest,_hactI,_hactE⟩:=exists_originalDensity_weakNeumannInterpolation K μ f g hf hg hρ hC hfl hgl hbound
  have hflux (φ:𝓓_{K}(ι→ℝ,ℝ)) :
      (∫x,inner ℝ (j x) (physicalCoordinateGradient ι (fderiv ℝ φ x))∂μ)=
        (∫x,φ x*f x∂μ)-(∫x,φ x*g x∂μ) := by
    have hh:=(hasDerivAt_residualDensityInterpolation_test K μ φ hf hg 0).unique (hjtest φ 0)
    linarith
  exact (neumannQuadraticSoftTest_valueComparison_of_flux K μ hK₀ hK₀K hμ f g hf hg hρ hfl hgl j hflux hε hδ a y).trans
    (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hjE (inv_nonneg.mpr hρ.le)) (by norm_num))

/-- Fractional allocations with source law `μ` and the specified target-label masses. -/
structure IsSemidiscreteAllocation (μ : Measure S) (p : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (a : S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) : Prop where
  integrable : ∀ j, Integrable (fun s ↦ a s j) μ
  nonneg : ∀ᵐ s ∂μ, ∀ j, 0 ≤ a s j
  sum_one : ∀ᵐ s ∂μ, ∑ j, a s j = 1
  mass : ∀ j, ∫ s, a s j ∂μ = p j

/-- Every feasible coefficient lies in the unit interval almost everywhere. -/
theorem IsSemidiscreteAllocation.ae_le_one {μ : Measure S} {p : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ}
    {a : S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ} (ha : IsSemidiscreteAllocation μ p a) :
    ∀ᵐ s ∂μ, ∀ j, a s j ≤ 1 := by
  filter_upwards [ha.nonneg, ha.sum_one] with s hn hs
  intro j
  rw [← hs]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ ↦ hn k) (Finset.mem_univ j)

/-- Integrable original costs remain integrable against any feasible allocation. -/
theorem IsSemidiscreteAllocation.integrable_mul {μ : Measure S} {p : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ}
    {a : S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ} (ha : IsSemidiscreteAllocation μ p a)
    (c : S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (hc : ∀ j, Integrable (fun s ↦ c s j) μ)
    (j : Fin (m + 1)) : Integrable (fun s ↦ a s j * c s j) μ := by
  apply (hc j).bdd_mul (ha.integrable j).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [ha.nonneg, ha.ae_le_one] with s hn hu
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hn j)] using hu j

d-6dbcf2b8646eafc7970c2d1f.selected_source_excerpt:
/-- Adding target prices changes every feasible objective by the same mass-weighted sum. -/
theorem IsSemidiscreteAllocation.cost_add_prices {μ : Measure S} {p : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ}
    {a : S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ} (ha : IsSemidiscreteAllocation μ p a)
    (c : S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (hc : ∀ j, Integrable (fun s ↦ c s j) μ)
    (β : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) :
    semidiscreteAllocationCost μ (fun s j ↦ c s j + β j) a =
      semidiscreteAllocationCost μ c a + ∑ j, p j * β j := by
  have hi j := ha.integrable_mul c hc j
  have hp j := (ha.integrable j).mul_const (β j)
  unfold semidiscreteAllocationCost
  simp_rw [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [integral_add (integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ ↦ hi j))
    (integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ ↦ hp j)), integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ ↦ hp j)]
  simp_rw [integral_mul_const, ha.mass]

private theorem min_le_weighted_sum (b score : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ j, 0 ≤ b j) (hs : ∑ j, b j = 1) (k : Fin (m + 1))
    (hk : ∀ j, score k ≤ score j) : score k ≤ ∑ j, b j * score j := by
  calc
    score k = ∑ j, b j * score k := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hs, one_mul]
    _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ ↦ mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hk j) (hb j)

d-aa7660c539dd4dfddac050c5.name: _private.OTSelector.Probability.CavitySemidiscreteCalibration.0.OTSelector.Probability.eq_single_of_weighted_sum_eq_min
d-aa7660c539dd4dfddac050c5.selected_source_excerpt:
private theorem eq_single_of_weighted_sum_eq_min (b score : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ j, 0 ≤ b j) (hs : ∑ j, b j = 1) (k : Fin (m + 1))
    (hk : ∀ j, j ≠ k → score k < score j)
    (heq : ∑ j, b j * score j = score k) : ∀ j, b j = if j = k then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  have hnonneg j : 0 ≤ b j * (score j - score k) := by
    apply mul_nonneg (hb j)
    by_cases hj : j = k
    · simp [hj]
    · exact sub_nonneg.mpr (hk j hj).le
  have hz : ∑ j, b j * (score j - score k) = 0 := by
    simp_rw [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hs, one_mul, heq, sub_self]
  have hzj j : b j * (score j - score k) = 0 :=
    (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ ↦ hnonneg j)).mp hz j (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hoff j (hj : j ≠ k) : b j = 0 :=
    (mul_eq_zero.mp (hzj j)).resolve_right (ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr (hk j hj)))
  have hon : b k = 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k (fun j _ hj ↦ hoff j hj) (by simp)] at hs
    exact hs
  intro j
  split_ifs with hj
  · simpa only [hj] using hon
  · exact hoff j hj
d-aa7660c539dd4dfddac050c5.formal_conclusion: ∀ j, b j = if j = k then 1 else 0

d-477fb5f0938e9dab8d316999.name: OTSelector.Probability.semidiscreteAllocationCost_le_of_calibrated
d-477fb5f0938e9dab8d316999.selected_source_excerpt:
/-- A measurable allocation calibrated by one source potential and target prices
minimizes the exact semidiscrete objective. -/
theorem semidiscreteAllocationCost_le_of_calibrated
    (μ : Measure S) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (c a b : S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (ha : IsSemidiscreteAllocation μ p a) (hb : IsSemidiscreteAllocation μ p b)
    (hc : ∀ j, Integrable (fun s ↦ c s j) μ) (β : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (hcal : ∀ᵐ s ∂μ, ∃ k, (∀ j, c s k + β k ≤ c s j + β j) ∧
      ∀ j, a s j = if j = k then 1 else 0) :
    semidiscreteAllocationCost μ c a ≤ semidiscreteAllocationCost μ c b := by
  classical
  have hshift j : Integrable (fun s ↦ c s j + β j) μ := (hc j).add (integrable_const _)
  have hle : (fun s ↦ ∑ j, a s j * (c s j + β j)) ≤ᵐ[μ]
      fun s ↦ ∑ j, b s j * (c s j + β j) := by
    filter_upwards [hcal, hb.nonneg, hb.sum_one] with s hs hn ht
    obtain ⟨k, hk, ha⟩ := hs
    simp_rw [ha]
    simpa only [ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true] using
      min_le_weighted_sum (b s) (fun j ↦ c s j + β j) hn ht k hk
  have hint := integral_mono_ae
    (integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ ↦ ha.integrable_mul _ hshift j))
    (integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ ↦ hb.integrable_mul _ hshift j)) hle
  change semidiscreteAllocationCost μ (fun s j ↦ c s j + β j) a ≤
    semidiscreteAllocationCost μ (fun s j ↦ c s j + β j) b at hint
  rw [ha.cost_add_prices c hc β, hb.cost_add_prices c hc β] at hint
  exact (add_le_add_iff_right _).mp hint
d-477fb5f0938e9dab8d316999.formal_conclusion: semidiscreteAllocationCost μ c a ≤ semidiscreteAllocationCost μ c b

d-7e78030f8d7026e81a3448c2.name: OTSelector.Probability.semidiscreteAllocation_eq_of_cost_eq_of_strictly_calibrated
d-7e78030f8d7026e81a3448c2.selected_source_excerpt:
/-- Strict calibration identifies the entire optimal allocation face almost everywhere. -/
theorem semidiscreteAllocation_eq_of_cost_eq_of_strictly_calibrated
    (μ : Measure S) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (c a b : S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (ha : IsSemidiscreteAllocation μ p a) (hb : IsSemidiscreteAllocation μ p b)
    (hc : ∀ j, Integrable (fun s ↦ c s j) μ) (β : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (hcal : ∀ᵐ s ∂μ, ∃ k, (∀ j, j ≠ k → c s k + β k < c s j + β j) ∧
      ∀ j, a s j = if j = k then 1 else 0)
    (heq : semidiscreteAllocationCost μ c a = semidiscreteAllocationCost μ c b) :
    a =ᵐ[μ] b := by
  classical
  have hshift j : Integrable (fun s ↦ c s j + β j) μ := (hc j).add (integrable_const _)
  have hle : (fun s ↦ ∑ j, a s j * (c s j + β j)) ≤ᵐ[μ]
      fun s ↦ ∑ j, b s j * (c s j + β j) := by
    filter_upwards [hcal, hb.nonneg, hb.sum_one] with s hs hn ht
    obtain ⟨k, hk, ha⟩ := hs
    simp_rw [ha]
    simp only [ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
    apply min_le_weighted_sum (b s) (fun j ↦ c s j + β j) hn ht k
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j = k
    · simp [hj]
    · exact (hk j hj).le
  have hint : (∫ s, ∑ j, a s j * (c s j + β j) ∂μ) =
      ∫ s, ∑ j, b s j * (c s j + β j) ∂μ := by
    change semidiscreteAllocationCost μ (fun s j ↦ c s j + β j) a =
      semidiscreteAllocationCost μ (fun s j ↦ c s j + β j) b
    rw [ha.cost_add_prices c hc β, hb.cost_add_prices c hc β, heq]
  have hae := (integral_eq_iff_of_ae_le
    (integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ ↦ ha.integrable_mul _ hshift j))
    (integrable_finsetSum _ (fun j _ ↦ hb.integrable_mul _ hshift j)) hle).mp hint
  filter_upwards [hcal, hb.nonneg, hb.sum_one, hae] with s hs hn ht he
  obtain ⟨k, hk, ha⟩ := hs
  have he' : ∑ j, b s j * (c s j + β j) = c s k + β k := by
    rw [← he]
    simp [ha]
  funext j
  rw [ha, eq_single_of_weighted_sum_eq_min (b s) (fun j ↦ c s j + β j) hn ht k hk he']

theorem measurable_cavityScore
    (retained : W → Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)

/-- Atomlessness of a pairwise cost difference makes its priced score tie null. -/
theorem measure_cavityScore_eq_zero_of_atomless
    (μ : Measure S) (retained : W → Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (row : W × S → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hrow : ∀ j, Measurable (fun z ↦ row z j)) (i j k : Fin (n + 1)) (w : W)
    [NullSingletonClass (μ.map (fun s ↦ row (w, s) j - row (w, s) k))] :
    μ {s | cavityScore retained row i (w, s) j = cavityScore retained row i (w, s) k} = 0 := by
  have hm : Measurable (fun s ↦ row (w, s) j - row (w, s) k) :=
    ((hrow j).comp measurable_prodMk_left).sub ((hrow k).comp measurable_prodMk_left)
  have heq : {s | cavityScore retained row i (w, s) j = cavityScore retained row i (w, s) k} =
      (fun s ↦ row (w, s) j - row (w, s) k) ⁻¹'
        {assignmentCavityValue (retained w) i k - assignmentCavityValue (retained w) i j} := by
    ext s
    simp only [mem_ofPred_eq, mem_preimage, mem_singleton_iff, cavityScore]
    constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
  rw [heq, ← Measure.map_apply hm (measurableSet_singleton _), measure_singleton]

/-- With no ties, the measurable cell masses sum to the full insertion mass. -/
theorem sum_cavityCellMass
    (μ : Measure S) (retained : W → Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (row : W × S → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hret : ∀ k l, Measurable (fun w ↦ retained w k l))
    (hrow : ∀ j, Measurable (fun z ↦ row z j)) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (w : W)
    (hno : ∀ j k, j ≠ k →
      μ {s | cavityScore retained row i (w, s) j = cavityScore retained row i (w, s) k} = 0) :
    ∑ j, cavityCellMass μ retained row i j w = μ Set.univ := by
  have hcover : (⋃ j, {s | (w, s) ∈ cavityCell retained row i j}) = Set.univ := by
    ext s
    simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_univ, iff_true]
    exact exists_mem_cavityCell retained row i (w, s)
  have hmeas (j : Fin (n + 1)) : MeasurableSet {s | (w, s) ∈ cavityCell retained row i j} :=
    (measurableSet_cavityCell retained row hret hrow i j).preimage measurable_prodMk_left
  rw [← hcover, measure_iUnion₀ (aedisjoint_cavityCell_sections μ retained row i w hno)
    (fun j ↦ (hmeas j).nullMeasurableSet), tsum_fintype]
  rfl

theorem existsUnique_mem_cavityCell_of_pairwise_ne
    (retained : W → Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (row : W × S → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (z : W × S)

private theorem ae_pairwise_ne_of_eq_null {A : Type*} [MeasurableSpace A]
    (μ : Measure A) (score : A → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hno : ∀ j k, j ≠ k → μ {a | score a j = score a k} = 0) :
    ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, Pairwise (fun j k ↦ score a j ≠ score a k) := by
  apply ae_all_iff.mpr
  intro j
  apply ae_all_iff.mpr
  intro k
  by_cases hjk : j = k
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ h ↦ (h hjk).elim
  · have hne : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, score a j ≠ score a k := by
      apply ae_iff.mpr
      simpa only [not_not] using hno j k hjk
    exact hne.mono fun _ h _ ↦ h

/-- Under independence, fiberwise no ties hold for the original random insertion pair. -/
theorem ae_existsUnique_mem_cavityCell_of_indepFun
    (P : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure P] (μ : Measure S)
    (W₀ : Ω → W) (X : Ω → S) (hW : Measurable W₀) (hX : Measurable X)
    (hindep : IndepFun W₀ X P) (hlaw : P.map X = μ)
    (retained : W → Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (row : W × S → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hret : ∀ k l, Measurable (fun w ↦ retained w k l))
    (hrow : ∀ j, Measurable (fun z ↦ row z j)) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hno : ∀ᵐ w ∂P.map W₀, ∀ j k, j ≠ k →
      μ {s | cavityScore retained row i (w, s) j = cavityScore retained row i (w, s) k} = 0) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∃! j, (W₀ ω, X ω) ∈ cavityCell retained row i j := by
  have hnull (j k : Fin (n + 1)) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
      P {ω | cavityScore retained row i (W₀ ω, X ω) j =
        cavityScore retained row i (W₀ ω, X ω) k} = 0 := by
    have heq : MeasurableSet {z | cavityScore retained row i z j = cavityScore retained row i z k} :=
      measurableSet_eq_fun (measurable_cavityScore retained row hret hrow i j)
        (measurable_cavityScore retained row hret hrow i k)
    change P ((fun ω ↦ (W₀ ω, X ω)) ⁻¹'
      {z | cavityScore retained row i z j = cavityScore retained row i z k}) = 0
    rw [← Measure.map_apply (hW.prodMk hX) heq,
      hindep.map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hW.aemeasurable hX.aemeasurable, hlaw]
    apply Measure.measure_prod_null_of_ae_null heq
    exact hno.mono fun w hw ↦ hw j k hjk
  filter_upwards [ae_pairwise_ne_of_eq_null P
    (fun ω ↦ cavityScore retained row i (W₀ ω, X ω)) hnull] with ω hω
  exact existsUnique_mem_cavityCell_of_pairwise_ne retained row i (W₀ ω, X ω) hω

/-- Unique cell membership gives its actual strict price calibration and unit allocation. -/
theorem cavityAllocation_strictly_calibrated_of_unique
    (retained : W → Fin (m + 1) → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (row : W × S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (w : W) (s : S)
    (huniq : ∃! j, (w, s) ∈ cavityCell retained row i j) :
    ∃ k, (∀ j, j ≠ k →
      row (w, s) k + assignmentCavityValue (retained w) i k <
        row (w, s) j + assignmentCavityValue (retained w) i j) ∧
      ∀ j, cavityAllocation retained row i w s j = if j = k then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hu⟩ := huniq
  refine ⟨k, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne (hk j)
    intro he
    have hjcell : (w, s) ∈ cavityCell retained row i j := by
      intro l
      exact he ▸ hk l
    exact hj (hu j hjcell)
  · intro j
    by_cases hj : j = k
    · subst j
      simp [cavityAllocation, hk]
    · have hjnot : (w, s) ∉ cavityCell retained row i j := fun h ↦ hj (hu j h)
      simp [cavityAllocation, hj, hjnot]

theorem isSemidiscreteAllocation_cavityAllocation
    (μ : Measure S) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (retained : W → Fin (m + 1) → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (row : W × S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (hret : ∀ k j, Measurable (fun w ↦ retained w k j))
    (hrow : ∀ j, Measurable (fun z ↦ row z j)) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (w : W)
    (hno : ∀ j l, j ≠ l →
      μ {s | cavityScore retained row i (w, s) j = cavityScore retained row i (w, s) l} = 0) :
    IsSemidiscreteAllocation μ (fun j ↦ (cavityCellMass μ retained row i j w).toReal)
      (cavityAllocation retained row i w) := by
  classical
  have hm j : MeasurableSet {s | (w, s) ∈ cavityCell retained row i j} :=
    (measurableSet_cavityCell retained row hret hrow i j).preimage measurable_prodMk_left
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    exact (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator (hm j)

      by_cases hs : (w, s) ∈ cavityCell retained row i j <;> simp [cavityAllocation, hs]

  · intro j

/-- The actual cavity allocation is optimal for its own masses, and equality of the
cost forces every feasible competitor to be that allocation almost everywhere. -/
theorem cavityAllocation_unique_optimal
    (μ : Measure S) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (retained : W → Fin (m + 1) → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (row : W × S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (hret : ∀ k j, Measurable (fun w ↦ retained w k j))
    (hrow : ∀ j, Measurable (fun z ↦ row z j)) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (w : W)
    (hno : ∀ j l, j ≠ l →
      μ {s | cavityScore retained row i (w, s) j = cavityScore retained row i (w, s) l} = 0)
    (hc : ∀ j, Integrable (fun s ↦ row (w, s) j) μ)
    (b : S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (hb : IsSemidiscreteAllocation μ
      (fun j ↦ (cavityCellMass μ retained row i j w).toReal) b) :
    semidiscreteAllocationCost μ (fun s ↦ row (w, s)) (cavityAllocation retained row i w) ≤
      semidiscreteAllocationCost μ (fun s ↦ row (w, s)) b ∧
    (semidiscreteAllocationCost μ (fun s ↦ row (w, s)) (cavityAllocation retained row i w) =
      semidiscreteAllocationCost μ (fun s ↦ row (w, s)) b →
        cavityAllocation retained row i w =ᵐ[μ] b) := by
  have ha := isSemidiscreteAllocation_cavityAllocation μ retained row hret hrow i w hno
  have hcal := ae_cavityAllocation_strictly_calibrated μ retained row i w hno
  refine ⟨semidiscreteAllocationCost_le_of_calibrated μ _ _ _ b ha hb hc
    (assignmentCavityValue (retained w) i) ?_, ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [hcal] with s hs
    obtain ⟨k, hk, ha⟩ := hs
    refine ⟨k, fun j ↦ ?_, ha⟩
    by_cases hj : j = k
    · simp [hj]
    · exact (hk j hj).le
  · exact semidiscreteAllocation_eq_of_cost_eq_of_strictly_calibrated μ _ _ _ b ha hb hc
      (assignmentCavityValue (retained w) i) hcal

/-- The earlier paired mean readout is exactly the cost of the actual cell allocation,
with the endpoint test in place of cost. -/
theorem cavityMeanReadout_eq_allocationCost
    (μ : Measure S) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (retained : W → Fin (m + 1) → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (row : W × S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (hret : ∀ k j, Measurable (fun w ↦ retained w k j))
    (hrow : ∀ j, Measurable (fun z ↦ row z j)) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (w : W)
    (g : W × S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ j, Integrable (fun s ↦ g (w, s) j) μ) :
    cavityMeanReadout μ retained row i g w =
      semidiscreteAllocationCost μ (fun s ↦ g (w, s)) (cavityAllocation retained row i w) := by
  classical
  have hm j : MeasurableSet {s | (w, s) ∈ cavityCell retained row i j} :=
    (measurableSet_cavityCell retained row hret hrow i j).preimage measurable_prodMk_left
  have hind j : (fun s ↦ cavityAllocation retained row i w s j * g (w, s) j) =
      {s | (w, s) ∈ cavityCell retained row i j}.indicator (fun s ↦ g (w, s) j) := by
    funext s
    by_cases hs : (w, s) ∈ cavityCell retained row i j <;> simp [cavityAllocation, hs]
  have hi j : Integrable (fun s ↦ cavityAllocation retained row i w s j * g (w, s) j) μ := by
    rw [hind]
    exact (hg j).indicator (hm j)
  unfold cavityMeanReadout semidiscreteAllocationCost
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ ↦ hi j)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [hind, integral_indicator (hm j)]

/-- For fixed source costs, two cavity environments with the same masses have the
same allocation almost everywhere. The conclusion follows from actual optimality. -/
theorem cavityAllocation_eq_of_same_masses
    (μ : Measure S) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (retained : W → Fin (m + 1) → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (hret : ∀ k j, Measurable (fun w ↦ retained w k j))
    (c : S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (hc : ∀ j, Measurable (fun s ↦ c s j))
    (hci : ∀ j, Integrable (fun s ↦ c s j) μ)
    (hatom : ∀ j l, j ≠ l → NullSingletonClass (μ.map (fun s ↦ c s j - c s l)))
    (i : Fin (m + 1)) (w v : W)
    (hmass : ∀ j, cavityCellMass μ retained (fun z ↦ c z.2) i j w =
      cavityCellMass μ retained (fun z ↦ c z.2) i j v) :
    cavityAllocation retained (fun z ↦ c z.2) i w =ᵐ[μ]
      cavityAllocation retained (fun z ↦ c z.2) i v := by
  let row : W × S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ := fun z ↦ c z.2
  have hrow j : Measurable (fun z ↦ row z j) := (hc j).comp measurable_snd
  have hno (u : W) (j l : Fin (m + 1)) (hjl : j ≠ l) :
      μ {s | cavityScore retained row i (u, s) j = cavityScore retained row i (u, s) l} = 0 := by
    have := hatom j l hjl
    exact measure_cavityScore_eq_zero_of_atomless μ retained row hrow i j l u
  have hw := isSemidiscreteAllocation_cavityAllocation μ retained row hret hrow i w (hno w)
  have hv := isSemidiscreteAllocation_cavityAllocation μ retained row hret hrow i v (hno v)
  have hp : (fun j ↦ (cavityCellMass μ retained row i j w).toReal) =
      (fun j ↦ (cavityCellMass μ retained row i j v).toReal) :=
    funext fun j ↦ congrArg ENNReal.toReal (hmass j)
  have hoptw := cavityAllocation_unique_optimal μ retained row hret hrow i w (hno w) hci
    (cavityAllocation retained row i v) (hp.symm ▸ hv)
  have hoptv := cavityAllocation_unique_optimal μ retained row hret hrow i v (hno v) hci
    (cavityAllocation retained row i w) (hp ▸ hw)
  exact hoptw.2 (le_antisymm hoptw.1 hoptv.1)

/-- A measurable Dirichlet readout of the actual unique semidiscrete allocation,
with the exact mean identity simultaneously for the whole empirical optimal face. -/
theorem exists_dirichlet_semidiscrete_mean_readout
    (μ : Measure S) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (c : Fin (m + 1) → S → ℝ) (hc : ∀ j, Measurable (c j))
    (hci : ∀ j, Integrable (c j) μ)
    (hatom : ∀ j l, j ≠ l → NullSingletonClass (μ.map (fun s ↦ c j s - c l s)))
    (g : S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (hgm : ∀ j, Measurable (fun s ↦ g s j)) (hgi : ∀ j, Integrable (fun s ↦ g s j) μ) :
    ∃ G : (Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) → ℝ, Measurable G ∧
      (∀ᵐ p ∂dirichletOne m, ∃ a : S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ,
        IsSemidiscreteAllocation μ p a ∧
        (∀ b, IsSemidiscreteAllocation μ p b →
          semidiscreteAllocationCost μ (fun s j ↦ c j s) a ≤
            semidiscreteAllocationCost μ (fun s j ↦ c j s) b ∧
          (semidiscreteAllocationCost μ (fun s j ↦ c j s) a =
            semidiscreteAllocationCost μ (fun s j ↦ c j s) b → a =ᵐ[μ] b)) ∧
        G p = semidiscreteAllocationCost μ g a) ∧
      (∀ A : (Fin (m + 1) → S) → Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ,
        (∀ᵐ x ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ μ),
          OptimalFractionalAssignment (fun k j ↦ c j (x k)) (A x)) →
        (∫ x, (∑ i, ∑ j, A x i j * g (x i) j) / (m + 1 : ℕ)
          ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ μ)) = ∫ p, G p ∂dirichletOne m) := by
  let retained := iidCapacityInputCost c (fun (k : Fin m) (w : Fin m → S) ↦ w k)
  let row : (Fin m → S) × S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ := fun z j ↦ c j z.2
  have hret := measurable_iidCavityRetained c hc
  have hrow j : Measurable (fun z ↦ row z j) := (hc j).comp measurable_snd
  obtain ⟨G, hG, hrep, hfactor⟩ := exists_dirichlet_cavity_readout μ c hc hci hatom g hgm hgi
  refine ⟨G, hG, ?_, ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [hrep] with p hp
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hGw⟩ := hp
    have hno (j l : Fin (m + 1)) (hjl : j ≠ l) :
        μ {s | cavityScore retained row 0 (w, s) j = cavityScore retained row 0 (w, s) l} = 0 := by
      have := hatom j l hjl
      exact measure_cavityScore_eq_zero_of_atomless μ retained row hrow 0 j l w
    have ha := isSemidiscreteAllocation_cavityAllocation μ retained row hret hrow 0 w hno
    have hmass : (fun j ↦ (cavityCellMass μ retained row 0 j w).toReal) = p := hw
    refine ⟨cavityAllocation retained row 0 w, hmass ▸ ha, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro b hb
      exact cavityAllocation_unique_optimal μ retained row hret hrow 0 w hno hci b
        (hmass.symm ▸ hb)
    · exact hGw.trans (cavityMeanReadout_eq_allocationCost μ retained row hret hrow 0 w _ hgi)
  · intro A hA
    rw [(integral_iid_optimalFractional_mean_eq_canonical_cavity μ c hc hatom A hA g hgi).2]
    rw [← map_iidCavityMassVector_eq_dirichletOne μ c hc hatom,
      integral_map (measurable_iidCavityMassVector μ c hc).aemeasurable hG.aestronglyMeasurable]
    exact integral_congr_ae hfactor

/-- Every actual source row of every optimal fractional plan has the same canonical
cavity expectation against arbitrary integrable paired tests. -/
theorem integral_iid_optimalFractional_row_eq_canonical_cavity
    (μ : Measure S) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (c : Fin (m + 1) → S → ℝ) (hc : ∀ j, Measurable (c j))
    (hatom : ∀ j l, j ≠ l → NullSingletonClass (μ.map (fun s ↦ c j s - c l s)))
    (i : Fin (m + 1))
    (A : (Fin (m + 1) → S) → Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ᵐ x ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ μ),
      OptimalFractionalAssignment (fun k j ↦ c j (x k)) (A x))
    (g : S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (hg : ∀ j, Integrable (fun s ↦ g s j) μ) :
    Integrable (fun x ↦ ∑ j, A x i j * g (x i) j)
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ μ)) ∧
      (∫ x, ∑ j, A x i j * g (x i) j ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ μ)) =
        ∫ w, cavityMeanReadout μ (iidCapacityInputCost c (fun k w ↦ w k))
          (fun z j ↦ c j z.2) 0 (fun z ↦ g z.2) w ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin m ↦ μ) := by
  classical
  let P := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ μ)
  let ν := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin m ↦ μ)
  let W₀ : (Fin (m + 1) → S) → (Fin m → S) := fun x k ↦ x (i.succAbove k)
  let X : (Fin (m + 1) → S) → S := fun x ↦ x i
  have hW : Measurable W₀ := measurable_pi_iff.mpr fun _ ↦ measurable_pi_apply _
  have hX : Measurable X := measurable_pi_apply i
  have hpair : MeasurePreserving (fun x ↦ (W₀ x, X x)) P (ν.prod μ) :=
    Measure.measurePreserving_swap.comp (measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ ↦ μ) i)
  have hWlaw : P.map W₀ = ν := (measurePreserving_fst.comp hpair).map_eq
  have hXlaw : P.map X = μ := (measurePreserving_snd.comp hpair).map_eq
  have hindep : IndepFun W₀ X P := by
    apply (indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hW.aemeasurable hX.aemeasurable).mpr
    rw [hWlaw, hXlaw]
    exact hpair.map_eq
  have hret (k j : Fin (m + 1)) : Measurable (fun w ↦ iidCavityInputCostAt c i w k j) := by
    refine Fin.succAboveCases i ?_ (fun l ↦ ?_) k
    · simp only [iidCavityInputCostAt, Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
      exact measurable_const
    · simpa only [iidCavityInputCostAt, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove, Function.comp_def] using
        (hc j).comp (measurable_pi_apply l)
  have hA' : ∀ᵐ x ∂P, OptimalFractionalAssignment
      (Function.update (iidCavityInputCostAt c i (W₀ x)) i (fun j ↦ c j (X x))) (A x) := by
    simpa only [W₀, X, iidCavityInputCostAt_update] using hA
  have hmean := integral_optimalFractional_row_eq_cavityMeanReadout P μ W₀ X hW hX
    hindep hXlaw (iidCavityInputCostAt c i) (fun z j ↦ c j z.2) hret
    (fun j ↦ (hc j).comp measurable_snd) i
    (Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ hatom) A hA' (fun z ↦ g z.2)
    (fun j ↦ by rw [hWlaw]; exact (hg j).comp_snd ν)
  refine ⟨hmean.1, ?_⟩
  rw [hmean.2, hWlaw]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with w
  unfold cavityMeanReadout
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  have heq : {s | (w, s) ∈ cavityCell (iidCavityInputCostAt c i) (fun z j ↦ c j z.2) i j} =
      {s | (w, s) ∈ cavityCell (iidCapacityInputCost c (fun k w ↦ w k))
        (fun z j ↦ c j z.2) 0 j} := by
    ext s
    simp only [cavityCell, cavityScore, mem_ofPred_eq, iidCavityInputCostAt_price]
  rw [heq]

/-- A unique cavity cell forces the whole optimal fractional row to its indicator. -/
theorem optimalFractional_row_eq_cavity_indicator
    (retained : W → Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (row : W × S → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (z : W × S)
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (hA : OptimalFractionalAssignment (Function.update (retained z.1) i (row z)) A)
    (huniq : ∃! j, z ∈ cavityCell retained row i j) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    A i j = (cavityCell retained row i j).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) z := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hku⟩ := huniq
  have hz (l : Fin (n + 1)) (hl : l ≠ k) : A i l = 0 := by
    apply le_antisymm _ (nonneg_of_mem_doublyStochastic hA.1)
    by_contra hpos
    exact hl (hku l (mem_cavityCell_of_optimalFractional_pos retained row i l z A hA
      (lt_of_not_ge hpos)))
  have hk1 : A i k = 1 := by
    have hs := sum_row_of_mem_doublyStochastic hA.1 i
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k (fun l _ hl ↦ hz l hl) (by simp)] at hs
    exact hs
  by_cases hj : j = k
  · subst j
    simp [hk, hk1]

/-- Each original optimal fractional row has exactly the cavity allocation's mean readout.
The test may depend on the retained data, source, and target label. The optimizer is arbitrary;
its almost-everywhere equality to measurable cell indicators also supplies integrability. -/
theorem integral_optimalFractional_row_eq_cavityMeanReadout_of_unique
    (P : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure P] (μ : Measure S) [SFinite μ]
    (W₀ : Ω → W) (X : Ω → S) (hW : Measurable W₀) (hX : Measurable X)
    (hindep : IndepFun W₀ X P) (hlaw : P.map X = μ)
    (retained : W → Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (row : W × S → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hret : ∀ k l, Measurable (fun w ↦ retained w k l))
    (hrow : ∀ j, Measurable (fun z ↦ row z j)) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (huniq : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∃! j, (W₀ ω, X ω) ∈ cavityCell retained row i j)
    (A : Ω → Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, OptimalFractionalAssignment
      (Function.update (retained (W₀ ω)) i (row (W₀ ω, X ω))) (A ω))
    (g : W × S → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ j, Integrable (fun z ↦ g z j) ((P.map W₀).prod μ)) :
    Integrable (fun ω ↦ ∑ j, A ω i j * g (W₀ ω, X ω) j) P ∧
      (∫ ω, ∑ j, A ω i j * g (W₀ ω, X ω) j ∂P) =
        ∫ w, cavityMeanReadout μ retained row i g w ∂P.map W₀ := by
  classical
  let f (j : Fin (n + 1)) : W × S → ℝ :=
    (cavityCell retained row i j).indicator (fun z ↦ g z j)
  have hm j := measurableSet_cavityCell retained row hret hrow i j
  have hf j : Integrable (f j) ((P.map W₀).prod μ) := (hg j).indicator (hm j)
  have hmap : P.map (fun ω ↦ (W₀ ω, X ω)) = (P.map W₀).prod μ := by
    rw [hindep.map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hW.aemeasurable hX.aemeasurable, hlaw]
  have hcomp j : Integrable (fun ω ↦ f j (W₀ ω, X ω)) P := by
    have hfmap : Integrable (f j) (P.map (fun ω ↦ (W₀ ω, X ω))) := by
      rw [hmap]
      exact hf j
    exact hfmap.comp_measurable (hW.prodMk hX)
  have heq : (fun ω ↦ ∑ j, A ω i j * g (W₀ ω, X ω) j) =ᵐ[P]
      (fun ω ↦ ∑ j, f j (W₀ ω, X ω)) := by
    filter_upwards [hA, huniq] with ω hAω huω
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [optimalFractional_row_eq_cavity_indicator retained row i (W₀ ω, X ω)
      (A ω) hAω huω j]
    by_cases hj : (W₀ ω, X ω) ∈ cavityCell retained row i j <;> simp [f, hj]
  have hsum := integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun j _ ↦ hcomp j)
  refine ⟨hsum.congr heq.symm, ?_⟩
  rw [integral_congr_ae heq, integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ ↦ hcomp j)]
  have hiter j : Integrable (fun w ↦ ∫ s, f j (w, s) ∂μ) (P.map W₀) :=
    (hf j).integral_prod_left
  calc
    _ = ∑ j, ∫ w, ∫ s, f j (w, s) ∂μ ∂P.map W₀ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      have h := integral_indepFun_pair_eq_integral_prod hW hX hindep
        (F := f j) (by simpa [hlaw] using hf j)
      rw [hlaw] at h
      exact h.trans (integral_prod (f j) (hf j))
    _ = ∫ w, ∑ j, ∫ s, f j (w, s) ∂μ ∂P.map W₀ :=
      (integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ ↦ hiter j)).symm
    _ = ∫ w, cavityMeanReadout μ retained row i g w ∂P.map W₀ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with w
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      have hsec : MeasurableSet {s | (w, s) ∈ cavityCell retained row i j} :=
        (hm j).preimage measurable_prodMk_left
      rw [← integral_indicator (μ := μ) (f := fun s ↦ g (w, s) j) hsec]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with s
      by_cases hs : (w, s) ∈ cavityCell retained row i j <;> simp [f, hs]

/-- Conditioning on a measurable statistic yields a measurable version of every
fiber-constant real readout, with an actual representative on almost every fiber. -/
theorem exists_measurable_readout_of_fiber_constancy
    [StandardBorelSpace W] [Nonempty W] [MeasurableEq B]
    (P : Measure W) [IsFiniteMeasure P]
    (f : W → B) (hf : Measurable f) (g : W → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g)
    (hconst : ∀ w v, f w = f v → g w = g v) :
    ∃ G : B → ℝ, Measurable G ∧
      (∀ᵐ b ∂P.map f, ∃ w, f w = b ∧ G b = g w) ∧
      g =ᵐ[P] (G ∘ f) := by
  let κ := condDistrib (id : W → W) f P
  let G : B → ℝ := fun b ↦ ∫ w, g w ∂κ b
  have hG : Measurable G :=
    ((hg.comp measurable_snd).stronglyMeasurable.integral_condDistrib).measurable
  have hsupp : ∀ᵐ b ∂P.map f, ∀ᵐ w ∂κ b, f w = b := by
    apply Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_compProd (μ := P.map f) (κ := κ)
      (p := fun q : B × W ↦ f q.2 = q.1)
    change ∀ᵐ q ∂((P.map f) ⊗ₘ condDistrib id f P), f q.2 = q.1
    rw [compProd_map_condDistrib aemeasurable_id]
    apply (ae_map_iff (hf.prodMk measurable_id).aemeasurable
      (measurableSet_eq_fun (hf.comp measurable_snd) measurable_fst)).mpr
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hrep : ∀ᵐ b ∂P.map f, ∃ w, f w = b ∧ G b = g w := by
    filter_upwards [hsupp] with b hb
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hb.exists
    refine ⟨w, hw, ?_⟩
    change (∫ v, g v ∂κ b) = g w
    calc
      _ = ∫ _v, g w ∂κ b := integral_congr_ae (hb.mono fun v hv ↦ hconst v w (hv.trans hw.symm))
      _ = _ := by simp
  refine ⟨G, hG, hrep, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [ae_of_ae_map hf.aemeasurable hrep] with w hw
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hGv⟩ := hw
  exact (hconst w v hv.symm).trans hGv.symm

/-- Measurable endpoint tests have measurable actual cavity mean readouts. -/
theorem measurable_cavityMeanReadout
    (μ : Measure S) [SFinite μ]
    (retained : W → Fin (m + 1) → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (row : W × S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (hret : ∀ k j, Measurable (fun w ↦ retained w k j))
    (hrow : ∀ j, Measurable (fun z ↦ row z j)) (i : Fin (m + 1))
    (g : W × S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (hg : ∀ j, Measurable (fun z ↦ g z j)) :
    Measurable (cavityMeanReadout μ retained row i g) := by
  classical
  have hm j := measurableSet_cavityCell retained row hret hrow i j
  have hf j : Measurable ((cavityCell retained row i j).indicator (fun z ↦ g z j)) :=
    (hg j).indicator (hm j)
  have heq : cavityMeanReadout μ retained row i g = fun w ↦
      ∑ j, ∫ s, (cavityCell retained row i j).indicator (fun z ↦ g z j) (w, s) ∂μ := by
    funext w
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    have hsec : MeasurableSet {s | (w, s) ∈ cavityCell retained row i j} :=
      (hm j).preimage measurable_prodMk_left
    rw [← integral_indicator (μ := μ) (f := fun s ↦ g (w, s) j) hsec]
    rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun j _ ↦ (hf j).stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'.measurable

/-- Every integrable paired-test cavity readout admits a measurable version on Dirichlet
weights. Almost every weight is represented by an actual, uniquely calibrated allocation. -/
theorem exists_dirichlet_cavity_readout
    [StandardBorelSpace S]
    (μ : Measure S) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (c : Fin (m + 1) → S → ℝ) (hc : ∀ j, Measurable (c j))
    (hci : ∀ j, Integrable (c j) μ)
    (hatom : ∀ j l, j ≠ l → NullSingletonClass (μ.map (fun s ↦ c j s - c l s)))
    (g : S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (hgm : ∀ j, Measurable (fun s ↦ g s j)) (hgi : ∀ j, Integrable (fun s ↦ g s j) μ) :
    ∃ G : (Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) → ℝ, Measurable G ∧
      (∀ᵐ p ∂dirichletOne m, ∃ w : Fin m → S, iidCavityMassVector μ c w = p ∧
        G p = cavityMeanReadout μ (iidCapacityInputCost c (fun k w ↦ w k))
          (fun z j ↦ c j z.2) 0 (fun z ↦ g z.2) w) ∧
      (fun w ↦ cavityMeanReadout μ (iidCapacityInputCost c (fun k w ↦ w k))
        (fun z j ↦ c j z.2) 0 (fun z ↦ g z.2) w) =ᵐ[Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin m ↦ μ)]
          (G ∘ iidCavityMassVector μ c) := by
  let : Nonempty S := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure μ
  let retained := iidCapacityInputCost c (fun (k : Fin m) (w : Fin m → S) ↦ w k)
  let row : (Fin m → S) × S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ := fun z j ↦ c j z.2
  have hret := measurable_iidCavityRetained c hc
  have hrow j : Measurable (fun z ↦ row z j) := (hc j).comp measurable_snd
  have hconst (w v : Fin m → S) (hp : iidCavityMassVector μ c w = iidCavityMassVector μ c v) :
      cavityMeanReadout μ retained row 0 (fun z ↦ g z.2) w =
        cavityMeanReadout μ retained row 0 (fun z ↦ g z.2) v := by
    apply cavityMeanReadout_eq_of_same_masses μ retained hret (fun s j ↦ c j s)
      hc hci hatom 0 w v ?_ g hgi
    intro j
    have hj := congrArg (fun p ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (p j)) hp
    simpa only [ofReal_iidCavityMassVector] using hj
  obtain ⟨G, hG, hrep, hfactor⟩ := exists_measurable_readout_of_fiber_constancy
    (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin m ↦ μ)) (iidCavityMassVector μ c)
    (measurable_iidCavityMassVector μ c hc)
    (cavityMeanReadout μ retained row 0 (fun z ↦ g z.2))
    (measurable_cavityMeanReadout μ retained row hret hrow 0 _
      (fun j ↦ (hgm j).comp measurable_snd)) hconst
  rw [map_iidCavityMassVector_eq_dirichletOne μ c hc hatom] at hrep
  exact ⟨G, hG, hrep, hfactor⟩

theorem exists_countable_exceptional_opposite_semidiscrete_optima
    (μ : Measure S) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (ρ : Measure V) [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ]
    (c g : Fin (m + 1) → V → S → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ j, Measurable (Function.uncurry (c j)))
    (hci : ∀ᵐ v ∂ρ, ∀ j, Integrable (c j v) μ)
    (hg : ∀ j, Measurable (Function.uncurry (g j)))
    (hatom : ∀ᵐ v ∂ρ, ∀ j l, j ≠ l →
      NullSingletonClass (μ.map (fun s ↦ c j v s - c l v s)))
    (G : ℝ≥0) (hbound : ∀ v s j, |g j v s| ≤ G) :
    ∃ N : Set ℝ, N.Countable ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, t ∉ N →
      ∀ᵐ v ∂ρ, ∀ᵐ p ∂dirichletOne m, ∃ a₀ aplus aminus : S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ,
        IsOptimalSemidiscreteAllocation μ p (fun s j ↦ c j v s) a₀ ∧
        IsOptimalSemidiscreteAllocation μ p (fun s j ↦ c j v s + t * g j v s) aplus ∧
        IsOptimalSemidiscreteAllocation μ p (fun s j ↦ c j v s + (-t) * g j v s) aminus

theorem exists_opposite_semidiscrete_optima_sequence
    (μ : Measure S) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (ρ : Measure V) [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ]
    (c g : Fin (m + 1) → V → S → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ j, Measurable (Function.uncurry (c j)))
    (hci : ∀ᵐ v ∂ρ, ∀ j, Integrable (c j v) μ)
    (hg : ∀ j, Measurable (Function.uncurry (g j)))
    (hatom : ∀ᵐ v ∂ρ, ∀ j l, j ≠ l →
      NullSingletonClass (μ.map (fun s ↦ c j v s - c l v s)))
    (G : ℝ≥0) (hbound : ∀ v s j, |g j v s| ≤ G) :
    ∃ t : ℕ → ℝ, StrictAnti t ∧ (∀ n, 0 < t n) ∧ Tendsto t atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ᵐ v ∂ρ, ∀ᵐ p ∂dirichletOne m, ∀ n, ∃ a₀ aplus aminus : S → Fin (m + 1) → ℝ,
        IsOptimalSemidiscreteAllocation μ p (fun s j ↦ c j v s) a₀ ∧
        IsOptimalSemidiscreteAllocation μ p (fun s j ↦ c j v s + t n * g j v s) aplus ∧
        IsOptimalSemidiscreteAllocation μ p (fun s j ↦ c j v s + (-t n) * g j v s) aminus
